    <script>
        let fullLeaderboard = [];
        let currentMarketFilter = 'ALL';

        function escapeHtml(str) {
            if (str == null) return '';
            return String(str)
                .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
                .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
                .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
                .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
                .replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
        }

        function openSymbolDrawer(sym) {
            return openSymbol(sym);
        }

        function resolveApiUrl(url) {
            if (!url) return url;
            if (url.startsWith('http://') || url.startsWith('https://')) return url;
            let base = window.location.pathname || '/';
            if (!base.endsWith('/')) {
                if (!base.split('/').pop().includes('.')) {
                    base += '/';
                } else {
                    base = base.substring(0, base.lastIndexOf('/') + 1);
                }
            }
            const clean = url.startsWith('/') ? url.slice(1) : url;
            return base + clean;
        }

        async function fetchJson(primaryUrl, fallbackUrl) {
            const pUrl = resolveApiUrl(primaryUrl);
            const fUrl = fallbackUrl ? resolveApiUrl(fallbackUrl) : null;
            try {
                const res = await fetch(pUrl);
                if (res.ok) return await res.json();
            } catch (e) {}
            if (fUrl) {
                try {
                    const res2 = await fetch(fUrl);
                    if (res2.ok) return await res2.json();
                } catch (e) {}
            }
            if (primaryUrl && primaryUrl !== pUrl) {
                try {
                    const res3 = await fetch(primaryUrl);
                    if (res3.ok) return await res3.json();
                } catch (e) {}
            }
            throw new Error(`Failed to fetch from ${pUrl} or ${fUrl}`);
        }

        // =========================================================================
        // Phase 21.1: Universal Command Palette (Ctrl+K / Cmd+K Omnibar) & Shortcuts
        // =========================================================================
        let paletteActiveCategory = 'ALL';
        let paletteSelectedIndex = 0;
        let paletteFilteredItems = [];
        let rawSignalsData = [];

        function isCommandPaletteOpen() {
            const m = document.getElementById('commandPaletteModal');
            return m && m.style.display === 'flex';
        }

        function openCommandPalette() {
            const modal = document.getElementById('commandPaletteModal');
            const overlay = document.getElementById('modalOverlay');
            const input = document.getElementById('commandPaletteInput');
            if (!modal || !overlay || !input) return;

            modal.style.display = 'flex';
            overlay.style.display = 'block';
            overlay.style.zIndex = '190';
            input.value = '';
            paletteSelectedIndex = 0;
            filterCommandPalette();
            setTimeout(() => input.focus(), 50);
        }

        function closeCommandPalette() {
            const modal = document.getElementById('commandPaletteModal');
            const overlay = document.getElementById('modalOverlay');
            if (modal) modal.style.display = 'none';
            if (overlay) {
                overlay.style.display = 'none';
                overlay.style.zIndex = '150';
            }
        }

        function setPaletteCategory(cat) {
            paletteActiveCategory = cat;
            document.querySelectorAll('.palette-chip').forEach(c => {
                c.classList.toggle('active', c.id === `chip-${cat}`);
            });
            paletteSelectedIndex = 0;
            filterCommandPalette();
        }

        function handlePaletteKeydown(e) {
            if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
                e.preventDefault();
                if (paletteFilteredItems.length > 0) {
                    paletteSelectedIndex = (paletteSelectedIndex + 1) % paletteFilteredItems.length;
                    renderPaletteResults();
                    scrollToSelectedPaletteItem();
                }
            } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
                e.preventDefault();
                if (paletteFilteredItems.length > 0) {
                    paletteSelectedIndex = (paletteSelectedIndex - 1 + paletteFilteredItems.length) % paletteFilteredItems.length;
                    renderPaletteResults();
                    scrollToSelectedPaletteItem();
                }
            } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                e.preventDefault();
                if (paletteFilteredItems.length > 0 && paletteFilteredItems[paletteSelectedIndex]) {
                    executePaletteAction(paletteFilteredItems[paletteSelectedIndex]);
                }
            } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                e.preventDefault();
                closeCommandPalette();
            }
        }

        function scrollToSelectedPaletteItem() {
            const selEl = document.querySelector('.palette-item.selected');
            if (selEl) {
                selEl.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest', behavior: 'smooth' });
            }
        }

        function executePaletteAction(item) {
            closeCommandPalette();
            if (item.type === 'EQUITY') {
                openSymbol(item.symbol);
            } else if (item.type === 'SCANNER') {
                switchTab('scanners');
                switchScannerView('cards');
                setTimeout(() => {
                    const cards = document.querySelectorAll('#scannersGrid .scanner-card');
                    for (const c of cards) {
                        if (c.innerText.toLowerCase().includes(item.name.toLowerCase()) || (item.id && c.innerText.toLowerCase().includes(item.id.toLowerCase()))) {
                            c.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
                            c.style.boxShadow = '0 0 20px var(--accent-blue)';
                            setTimeout(() => c.style.boxShadow = '', 2000);
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }, 150);
            } else if (item.type === 'SIGNAL') {
                switchTab('signals');
                const sigInput = document.getElementById('signalSearchInput');
                if (sigInput) {
                    sigInput.value = item.symbol;
                    filterSignalsView();
                }
            } else if (item.type === 'STRATEGY') {
                switchTab('backtest');
                if (typeof selectStrategy === 'function') {
                    selectStrategy(item.id);
                }
            } else if (item.type === 'TAB') {
                switchTab(item.tabId);
            }
        }

        function filterCommandPalette() {
            const query = (document.getElementById('commandPaletteInput')?.value || '').trim().toLowerCase();
            const items = [];

            // 1. Navigation Tabs
            if (paletteActiveCategory === 'ALL' || paletteActiveCategory === 'TABS') {
                const tabs = [
                    { tabId: 'leaderboard', label: 'Opportunity Leaderboard', icon: '🏆', desc: 'Composite 0-100 ranked stock universe across US & Canada' },
                    { tabId: 'scanners', label: 'TAC-15 Market Scanners', icon: '📡', desc: 'Institutional pattern recognition, squeeze, sweep, & liquidity scanners' },
                    { tabId: 'signals', label: 'Research Signal Plans', icon: '🎯', desc: 'Pre-computed trade setups with entry zones, stops, & 3 profit targets' },
                    { tabId: 'backtest', label: 'Backtest Lab & Validation', icon: '🧪', desc: 'Walk-forward event-driven backtesting, partial trim ladder, & cash sweep' },
                    { tabId: 'paper', label: 'Live Paper Trading', icon: '📝', desc: 'Virtual portfolio book execution with MFE/MAE resolution tracking' },
                    { tabId: 'portfolio', label: 'Portfolio Intelligence', icon: '💼', desc: 'Multi-asset allocation, cross-border exposure, & risk profiles' },
                    { tabId: 'alerts', label: 'Alert Center & Dispatch', icon: '🔔', desc: 'Material filing alerts, threshold notifications, & delivery consent' },
                    { tabId: 'deepread', label: 'AI Deep-Read & Model Cards', icon: '🤖', desc: 'Explainable AI layer, SHAP attribution, & model risk disclosure' },
                    { tabId: 'catalysts', label: 'News & SEC Filings', icon: '📰', desc: 'Real-time NLP sentiment, materiality scoring, & regulatory catalysts' },
                    { tabId: 'journal', label: 'Research Journal & Watchlists', icon: '📔', desc: 'Position tracking, quantitative notes, & custom security watchlists' },
                ];
                tabs.forEach(t => {
                    if (!query || t.label.toLowerCase().includes(query) || t.desc.toLowerCase().includes(query)) {
                        items.push({ type: 'TAB', ...t, title: t.label, subtitle: t.desc });
                    }
                });
            }

            // 2. Equities (19 Securities)
            if (paletteActiveCategory === 'ALL' || paletteActiveCategory === 'EQUITIES') {
                if (fullLeaderboard && fullLeaderboard.length) {
                    fullLeaderboard.forEach(s => {
                        const mSymbol = s.symbol.toLowerCase().includes(query);
                        const mName = s.name.toLowerCase().includes(query);
                        const mSector = (s.sector || '').toLowerCase().includes(query);
                        if (!query || mSymbol || mName || mSector) {
                            items.push({
                                type: 'EQUITY',
                                symbol: s.symbol,
                                name: s.name,
                                exchange: s.exchange,
                                country: s.country,
                                price: s.close || s.price,
                                score: s.composite_score,
                                title: `${s.symbol} · ${s.name}`,
                                subtitle: `${s.country === 'US' ? '🇺🇸' : '🇨🇦'} ${s.exchange} · Score: ${s.composite_score}/100 · $${(s.close || s.price || 0).toFixed(2)}`
                            });
                        }
                    });
                }
            }

            // 3. Scanners (15 Definitions)
            if (paletteActiveCategory === 'ALL' || paletteActiveCategory === 'SCANNERS') {
                const scannerDefs = [
                    { id: 'PO3_LIQUIDITY_SWEEP', name: 'TAC-15: PO3 Liquidity Sweep Reversal', tag: 'ACCUMULATION SWEEP', win: '58.5%' },
                    { id: 'VOLATILITY_SQUEEZE', name: 'TAC-02: Volatility Squeeze Expansion', tag: 'EXPANSION', win: '55.2%' },
                    { id: 'BASE_TIGHTENING', name: 'TAC-06: Base Tightening Consolidation', tag: 'VOL CONTRACTION', win: '54.0%' },
                    { id: 'PULLBACK_UPTREND', name: 'TAC-01: Pullback to Key Support Swing', tag: 'TREND CONTINUATION', win: '52.8%' },
                    { id: 'MOMENTUM_LEADERS', name: 'TAC-04: Momentum 52W High Breakout', tag: 'RELATIVE STRENGTH', win: '53.6%' },
                    { id: 'STACKED_MOVING_AVERAGES', name: 'TAC-08: Stacked Moving Averages (Golden)', tag: 'STRUCTURAL TREND', win: '56.0%' },
                    { id: 'LOW_BETA_QUALITY', name: 'TAC-11: Low-Beta Quality Defensive', tag: 'DEFENSIVE VALUE', win: '54.5%' },
                    { id: 'MTF_ALIGNMENT', name: 'TAC-09: Multi-Timeframe Trend Alignment', tag: 'MULTI-TIMEFRAME', win: '57.0%' },
                    { id: 'HIGH_RVOL_SURGE', name: 'TAC-07: High Relative Volume Surge', tag: 'VOLUME SURGE', win: '53.2%' },
                    { id: 'ATR_EXPANSION', name: 'TAC-10: ATR Volatility Expansion', tag: 'VOLATILITY SHOCK', win: '51.8%' },
                    { id: 'INSTITUTIONAL_ACCUMULATION', name: 'TAC-13: Institutional Block Accumulation', tag: 'ORDER FLOW', win: '56.8%' },
                    { id: 'MEAN_REVERSION_OVERSOLD', name: 'TAC-05: Mean Reversion Deep Oversold', tag: 'OVERSOLD REVERSAL', win: '52.1%' },
                ];
                scannerDefs.forEach(s => {
                    if (!query || s.name.toLowerCase().includes(query) || s.tag.toLowerCase().includes(query) || s.id.toLowerCase().includes(query)) {
                        items.push({
                            type: 'SCANNER',
                            id: s.id,
                            name: s.name,
                            tag: s.tag,
                            win: s.win,
                            title: s.name,
                            subtitle: `Pattern: ${s.tag} · Historical Win Rate: ${s.win}`
                        });
                    }
                });
            }

            // 4. Research Signals
            if (paletteActiveCategory === 'ALL' || paletteActiveCategory === 'SIGNALS') {
                if (rawSignalsData && rawSignalsData.length) {
                    rawSignalsData.forEach(sig => {
                        const mSym = sig.symbol.toLowerCase().includes(query);
                        const mDir = (sig.direction || '').toLowerCase().includes(query);
                        if (!query || mSym || mDir) {
                            items.push({
                                type: 'SIGNAL',
                                symbol: sig.symbol,
                                direction: sig.direction,
                                entry: sig.entry_price || sig.preferred_entry,
                                rr: sig.reward_risk_ratio || sig.rr_ratio || '2.2:1',
                                title: `Signal Plan: ${sig.symbol} [${sig.direction || 'LONG'}]`,
                                subtitle: `Entry: $${(sig.entry_price || sig.preferred_entry || 0).toFixed(2)} · R:R ${sig.reward_risk_ratio || '2.2:1'}`
                            });
                        }
                    });
                }
            }

            // 5. Backtest Strategies
            if (paletteActiveCategory === 'ALL' || paletteActiveCategory === 'STRATEGIES') {
                const strats = [
                    { id: 'PO3_LIQUIDITY_SWEEP', name: 'TAC-15: PO3 Liquidity Sweep Reversal', returnPct: '+10.03%', sharpe: '0.27', win: '48.6%' },
                    { id: 'ADAPTIVE_DUAL_REGIME', name: 'Dual-Regime Adaptive Ensemble', returnPct: '+12.59%', sharpe: '0.32', win: '47.3%' },
                    { id: 'ENSEMBLE_8F', name: '8-Factor Trend & Value Ensemble', returnPct: '-23.90%', sharpe: '-1.18', win: '36.5%' },
                    { id: 'TAC02_SQUEEZE', name: 'TAC-02: Volatility Squeeze Expansion', returnPct: '+2.04%', sharpe: '-0.27', win: '38.5%' },
                    { id: 'TAC01_PULLBACK', name: 'TAC-01: Pullback Support Swing', returnPct: '-20.20%', sharpe: '-1.13', win: '38.0%' },
                ];
                strats.forEach(st => {
                    if (!query || st.name.toLowerCase().includes(query) || st.id.toLowerCase().includes(query)) {
                        items.push({
                            type: 'STRATEGY',
                            id: st.id,
                            name: st.name,
                            title: `Strategy: ${st.name}`,
                            subtitle: `Return: ${st.returnPct} · Sharpe: ${st.sharpe} · Win Rate: ${st.win}`
                        });
                    }
                });
            }

            paletteFilteredItems = items;
            if (paletteSelectedIndex >= paletteFilteredItems.length) {
                paletteSelectedIndex = 0;
            }
            renderPaletteResults();
        }

        function renderPaletteResults() {
            const container = document.getElementById('commandPaletteResults');
            const countEl = document.getElementById('paletteResultCount');
            if (!container) return;

            if (paletteFilteredItems.length === 0) {
                container.innerHTML = `
                    <div style="padding: 36px 20px; text-align: center; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 13px;">
                        <div>🔍 No matching symbols, scanners, or commands found</div>
                        <div style="font-size: 11px; margin-top: 6px;">Try typing a ticker symbol like <strong>SHOP</strong>, <strong>NVDA</strong>, or a pattern like <strong>PO3</strong>.</div>
                    </div>
                `;
                if (countEl) countEl.innerText = '0 matches';
                return;
            }

            if (countEl) countEl.innerText = `Showing ${paletteFilteredItems.length} match${paletteFilteredItems.length === 1 ? '' : 'es'}`;

            let html = '';
            paletteFilteredItems.forEach((item, idx) => {
                const isSel = idx === paletteSelectedIndex;
                let badge = '';
                if (item.type === 'EQUITY') {
                    const isUS = item.country === 'US';
                    badge = `<span class="exchange-tag" style="background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.15); color: var(--accent-blue);">${isUS ? 'US' : 'TSX'}</span>`;
                } else if (item.type === 'SCANNER') {
                    badge = `<span class="exchange-tag" style="background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15); color: var(--accent-green);">SCANNER</span>`;
                } else if (item.type === 'SIGNAL') {
                    badge = `<span class="exchange-tag" style="background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15); color: var(--accent-amber);">SIGNAL</span>`;
                } else if (item.type === 'STRATEGY') {
                    badge = `<span class="exchange-tag" style="background: rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.15); color: var(--accent-purple);">BACKTEST</span>`;
                } else if (item.type === 'TAB') {
                    badge = `<span class="exchange-tag" style="background: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.15); color: var(--accent-cyan);">${item.icon || 'TAB'}</span>`;
                }

                html += `
                    <div class="palette-item ${isSel ? 'selected' : ''}" onclick="executePaletteAction(paletteFilteredItems[${idx}])" onmouseenter="paletteSelectedIndex = ${idx}; renderPaletteResultsHighlight();">
                        <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-width: 0; flex: 1;">
                            ${badge}
                            <div style="min-width: 0; flex: 1;">
                                <div style="font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-primary); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;">
                                    ${item.title}
                                </div>
                                <div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;">
                                    ${item.subtitle}
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;">
                            <span style="font-size: 10px; opacity: 0.7;">↵ Jump</span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
            });

            container.innerHTML = html;
        }

        function renderPaletteResultsHighlight() {
            const items = document.querySelectorAll('.palette-item');
            items.forEach((el, i) => {
                el.classList.toggle('selected', i === paletteSelectedIndex);
            });
        }

        // Global Keyboard Shortcut Interceptor (Ctrl+K / Cmd+K / Slash / Escape)
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            const isInput = ['INPUT', 'TEXTAREA', 'SELECT'].includes(document.activeElement.tagName);
            if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'k') {
                e.preventDefault();
                if (isCommandPaletteOpen()) {
                    closeCommandPalette();
                } else {
                    openCommandPalette();
                }
            } else if (e.key === '/' && !isInput) {
                e.preventDefault();
                openCommandPalette();
            } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                if (isCommandPaletteOpen()) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    closeCommandPalette();
                }
            }
        });

        // Phase 21.3: Scanner & Signal Workstation Filters
        let activeScannerCardFilter = 'ALL';
        function setScannerCardFilter(filter) {
            activeScannerCardFilter = filter;
            ['btnScFilterAll', 'btnScFilterHigh', 'btnScFilterPass', 'btnScFilterHasMatches'].forEach(id => {
                const btn = document.getElementById(id);
                if (btn) btn.classList.remove('active');
            });
            if (filter === 'ALL') document.getElementById('btnScFilterAll')?.classList.add('active');
            if (filter === 'HIGH') document.getElementById('btnScFilterHigh')?.classList.add('active');
            if (filter === 'PASS') document.getElementById('btnScFilterPass')?.classList.add('active');
            if (filter === 'MATCHES') document.getElementById('btnScFilterHasMatches')?.classList.add('active');
            filterScannerCardsView();
        }

        function filterScannerCardsView() {
            const q = (document.getElementById('scannerCardSearchInput')?.value || '').trim().toLowerCase();
            const cards = document.querySelectorAll('#scannersGrid .scanner-card');
            cards.forEach(card => {
                const text = card.innerText.toLowerCase();
                const matchesQ = !q || text.includes(q);
                let matchesF = true;
                if (activeScannerCardFilter === 'HIGH') {
                    matchesF = card.querySelector('.conviction-high') !== null || text.includes('high') || text.includes('8') || text.includes('9');
                } else if (activeScannerCardFilter === 'PASS') {
                    matchesF = !text.includes('regime gated');
                } else if (activeScannerCardFilter === 'MATCHES') {
                    matchesF = !text.includes('no qualifying securities');
                }
                card.style.display = (matchesQ && matchesF) ? 'block' : 'none';
            });
        }

        let activeSignalMarketFilter = 'ALL';
        function setSignalFilter(f) {
            activeSignalMarketFilter = f;
            document.getElementById('btnSigAll')?.classList.toggle('active', f === 'ALL');
            document.getElementById('btnSigUS')?.classList.toggle('active', f === 'US');
            document.getElementById('btnSigCA')?.classList.toggle('active', f === 'CA');
            filterSignalsView();
        }

        function filterSignalsView() {
            const q = (document.getElementById('signalSearchInput')?.value || '').trim().toLowerCase();
            const cards = document.querySelectorAll('#signalsGrid .signal-card');
            cards.forEach(card => {
                const text = card.innerText.toLowerCase();
                const matchesQ = !q || text.includes(q);
                let matchesM = true;
                if (activeSignalMarketFilter === 'US') {
                    matchesM = text.includes('nasdaq') || text.includes('nyse') || text.includes('us');
                } else if (activeSignalMarketFilter === 'CA') {
                    matchesM = text.includes('tsx') || text.includes('ca');
                }
                card.style.display = (matchesQ && matchesM) ? 'block' : 'none';
            });
        }

        async function init() {
            // Concurrent parallel fetches for all core feeds
            fetchJson('/api/summary.json', '/api/daily_summary.json')
                .then(data => renderRegimes(data.regimes))
                .catch(err => console.error("Summary load error:", err));

            fetchJson('/api/leaderboard.json', '/api/leaderboard')
                .then(data => {
                    fullLeaderboard = data.securities;
                    renderLeaderboard(fullLeaderboard);
                    runCustomScreener();
                    initSavedPresetsDropdown();
                })
                .catch(err => console.error("Leaderboard load error:", err));

            fetchJson('/api/scanners.json', '/api/scanners')
                .then(data => {
                    rawScannersData = data;
                    renderScanners(data.matches || []);
                    if (data.scanner_definitions) {
                        renderScannerExpectancyTable(data.scanner_definitions, data.active_regime || 'WEAK_BULL');
                    }
                })
                .catch(err => console.error("Scanners load error:", err));

            fetchJson('/api/signals.json', '/api/signals')
                .then(data => {
                    rawSignalsData = data.signals || [];
                    renderSignals(rawSignalsData);
                })
                .catch(err => console.error("Signals load error:", err));

            fetchJson('/api/quant_intel.json', '/api/quant_intel')
                .then(data => {
                    quantIntelBundle = data;
                    renderQuantIntelView();
                })
                .catch(err => console.error("Quant Intel load error:", err));

            loadBacktestsAndRender();
        }

        function renderRegimes(regimes) {
            const grid = document.getElementById('regimeGrid');
            grid.innerHTML = '';

            for (const [ctry, r] of Object.entries(regimes)) {
                const card = document.createElement('div');
                const isStrong = r.regime_state === 'STRONG_BULL';
                card.className = `regime-card ${isStrong ? 'strong-bull' : 'weak-bull'}`;
                
                card.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="regime-header">
                        <div>
                            <div class="regime-name">${r.market_label} (${ctry})</div>
                            <div style="font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; margin-top: 2px;">
                                ${r.benchmark_symbol} @ $${r.benchmark_price.toFixed(2)}
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <span class="regime-state-badge ${isStrong ? 'badge-bull' : 'badge-weak-bull'}">
                            ${r.regime_state.replace('_', ' ')} (${Math.round(r.filtered_probability * 100)}%)
                        </span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="regime-metrics">
                        <div>Score Multiplier: <strong style="color: var(--text-primary);">${r.score_multiplier}x</strong></div>
                        <div>Position Size Scaling: <strong style="color: var(--text-primary);">${r.risk_scaling}x</strong></div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="regime-drivers">
                        <ul>
                            ${r.top_drivers.map(d => `<li>${d}</li>`).join('')}
                        </ul>
                    </div>
                `;
                grid.appendChild(card);
            }
        }

        function renderLeaderboard(items) {
            const tbody = document.getElementById('leaderboardBody');
            tbody.innerHTML = '';

            items.forEach(item => {
                const tr = document.createElement('tr');
                tr.onclick = () => openSymbol(item.symbol);

                const scoreClass = item.composite_score >= 60 ? 'score-high' : (item.composite_score >= 45 ? 'score-mid' : 'score-low');
                const proxClass = item.proximity_52w_high >= -5 ? 'color: var(--accent-green);' : (item.proximity_52w_high <= -20 ? 'color: var(--accent-red);' : '');

                const confScore = item.mtf_confluence_score ?? 50;
                const confLabel = item.mtf_confluence_label || 'NEUTRAL';
                const confColor = confScore >= 75 ? 'var(--accent-green)' : (confScore >= 50 ? 'var(--accent-blue)' : 'var(--accent-amber)');

                const vaState = item.value_area_state || 'INSIDE_VALUE';
                const vaColor = vaState === 'ABOVE_VALUE' ? 'var(--accent-cyan)' : (vaState === 'INSIDE_VALUE' ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-amber)');

                const fundScore = item.fundamental_score;
                const isEtf = item.coverage_status === 'INDEX_ETF_BYPASS';
                const fundColor = fundScore >= 65 ? 'var(--accent-green)' : (fundScore >= 45 ? 'var(--accent-blue)' : 'var(--accent-amber)');
                const fundDisplay = isEtf 
                    ? `<span class="exchange-tag" style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--accent-blue);">ETF BYPASS</span>`
                    : (fundScore != null 
                        ? `<div><span style="font-weight: 800; color: ${fundColor}; font-size: 12px;">${fundScore}/100</span><div style="font-size: 9px; color: var(--text-muted);">Q:${item.quality_score} · V:${item.valuation_score}</div></div>`
                        : `<span style="color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 11px;">N/A</span>`);

                const roicDisplay = item.roic != null ? `<span style="font-family: monospace; font-weight: 700;">${item.roic.toFixed(1)}%</span>` : `<span style="color: var(--text-muted);">-</span>`;
                const peDisplay = item.pe_ratio != null ? `<span style="font-family: monospace;">${item.pe_ratio.toFixed(1)}x</span>` : `<span style="color: var(--text-muted);">-</span>`;

                tr.innerHTML = `
                    <td>
                        <div class="symbol-badge">
                            <span>${item.symbol}</span>
                            <span class="exchange-tag">${item.exchange}</span>
                            ${item.is_dual_listed ? `<span class="exchange-tag" style="font-size: 9px; background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.15); color: var(--accent-blue);" title="Dual-listed on NYSE as ${item.dual_listed_us_sym}">US:${item.dual_listed_us_sym}</span>` : ''}
                        </div>
                        <div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted);">${item.name}</div>
                    </td>
                    <td>
                        <strong>$${item.price.toFixed(2)}</strong> <span style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted);">${item.currency}</span>
                    </td>
                    <td>
                        <div class="score-box">
                            <span class="score-pill ${scoreClass}">${item.composite_score}/100</span>
                        </div>
                    </td>
                    <td>
                        ${fundDisplay}
                    </td>
                    <td>
                        ${roicDisplay}
                    </td>
                    <td>
                        ${peDisplay}
                    </td>
                    <td>
                        <div style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: ${confColor};">${confScore}%</div>
                        <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted);">${confLabel.replace(/_/g, ' ')}</div>
                    </td>
                    <td>
                        <span class="exchange-tag" style="color: ${vaColor}; font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px;">
                            ${vaState.replace(/_/g, ' ')}
                        </span>
                    </td>
                    <td>
                        <span style="font-weight: 700; color: ${item.confidence_tier === 'A' ? 'var(--accent-green)' : (item.confidence_tier === 'B' ? 'var(--accent-blue)' : 'var(--accent-amber)')};">
                            Tier ${item.confidence_tier}
                        </span>
                    </td>
                    <td>${item.rsi_14.toFixed(1)}</td>
                    <td>${item.rvol_20.toFixed(2)}x</td>
                    <td style="${proxClass} font-weight: 600;">
                        ${item.proximity_52w_high > 0 ? '+' : ''}${item.proximity_52w_high.toFixed(1)}%
                    </td>
                    <td>
                        ${item.scanner_tags.slice(0, 2).map(t => `<span class="tag-pill">${t}</span>`).join('')}
                        ${item.scanner_tags.length > 2 ? `<span class="tag-pill">+${item.scanner_tags.length - 2}</span>` : ''}
                    </td>
                `;
                tbody.appendChild(tr);
            });
        }

        function renderScanners(matches) {
            const grid = document.getElementById('scannersGrid');
            grid.innerHTML = '';

            const grouped = {};
            matches.forEach(m => {
                if (!grouped[m.scanner_name]) grouped[m.scanner_name] = [];
                grouped[m.scanner_name].push(m);
            });

            for (const [name, list] of Object.entries(grouped)) {
                const card = document.createElement('div');
                card.className = 'scanner-card';
                card.style.cursor = 'pointer';
                card.title = `Click to inspect institutional strategy specification & rules for ${name}`;
                const stratIdToOpen = list[0].scanner_id || name;
                card.onclick = () => openStrategyModal(stratIdToOpen);
                const isGated = list[0].regime_gated;
                const gateTag = isGated
                    ? `<span class="exchange-tag" style="background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15); color: var(--accent-amber); border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.4); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700;">⚠️ REGIME GATED</span>`
                    : `<span class="exchange-tag" style="background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15); color: var(--accent-green); border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.4); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700;">✓ REGIME PASS</span>`;

                card.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="scanner-header">
                        <span class="scanner-title" style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;">
                            <span>${name}</span>
                            <span style="font-size: 11px; opacity: 0.7; color: var(--accent-cyan);" title="Inspect Strategy Spec">🔬</span>
                        </span>
                        <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;">
                            ${gateTag}
                            <span class="scanner-count">${list.length}</span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 8px;">
                        ${list[0].why_matched.split(';')[0]}
                    </div>
                    <div class="scanner-matches">
                        ${list.map(m => {
                            const isDeRisk = m.idiosyncratic_risk_multiplier && m.idiosyncratic_risk_multiplier < 0.70;
                            const isCaution = m.idiosyncratic_risk_multiplier && m.idiosyncratic_risk_multiplier < 1.0 && !isDeRisk;
                            const multBadge = isDeRisk
                                ? `<span style="font-size: 9px; padding: 1px 4px; border-radius: 3px; background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.2); color: var(--accent-red); margin-left: 4px;" title="Pre-Flight De-Risk: ${m.primary_risk_driver || 'Hurst flip'}">⚠️ ${(m.idiosyncratic_risk_multiplier*100).toFixed(0)}%</span>`
                                : (isCaution
                                    ? `<span style="font-size: 9px; padding: 1px 4px; border-radius: 3px; background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.2); color: var(--accent-amber); margin-left: 4px;" title="Pre-Flight Caution: ${m.primary_risk_driver || 'Detractor drag'}">${(m.idiosyncratic_risk_multiplier*100).toFixed(0)}%</span>`
                                    : '');
                            const cScore = m.conviction_score != null ? m.conviction_score : 75;
                            const cTier = m.conviction_tier || (cScore >= 80 ? 'HIGH' : (cScore >= 65 ? 'MODERATE' : 'WATCHLIST'));
                            const scoreColor = cTier === 'HIGH' ? 'var(--accent-green)' : (cTier === 'MODERATE' ? 'var(--accent-cyan)' : 'var(--accent-amber)');
                            const scorePill = `<span class="conviction-${cTier.toLowerCase()}" style="font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; padding: 1px 4px; border-radius: 3px; background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.15); color: ${scoreColor}; margin-left: 4px;" title="Setup Conviction: ${cScore}/100 (${cTier})">${cScore.toFixed(0)} pts</span>`;

                            return `
                            <span class="match-badge" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); openSymbol('${m.symbol}')" title="Inspect ${m.symbol} Dossier · Conviction: ${cScore}/100 (${cTier}) · Pre-flight: ${m.primary_risk_driver || 'Normal equilibrium'}">
                                ${m.symbol} <span style="color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 10px;">$${m.price.toFixed(1)}</span>
                                ${scorePill}
                                ${multBadge}
                            </span>
                        `}).join('')}
                    </div>
                `;
                grid.appendChild(card);
            }
        }

        // ==========================================
        // CUSTOM MULTI-FACTOR SCREENER WORKSTATION
        // ==========================================
        let rawScannersData = null;
        let screenerMatches = [];
        let screenerSortCol = 'composite_score';
        let screenerSortAsc = false;

        function switchScannerView(mode) {
            const screenerView = document.getElementById('screenerTableView');
            const cardsView = document.getElementById('screenerCardsView');
            const expView = document.getElementById('screenerExpectancyView');
            const btnScreener = document.getElementById('btnViewScreener');
            const btnCards = document.getElementById('btnViewCards');
            const btnExp = document.getElementById('btnViewExpectancy');

            if (screenerView) screenerView.style.display = mode === 'screener' ? 'block' : 'none';
            if (cardsView) cardsView.style.display = mode === 'cards' ? 'block' : 'none';
            if (expView) expView.style.display = mode === 'expectancy' ? 'block' : 'none';

            btnScreener?.classList.toggle('active', mode === 'screener');
            btnCards?.classList.toggle('active', mode === 'cards');
            btnExp?.classList.toggle('active', mode === 'expectancy');

            if (mode === 'screener') runCustomScreener();
            if (mode === 'expectancy' && rawScannersData) {
                renderScannerExpectancyTable(rawScannersData.scanner_definitions, rawScannersData.active_regime || 'WEAK_BULL');
            }
        }

        function renderScannerExpectancyTable(defs, activeRegime) {
            const tbody = document.getElementById('scannerExpectancyTableBody');
            if (!tbody || !defs) return;

            let html = '';
            defs.forEach(d => {
                const isPass = d.regime_status === 'PASS';
                const gateBadge = isPass
                    ? `<span class="verdict-badge-edge" style="font-size: 10px;">✓ PASS (${d.active_market_regime})</span>`
                    : `<span class="verdict-badge-conditional" style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--accent-amber); border-color: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.4); background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.1);">⚠️ GATED (${d.active_market_regime})</span>`;

                html += `
                    <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease;" title="Click to inspect strategy specification & rules for ${d.name}" onclick="openStrategyModal('${d.scanner_id}')">
                        <td style="padding: 12px 14px;">
                            <div style="font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-primary); font-size: 13px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;">
                                <span>${d.name}</span>
                                <span style="font-size: 11px; opacity: 0.7; color: var(--accent-cyan);">🔬</span>
                            </div>
                            <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); font-family: monospace;">${d.scanner_id}</div>
                        </td>
                        <td style="padding: 12px 14px;">
                            <span class="exchange-tag" style="font-size: 10px;">${d.category}</span>
                        </td>
                        <td style="padding: 12px 14px; font-family: monospace; font-size: 11px; color: var(--accent-cyan); max-width: 320px;">
                            ${d.rule_summary}
                        </td>
                        <td style="padding: 12px 14px; text-align: center;">
                            ${gateBadge}
                        </td>
                        <td style="padding: 12px 14px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace; font-weight: 800; color: var(--accent-green);">
                            +${d.forward_5d_return_pct.toFixed(2)}%
                        </td>
                        <td style="padding: 12px 14px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace; font-weight: 800; color: var(--text-primary);">
                            ${d.historical_win_rate_pct.toFixed(1)}%
                        </td>
                        <td style="padding: 12px 14px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace; font-weight: 800; color: var(--accent-blue);">
                            +${d.expectancy_r.toFixed(2)}R
                        </td>
                        <td style="padding: 12px 14px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-secondary);">
                            ${d.sample_size}
                        </td>
                    </tr>
                `;
            });

            tbody.innerHTML = html;
        }

        function updateScoreVal(val) {
            const el = document.getElementById('scScoreVal');
            if (el) el.innerText = '≥ ' + val;
        }

        function updateTechVal(val) {
            const el = document.getElementById('scTechVal');
            if (el) el.innerText = '≥ ' + val;
        }

        function applyScreenerPreset(preset) {
            resetScreenerFilters(false);
            if (preset === 'high_probability') {
                document.getElementById('scScore').value = '65';
                updateScoreVal(65);
                document.getElementById('scTier').value = 'AB';
            } else if (preset === 'po3_sweep') {
                document.getElementById('scScore').value = '50';
                updateScoreVal(50);
                document.getElementById('scRsi').value = 'NEUTRAL';
                document.getElementById('scRvol').value = '1.0';
            } else if (preset === 'momentum_breakout') {
                document.getElementById('scScore').value = '55';
                updateScoreVal(55);
                document.getElementById('scRvol').value = '1.0';
                document.getElementById('scProx52w').value = '7';
                document.getElementById('scRsi').value = 'MOMENTUM';
            } else if (preset === 'support_pullback') {
                document.getElementById('scScore').value = '50';
                updateScoreVal(50);
                document.getElementById('scRsi').value = 'PULLBACK';
            } else if (preset === 'tsx_leaders') {
                document.getElementById('scMarket').value = 'CA';
                document.getElementById('scScore').value = '55';
                updateScoreVal(55);
            } else if (preset === 'us_growth') {
                document.getElementById('scMarket').value = 'US';
                document.getElementById('scScore').value = '60';
                updateScoreVal(60);
            } else if (preset === 'low_volatility') {
                document.getElementById('scAtr').value = 'LOW';
                document.getElementById('scScore').value = '50';
                updateScoreVal(50);
            }
            runCustomScreener();
        }

        function resetScreenerFilters(triggerRun = true) {
            const mkt = document.getElementById('scMarket');
            if (mkt) mkt.value = 'ALL';
            const score = document.getElementById('scScore');
            if (score) { score.value = '0'; updateScoreVal(0); }
            const tech = document.getElementById('scTech');
            if (tech) { tech.value = '0'; updateTechVal(0); }
            const rsi = document.getElementById('scRsi');
            if (rsi) rsi.value = 'ALL';
            const rvol = document.getElementById('scRvol');
            if (rvol) rvol.value = 'ALL';
            const prox = document.getElementById('scProx52w');
            if (prox) prox.value = 'ALL';
            const atr = document.getElementById('scAtr');
            if (atr) atr.value = 'ALL';
            const tier = document.getElementById('scTier');
            if (tier) tier.value = 'ALL';
            const search = document.getElementById('screenerSearchInput');
            if (search) search.value = '';

            if (triggerRun) runCustomScreener();
        }

        function runCustomScreener() {
            if (!fullLeaderboard || fullLeaderboard.length === 0) return;

            const mkt = document.getElementById('scMarket')?.value || 'ALL';
            const minScore = parseInt(document.getElementById('scScore')?.value || '0', 10);
            const minTech = parseInt(document.getElementById('scTech')?.value || '0', 10);
            const rsiBand = document.getElementById('scRsi')?.value || 'ALL';
            const minRvol = document.getElementById('scRvol')?.value || 'ALL';
            const proxBand = document.getElementById('scProx52w')?.value || 'ALL';
            const atrBand = document.getElementById('scAtr')?.value || 'ALL';
            const tierVal = document.getElementById('scTier')?.value || 'ALL';
            const searchQ = (document.getElementById('screenerSearchInput')?.value || '').trim().toLowerCase();

            screenerMatches = fullLeaderboard.filter(item => {
                // Market
                if (mkt !== 'ALL' && item.country !== mkt) return false;

                // Composite Score
                if (item.composite_score < minScore) return false;

                // Technical Score
                if (item.technical_score < minTech) return false;

                // RSI Band
                const rsi = item.rsi_14 || 50;
                if (rsiBand === 'OVERSOLD' && rsi >= 40) return false;
                if (rsiBand === 'PULLBACK' && (rsi < 40 || rsi > 55)) return false;
                if (rsiBand === 'MOMENTUM' && (rsi < 55 || rsi > 70)) return false;
                if (rsiBand === 'OVERBOUGHT' && rsi <= 70) return false;

                // RVOL
                const rvol = item.rvol_20 || 1.0;
                if (minRvol !== 'ALL') {
                    if (rvol < parseFloat(minRvol)) return false;
                }

                // 52W Proximity
                const prox = item.proximity_52w_high || 0;
                if (proxBand === '3' && prox < -3.0) return false;
                if (proxBand === '7' && prox < -7.0) return false;
                if (proxBand === '15' && prox < -15.0) return false;
                if (proxBand === 'DISCOUNT' && prox >= -15.0) return false;

                // ATR Volatility
                const atr = item.atr_pct || 2.5;
                if (atrBand === 'LOW' && atr >= 2.2) return false;
                if (atrBand === 'MED' && (atr < 2.2 || atr > 3.5)) return false;
                if (atrBand === 'HIGH' && atr <= 3.5) return false;

                // Confidence Tier
                if (tierVal === 'A' && item.confidence_tier !== 'A') return false;
                if (tierVal === 'AB' && item.confidence_tier !== 'A' && item.confidence_tier !== 'B') return false;

                // Text search
                if (searchQ) {
                    const symMatch = (item.symbol || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchQ);
                    const nameMatch = (item.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchQ);
                    const tagMatch = (item.scanner_tags || []).some(t => t.toLowerCase().includes(searchQ));
                    if (!symMatch && !nameMatch && !tagMatch) return false;
                }

                return true;
            });

            // Sort
            screenerMatches.sort((a, b) => {
                let valA = a[screenerSortCol];
                let valB = b[screenerSortCol];
                if (typeof valA === 'string') valA = valA.toLowerCase();
                if (typeof valB === 'string') valB = valB.toLowerCase();
                if (valA < valB) return screenerSortAsc ? -1 : 1;
                if (valA > valB) return screenerSortAsc ? 1 : -1;
                return 0;
            });

            renderScreenerTable();
        }

        function sortScreenerTable(col) {
            if (screenerSortCol === col) {
                screenerSortAsc = !screenerSortAsc;
            } else {
                screenerSortCol = col;
                screenerSortAsc = false;
            }
            runCustomScreener();
        }

        function renderScreenerTable() {
            const tbody = document.getElementById('screenerTableBody');
            const counter = document.getElementById('screenerResultsCount');
            if (!tbody) return;

            const total = fullLeaderboard.length;
            const matched = screenerMatches.length;
            const pct = total > 0 ? ((matched / total) * 100).toFixed(0) : 0;

            if (counter) {
                counter.innerHTML = `
                    <span style="color: var(--accent-cyan); font-weight: 800;">${matched}</span> of ${total} securities matched criteria 
                    <span style="font-weight: 400; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 11px;">(${pct}% of universe)</span>
                `;
            }

            if (matched === 0) {
                tbody.innerHTML = `
                    <tr>
                        <td colspan="12" style="text-align: center; padding: 40px; color: var(--text-muted);">
                            No securities match current screener criteria. Try lowering the minimum score or resetting filters.
                        </td>
                    </tr>
                `;
                return;
            }

            let html = '';
            screenerMatches.forEach(item => {
                const scoreClass = item.composite_score >= 60 ? 'score-high' : (item.composite_score >= 45 ? 'score-mid' : 'score-low');
                const proxColor = item.proximity_52w_high >= -5 ? 'var(--accent-green)' : (item.proximity_52w_high <= -20 ? 'var(--accent-red)' : 'var(--text-muted)');
                const rsiColor = item.rsi_14 < 40 ? 'var(--accent-purple)' : (item.rsi_14 > 65 ? 'var(--accent-amber)' : 'var(--text-primary)');
                const rvolColor = item.rvol_20 >= 1.5 ? 'var(--accent-green)' : (item.rvol_20 >= 1.0 ? 'var(--text-primary)' : 'var(--text-muted)');

                html += `
                    <tr onclick="openSymbol('${item.symbol}')">
                        <td>
                            <div class="symbol-badge">
                                <span style="cursor: pointer; font-weight: 800; color: var(--accent-blue);">${item.country === 'US' ? '🇺🇸' : '🇨🇦'} ${item.symbol}</span>
                            </div>
                        </td>
                        <td style="color: var(--text-primary); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600;">${item.name}</td>
                        <td>
                            <span class="exchange-tag">${item.exchange}</span>
                        </td>
                        <td style="font-family: monospace; font-weight: 700;">
                            $${item.price.toFixed(2)} <span style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted);">${item.currency}</span>
                        </td>
                        <td>
                            <span class="score-pill ${scoreClass}">${item.composite_score}/100</span>
                        </td>
                        <td>
                            <span style="font-weight: 700; color: ${item.confidence_tier === 'A' ? 'var(--accent-green)' : (item.confidence_tier === 'B' ? 'var(--accent-blue)' : 'var(--accent-amber)')};">
                                Tier ${item.confidence_tier}
                            </span>
                        </td>
                        <td style="font-family: monospace; font-weight: 600;">${item.technical_score}</td>
                        <td style="font-family: monospace; font-weight: 700; color: ${rsiColor};">${item.rsi_14.toFixed(1)}</td>
                        <td style="font-family: monospace; font-weight: 700; color: ${rvolColor};">${item.rvol_20.toFixed(2)}x</td>
                        <td style="font-family: monospace; font-weight: 600; color: ${proxColor};">
                            ${item.proximity_52w_high > 0 ? '+' : ''}${item.proximity_52w_high.toFixed(1)}%
                        </td>
                        <td style="font-family: monospace; color: var(--text-muted);">${item.atr_pct.toFixed(2)}%</td>
                        <td>
                            ${item.scanner_tags.slice(0, 2).map(t => `<span class="tag-pill" style="font-size: 10px; margin-right: 4px;">${t}</span>`).join('')}
                            ${item.scanner_tags.length > 2 ? `<span class="tag-pill" style="font-size: 10px;">+${item.scanner_tags.length - 2}</span>` : ''}
                        </td>
                    </tr>
                `;
            });

            tbody.innerHTML = html;
        }

        function exportScreenerCSV() {
            if (!screenerMatches || screenerMatches.length === 0) {
                alert("No screener results to export.");
                return;
            }
            const headers = ["Symbol", "Name", "Exchange", "Country", "Currency", "Price", "CompositeScore", "ConfidenceTier", "TechnicalScore", "RSI14", "RVOL20", "52WHighProx", "ATRPct", "MatchedSetups"];
            const rows = screenerMatches.map(m => [
                m.symbol,
                `"${m.name.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
                m.exchange,
                m.country,
                m.currency,
                m.price.toFixed(2),
                m.composite_score,
                m.confidence_tier,
                m.technical_score,
                m.rsi_14.toFixed(1),
                m.rvol_20.toFixed(2),
                m.proximity_52w_high.toFixed(1),
                m.atr_pct.toFixed(2),
                `"${(m.scanner_tags || []).join('; ')}"`
            ]);

            const csvContent = "data:text/csv;charset=utf-8," + [headers.join(","), ...rows.map(e => e.join(","))].join("\n");
            const encodedUri = encodeURI(csvContent);
            const link = document.createElement("a");
            link.setAttribute("href", encodedUri);
            link.setAttribute("download", `screener_export_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.csv`);
            document.body.appendChild(link);
            link.click();
            document.body.removeChild(link);
        }

        function exportScreenerJSON() {
            if (!screenerMatches || screenerMatches.length === 0) {
                alert("No screener results to export.");
                return;
            }
            const dataStr = "data:text/json;charset=utf-8," + encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(screenerMatches, null, 2));
            const dlAnchor = document.createElement('a');
            dlAnchor.setAttribute("href", dataStr);
            dlAnchor.setAttribute("download", `screener_export_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.json`);
            document.body.appendChild(dlAnchor);
            dlAnchor.click();
            dlAnchor.remove();
        }

        function saveCurrentPreset() {
            const nameInput = document.getElementById('scNewPresetName');
            const name = (nameInput?.value || '').trim();
            if (!name) {
                alert("Please enter a name for your custom screen preset.");
                return;
            }

            const presetConfig = {
                market: document.getElementById('scMarket')?.value || 'ALL',
                score: document.getElementById('scScore')?.value || '0',
                tech: document.getElementById('scTech')?.value || '0',
                rsi: document.getElementById('scRsi')?.value || 'ALL',
                rvol: document.getElementById('scRvol')?.value || 'ALL',
                prox: document.getElementById('scProx52w')?.value || 'ALL',
                atr: document.getElementById('scAtr')?.value || 'ALL',
                tier: document.getElementById('scTier')?.value || 'ALL',
            };

            try {
                let saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('market_screener_presets') || '{}');
                saved[name] = presetConfig;
                localStorage.setItem('market_screener_presets', JSON.stringify(saved));
                initSavedPresetsDropdown();
                const sel = document.getElementById('scSavedPresets');
                if (sel) sel.value = name;
                if (nameInput) nameInput.value = '';
                alert(`Saved preset "${name}" to browser local storage.`);
            } catch (e) {
                console.error("Failed to save preset:", e);
            }
        }

        function loadSavedPreset(name) {
            if (!name) return;
            try {
                const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('market_screener_presets') || '{}');
                const cfg = saved[name];
                if (!cfg) return;

                if (document.getElementById('scMarket')) document.getElementById('scMarket').value = cfg.market;
                if (document.getElementById('scScore')) {
                    document.getElementById('scScore').value = cfg.score;
                    updateScoreVal(cfg.score);
                }
                if (document.getElementById('scTech')) {
                    document.getElementById('scTech').value = cfg.tech;
                    updateTechVal(cfg.tech);
                }
                if (document.getElementById('scRsi')) document.getElementById('scRsi').value = cfg.rsi;
                if (document.getElementById('scRvol')) document.getElementById('scRvol').value = cfg.rvol;
                if (document.getElementById('scProx52w')) document.getElementById('scProx52w').value = cfg.prox;
                if (document.getElementById('scAtr')) document.getElementById('scAtr').value = cfg.atr;
                if (document.getElementById('scTier')) document.getElementById('scTier').value = cfg.tier;

                runCustomScreener();
            } catch (e) {
                console.error("Failed to load preset:", e);
            }
        }

        function deleteSavedPreset() {
            const sel = document.getElementById('scSavedPresets');
            const name = sel?.value;
            if (!name) {
                alert("Please select a preset to delete.");
                return;
            }
            if (!confirm(`Delete saved preset "${name}"?`)) return;

            try {
                let saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('market_screener_presets') || '{}');
                delete saved[name];
                localStorage.setItem('market_screener_presets', JSON.stringify(saved));
                initSavedPresetsDropdown();
            } catch (e) {
                console.error("Failed to delete preset:", e);
            }
        }

        function initSavedPresetsDropdown() {
            const sel = document.getElementById('scSavedPresets');
            if (!sel) return;
            const curVal = sel.value;
            let saved = {};
            try {
                saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('market_screener_presets') || '{}');
            } catch (e) {}

            let html = '<option value="">-- Select Saved Screen --</option>';
            for (const name of Object.keys(saved)) {
                html += `<option value="${name}">${name}</option>`;
            }
            sel.innerHTML = html;
            if (saved[curVal]) sel.value = curVal;
        }

        function renderSignals(signals) {
            const grid = document.getElementById('signalsGrid');
            if (!grid) return;
            grid.innerHTML = '';

            if (!signals || signals.length === 0) {
                grid.innerHTML = '<div style="padding: 40px; text-align: center; color: var(--text-muted);">No active research signals qualify under current market filters.</div>';
                return;
            }

            signals.forEach(s => {
                const card = document.createElement('div');
                card.className = 'signal-card';

                const t1 = typeof s.targets[0] === 'object' ? s.targets[0].target : s.targets[0];
                const t1Basis = typeof s.targets[0] === 'object' ? s.targets[0].basis : '1.5R Trim Target';
                const t2 = typeof s.targets[1] === 'object' ? s.targets[1].target : s.targets[1];
                const t2Basis = typeof s.targets[1] === 'object' ? s.targets[1].basis : '2.5R Target';
                const t3 = typeof s.targets[2] === 'object' ? s.targets[2].target : s.targets[2];

                const invList = (s.invalidation_predicates || []).slice(0, 2).map(inv => `
                    <li style="margin-bottom: 3px;">${inv.description}</li>
                `).join('');

                const rationaleTags = s.rationale ? `
                    <div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px; margin-top: 10px; margin-bottom: 12px;">
                        <span class="exchange-tag" style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--accent-cyan);">Tech: ${s.setup_type || 'POSTURE'}</span>
                        <span class="exchange-tag" style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--accent-green);">R:R ${s.risk_reward_ratio || 2.5}:1</span>
                        <span class="exchange-tag" style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted);">${s.holding_period_desc ? s.holding_period_desc.split('—')[0] : 'POSITION'}</span>
                    </div>
                ` : '';

                card.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="signal-card-header">
                        <div>
                            <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 4px;">
                                <span class="symbol-badge" style="font-size: 16px; font-weight: 800;">${s.symbol}</span>
                                <span class="exchange-tag">${s.exchange}</span>
                                <span class="score-pill" style="font-size: 10px; padding: 2px 6px; background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15); color: var(--accent-green); border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3);">
                                    ${s.stance || 'POTENTIAL LONG SETUP'}
                                </span>
                            </div>
                            <div style="font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted);">${s.name}</div>
                        </div>
                        <div style="text-align: right;">
                            <span class="score-pill score-high" style="font-size: 14px;">${s.composite_score}/100</span>
                            <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 3px;">Tier ${s.confidence_tier} · ${s.setup_type || 'SETUP'}</div>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <div class="signal-levels" style="grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr; margin-bottom: 10px;">
                        <div>
                            <div class="level-label">Preferred Entry</div>
                            <div class="level-val val-entry">$${s.preferred_entry.toFixed(2)}</div>
                            <div style="font-size: 9px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 2px;">Alt: $${(s.alt_entry || s.preferred_entry*0.98).toFixed(2)}</div>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                            <div class="level-label">Structural Stop</div>
                            <div class="level-val val-stop">$${s.structural_stop.toFixed(2)}</div>
                            <div style="font-size: 9px; color: var(--accent-red); margin-top: 2px;">-${s.stop_distance_pct || 4.5}% Risk</div>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                            <div class="level-label">Target 2 (2.5R)</div>
                            <div class="level-val val-target">$${t2 ? t2.toFixed(2) : '—'}</div>
                            <div style="font-size: 9px; color: var(--accent-green); margin-top: 2px;">Planned ${s.planned_rr_t2 || s.risk_reward_ratio}:1</div>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 11px; margin-bottom: 8px; background: var(--bg-card); padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border-color);">
                        <span>Entry Zone: <strong>$${s.entry_zone[0].toFixed(2)} – $${s.entry_zone[1].toFixed(2)}</strong></span>
                        <span style="color: var(--accent-cyan); font-weight: 600;">Realized R:R: ~${s.realized_rr_t1 || '1.3'}:1</span>
                    </div>

                    <div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 8px;">
                        <strong>Target Ladder:</strong> T1 $${t1 ? t1.toFixed(2) : '—'} (${t1Basis}) · T3 $${t3 ? t3.toFixed(2) : '—'} (Trailing Chandelier)
                    </div>

                    <div class="invalidation-box" style="margin-bottom: 10px;">
                        <div style="font-weight: 700; color: var(--accent-red); margin-bottom: 4px; font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase;">
                            Machine-Checkable Invalidation Rules:
                        </div>
                        <ul style="margin: 0; padding-left: 16px; font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: 1.4;">
                            ${invList}
                        </ul>
                    </div>

                    ${rationaleTags}

                    <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-top: 10px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color); padding-top: 10px;">
                        <span style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted);">

                            Open Dossier &amp; Plan &rarr;
                        </button>
                    </div>
                `;
                grid.appendChild(card);
            });
        }

        function renderSymbolBacktestInDrawer(symbol) {
            const container = document.getElementById('drawerBacktestSection');
            if (!container) return;

            if (!backtestBundle || !backtestBundle.strategies) {
                container.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); padding: 8px;">Loading walk-forward strategy records...</div>';
                return;
            }

            const strat = backtestBundle.strategies[selectedStrategyId] || backtestBundle.strategies['ENSEMBLE_8F'];
            const allTrades = strat.all_trades || strat.trades || strat.recent_trades || [];
            const symbolTrades = allTrades.filter(t => t.symbol === symbol);

            if (symbolTrades.length === 0) {
                container.innerHTML = `
                    <div style="font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted); padding: 12px; background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.4); border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border-color);">
                        No triggered trade executions for <strong>${symbol}</strong> under <em>${strat.strategy_name}</em> during the 501-session backtest period.
                    </div>
                `;
                return;
            }

            let winCount = 0;
            let sumPnl = 0;
            let sumR = 0;
            symbolTrades.forEach(t => {
                const net = t.net_pnl_usd != null ? t.net_pnl_usd : (t.net_pnl || 0);
                if (net > 0) winCount++;
                sumPnl += net;
                sumR += (t.r_multiple || 0);
            });

            const wr = ((winCount / symbolTrades.length) * 100).toFixed(1);
            const expR = (sumR / symbolTrades.length).toFixed(2);
            const pnlColor = sumPnl >= 0 ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-red)';
            const pnlFormatted = (sumPnl >= 0 ? '+$' : '-$') + Math.abs(sumPnl).toLocaleString(undefined, {minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2});

            let rows = '';
            symbolTrades.slice().reverse().forEach(t => {
                const net = t.net_pnl_usd != null ? t.net_pnl_usd : (t.net_pnl || 0);
                const isWin = net > 0;
                const pColor = t.partition === 'TRAIN' ? 'var(--accent-green)' : (t.partition === 'VALIDATION' ? 'var(--accent-purple)' : 'var(--accent-cyan)');
                rows += `
                    <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color); font-size: 11px;">
                        <td style="padding: 6px; font-family: monospace;">${t.entry_date}</td>
                        <td style="padding: 6px;">$${(t.entry_price || 0).toFixed(2)}</td>
                        <td style="padding: 6px;">$${(t.exit_price || 0).toFixed(2)}</td>
                        <td style="padding: 6px; color: var(--text-muted);">${t.holding_days}d</td>
                        <td style="padding: 6px;"><span class="exchange-tag" style="font-size: 9px;">${t.exit_reason}</span></td>
                        <td style="padding: 6px; font-weight: 700; color: ${isWin ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-red)'}; font-family: monospace;">

                        </td>
                        <td style="padding: 6px; font-weight: 700; color: ${isWin ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-red)'}; font-family: monospace;">

                        </td>
                        <td style="padding: 6px; color: ${pColor}; font-weight: 600; font-size: 10px;">${t.partition}</td>
                    </tr>
                `;
            });

            container.innerHTML = `
                <div style="background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.6); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px;">

                        <span style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted);">${symbolTrades.length} Simulated Orders</span>

                            <div style="font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: ${parseFloat(wr) >= 50 ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-amber)'};">${wr}%</div>
                        </div>
                        <div style="background: var(--bg-card); padding: 6px; border-radius: 4px; text-align: center; border: 1px solid var(--border-color);">
