                            <div style="font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: ${pnlColor};">${pnlFormatted}</div>
                        </div>
                        <div style="background: var(--bg-card); padding: 6px; border-radius: 4px; text-align: center; border: 1px solid var(--border-color);">
                            <div style="font-size: 9px; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase;">Avg R-Multiple</div>
                            <div style="font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: ${parseFloat(expR) >= 0 ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-red)'};">${parseFloat(expR) >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${expR}R</div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div style="max-height: 160px; overflow-y: auto;">
                        <table style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; text-align: left;">
                            <thead>
                                <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color); color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase;">
                                    <th style="padding: 4px 6px;">Entry</th>
                                    <th style="padding: 4px 6px;">Buy</th>
                                    <th style="padding: 4px 6px;">Sell</th>
                                    <th style="padding: 4px 6px;">Hold</th>
                                    <th style="padding: 4px 6px;">Trigger</th>
                                    <th style="padding: 4px 6px;">Return</th>
                                    <th style="padding: 4px 6px;">Net P&L</th>
                                    <th style="padding: 4px 6px;">Part</th>
                                </tr>
                            </thead>
                            <tbody>${rows}</tbody>
                        </table>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;
        }

        function renderAssetFingerprintInDrawer(fp) {
            const container = document.getElementById('drawerFingerprintSection');
            if (!container) return;

            if (!fp) {
                container.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); padding: 8px;">Microstructure DNA fingerprinting pending computation.</div>';
                return;
            }

            const isTrending = fp.hurst_class === 'TRENDING';
            const isMeanRev = fp.hurst_class === 'MEAN_REVERTING';
            const hurstColor = isTrending ? 'var(--accent-green)' : (isMeanRev ? 'var(--accent-cyan)' : 'var(--accent-amber)');
            const hurstBg = isTrending ? 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15)' : (isMeanRev ? 'rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.15)' : 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15)');

            const fdiTurbulent = fp.fractal_dimension_index >= 1.5;
            const fdiColor = fdiTurbulent ? 'var(--accent-amber)' : 'var(--accent-green)';
            const fdiLabel = fdiTurbulent ? 'Consolidation Chop' : 'Directional Trend';

            container.innerHTML = `
                <div style="background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px;">
                    <!-- Archetype Classification Banner -->
                    <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color); padding-bottom: 10px;">
                        <div>
                            <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 700;">Microstructure Archetype</div>
                            <div style="font-size: 14px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--accent-purple); margin-top: 2px;">
                                ${escapeHtml(fp.archetype_label)}
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <span style="font-size: 11px; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.15); color: #a78bfa; font-family: monospace; font-weight: 800; border: 1px solid rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.3);">
                            ${escapeHtml(fp.archetype)}
                        </span>
                    </div>

                    <!-- Microstructure Parameter Grid -->
                    <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(170px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 12px;">
                        <!-- Hurst Exponent -->
                        <div style="background: var(--bg-secondary); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 6px; padding: 10px;">
                            <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;">
                                <span style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase;">Lo HAC Hurst (H)</span>
                                <span style="font-size: 9px; padding: 1px 4px; border-radius: 2px; background: ${hurstBg}; color: ${hurstColor}; font-weight: 800;">${fp.hurst_class}</span>
                            </div>
                            <div style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 800; color: ${hurstColor}; margin-top: 4px;">
                                ${fp.hurst_exponent}
                            </div>
                            <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 2px;">
                                ${isTrending ? 'Persistent momentum' : (isMeanRev ? 'Anti-persistent cyclical' : 'Random walk equilibrium')}
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <!-- Fractional Differentiation d* -->
                        <div style="background: var(--bg-secondary); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 6px; padding: 10px;">
                            <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;">
                                <span style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase;">Optimal Order d*</span>
                                <span style="font-size: 9px; padding: 1px 4px; border-radius: 2px; background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.15); color: #60a5fa; font-weight: 800;">${fp.memory_retention_pct}% MEM</span>
                            </div>
                            <div style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--text-primary); margin-top: 4px;">
                                d* = ${fp.fractional_d_order}
                            </div>
                            <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 2px;">
                                ADF stationary memory
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <!-- Fractal Dimension Index -->
                        <div style="background: var(--bg-secondary); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 6px; padding: 10px;">
                            <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;">
                                <span style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase;">Fractal Index (FDI)</span>
                                <span style="font-size: 9px; padding: 1px 4px; border-radius: 2px; color: ${fdiColor}; font-weight: 800;">${fdiLabel}</span>
                            </div>
                            <div style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--text-primary); margin-top: 4px;">
                                ${fp.fractal_dimension_index}
                            </div>
                            <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 2px;">
                                Range: 1.0 (Trend) to 2.0 (Chop)
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <!-- Amihud Illiquidity -->
                        <div style="background: var(--bg-secondary); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 6px; padding: 10px;">
                            <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase;">Amihud Illiquidity</div>
                            <div style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--accent-cyan); margin-top: 4px;">
                                ${fp.amihud_illiquidity} <span style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted);">bps</span>
                            </div>
                            <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 2px;">
                                Price impact per $100k traded
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <!-- Auxiliary Parameters -->
                    <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); background: var(--bg-secondary); padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 4px; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px;">
                        <span>Dominant Harmonic Cycle: <strong style="color: var(--text-primary);">${fp.dominant_cycle_bars} trading sessions</strong></span>
                        <span>Downside Volatility Leverage (γ): <strong style="color: var(--accent-amber);">${fp.gjr_garch_gamma}</strong></span>
                        <span style="font-family: monospace;">Calibrated: ${fp.last_updated.substring(0, 10)}</span>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;
        }

        function renderConformalBoundsInDrawer(cb) {

            }

            const isCovered = cb.realized_coverage_pct >= 88.0;
            const covColor = isCovered ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-amber)';

            const warningBanner = cb.volatility_expansion_warning ? `
                <div style="background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12); border: 1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.35); border-radius: 6px; padding: 10px 14px; margin-bottom: 12px; font-size: 11px; color: #fca5a5;">
                    <strong style="color: #ef4444;">⚠ VOLATILITY EXPANSION REGIME ALERT:</strong> Current bandwidth is &gt; 35% wider than the 60-day baseline. Asymmetric downside risk is elevated; R:R may degrade rapidly.
                </div>
            ` : '';

            container.innerHTML = `
                <div style="background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px;">
                    ${warningBanner}

                    <!-- Top Summary Bar -->
                    <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color); padding-bottom: 10px;">
                        <div>
                            <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 700;">Finite-Sample Coverage Guarantee</div>
                            <div style="font-size: 14px; font-weight: 800; color: ${covColor}; margin-top: 2px;">
                                ${cb.realized_coverage_pct}% Realized <span style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 600;">(vs ${cb.nominal_coverage_pct}% Target)</span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div style="text-align: right;">
                            <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase;">ACI Adapted Alpha</div>
                            <div style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; font-family: monospace; color: var(--accent-cyan); margin-top: 2px;">
                                α_t = ${cb.adapted_alpha}
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <!-- Asymmetric Price Boundary Ladder -->
                    <div style="background: var(--bg-secondary); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 6px; padding: 12px; margin-bottom: 12px;">
                        <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 4px 0; border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.08);">
                            <span style="font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--accent-green);">Upper Exhaustion Target</span>
                            <span style="font-family: monospace; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--accent-green);">$${cb.conformal_upper_target.toFixed(2)} <span style="font-size: 10px;">(+${cb.target_distance_pct}%)</span></span>
                        </div>
                        <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 4px 0; border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.08);">
                            <span style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted);">Expected Path Median</span>
                            <span style="font-family: monospace; font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-secondary);">$${cb.conformal_median_path.toFixed(2)}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 4px 0; border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.08);">
                            <span style="font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-primary);">Current Spot Price</span>
                            <span style="font-family: monospace; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--text-primary);">$${cb.current_price.toFixed(2)}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 4px 0;">
                            <span style="font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--accent-red);">Structural Invalidation Stop</span>
                            <span style="font-family: monospace; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--accent-red);">$${cb.conformal_lower_stop.toFixed(2)} <span style="font-size: 10px;">(-${cb.stop_distance_pct}%)</span></span>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <!-- Metric Footer Grid -->
                    <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 8px; text-align: center;">
                        <div style="background: var(--bg-secondary); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px;">
                            <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase;">Conformal R:R</div>
                            <div style="font-size: 14px; font-weight: 800; color: ${cb.conformal_risk_reward_ratio >= 1.5 ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-amber)'}; margin-top: 2px;">
                                ${cb.conformal_risk_reward_ratio}x

                        </div>

                        <div style="background: var(--bg-secondary); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px;">

                            <div style="font-size: 14px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--text-primary); margin-top: 2px;">

                                ● ${cb.invalidation_status}

                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;
        }

        function renderDualListedParityInDrawer(p) {
            const wrapper = document.getElementById('drawerParityWrapper');
            const container = document.getElementById('drawerParitySection');
            if (!container || !wrapper) return;

            if (!p) {
                wrapper.style.display = 'none';
                return;
            }
            wrapper.style.display = 'block';

            const stateColor = p.parity_state === 'PARITY_EQUILIBRIUM' 
                ? 'var(--accent-green)' 
                : (p.parity_state === 'MILD_DISPARITY' ? 'var(--accent-amber)' : 'var(--accent-red)');
            const stateLabel = p.parity_state.replace(/_/g, ' ');

            const spreadColor = Math.abs(p.basis_spread_bps) <= 10.0 
                ? 'var(--accent-green)' 
                : (Math.abs(p.basis_spread_bps) <= 25.0 ? 'var(--accent-amber)' : 'var(--accent-red)');
            const spreadSign = p.basis_spread_bps >= 0 ? '+' : '';

            const zColor = Math.abs(p.basis_zscore_60d) <= 1.0 
                ? 'var(--accent-green)' 
                : (Math.abs(p.basis_zscore_60d) <= 2.0 ? 'var(--accent-amber)' : 'var(--accent-red)');
            const zSign = p.basis_zscore_60d >= 0 ? '+' : '';

            const cointColor = p.is_cointegrated ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-red)';
            const liqCenterColor = p.primary_liquidity_center === 'TSX' ? 'var(--accent-cyan)' : 'var(--accent-blue)';

            container.innerHTML = `
                <div style="background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px;">
                    <!-- Top Summary Bar -->
                    <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color); padding-bottom: 10px;">
                        <div>
                            <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 700;">Dual-Listed Parity Anchor</div>
                            <div style="font-size: 14px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--text-primary); margin-top: 2px;">
                                TSX:${p.tsx_symbol} <span style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted);">vs</span> ${p.us_exchange}:${p.us_symbol}
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div style="text-align: right;">
                            <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase;">BoC USD/CAD Valet Fixing</div>
                            <div style="font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; font-family: monospace; color: var(--accent-cyan); margin-top: 2px;">
                                $1 USD = ${p.boc_fx_rate.toFixed(4)} CAD
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <!-- Parity Pricing Comparison Ladder -->
                    <div style="background: var(--bg-secondary); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 6px; padding: 12px; margin-bottom: 12px;">
                        <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 4px 0; border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.08);">
                            <span style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted);">US Settlement Close (${p.us_exchange})</span>
                            <span style="font-family: monospace; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-primary);">$${p.us_close_usd.toFixed(2)} USD</span>
                        </div>
                        <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 4px 0; border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.08);">
                            <span style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted);">Implied CAD Parity Price (USD × FX)</span>
                            <span style="font-family: monospace; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--accent-cyan);">$${p.implied_cad_price.toFixed(2)} CAD</span>
                        </div>
                        <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 4px 0; border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.08);">
                            <span style="font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-primary);">TSX Actual Close</span>
                            <span style="font-family: monospace; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--text-primary);">$${p.tsx_close_cad.toFixed(2)} CAD</span>
                        </div>
                        <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 4px 0;">
                            <span style="font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: ${spreadColor};">Cross-Border Basis Disparity</span>
                            <span style="font-family: monospace; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; color: ${spreadColor};">
                                ${spreadSign}${p.basis_spread_bps} bps <span style="font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600;">(${spreadSign}${p.basis_spread_pct}%)</span>
                            </span>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <!-- Econometrics & Microstructure Grid -->
                    <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 8px; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 10px;">
                        <div style="background: var(--bg-secondary); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px;">
                            <div style="font-size: 9px; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase;">60d Basis Z-Score</div>
                            <div style="font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; color: ${zColor}; margin-top: 2px;">
                                ${zSign}${p.basis_zscore_60d}σ
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <div style="background: var(--bg-secondary); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px;">
                            <div style="font-size: 9px; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase;">Cointegration Beta</div>
                            <div style="font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; color: ${cointColor}; margin-top: 2px;">
                                β = ${p.cointegration_beta}
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <div style="background: var(--bg-secondary); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px;">
                            <div style="font-size: 9px; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase;">Half-Life (AR1)</div>
                            <div style="font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--accent-cyan); margin-top: 2px;">
                                ${p.half_life_days}d
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <div style="background: var(--bg-secondary); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px;">
                            <div style="font-size: 9px; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase;">Primary Liquidity</div>
                            <div style="font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; color: ${liqCenterColor}; margin-top: 4px;">
                                ${p.primary_liquidity_center} (${p.volume_ratio_tsx_to_us}x)
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); padding-top: 6px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color);">
                        <span>Parity State: <strong style="color: ${stateColor};">● ${stateLabel}</strong></span>
                        <span>Arbitrage Friction: <strong style="color: ${p.actionable_arbitrage_friction ? 'var(--accent-red)' : 'var(--accent-green)'};">${p.actionable_arbitrage_friction ? 'ACTIVE (>25 bps)' : 'SUB-FRICTION NOISE'}</strong></span>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;
        }

        function renderSHAPAttributionInDrawer(s) {
            const container = document.getElementById('drawerShapSection');
            if (!container) return;

            if (!s) {
                container.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); padding: 8px;">TreeSHAP factor attribution calibrating...</div>';
                return;
            }

            const diff = s.model_score - s.base_value;
            const diffSign = diff >= 0 ? '+' : '';
            const scoreColor = s.model_score >= 60 ? 'var(--accent-green)' : (s.model_score >= 45 ? 'var(--accent-blue)' : 'var(--accent-amber)');

            // Top drivers pills
            const driverPills = (s.top_drivers || []).map(d => `
                <div style="background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12); border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3); border-radius: 4px; padding: 6px 10px; margin-bottom: 6px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;">
                    <span style="font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-primary);">${d.feature_label}</span>

        function renderFundamentalsInDrawer(fd) {

            if (!container) return;

            if (!fd) {
                container.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); padding: 8px;">No fundamental data available for this instrument.</div>';
                return;

            if (fd.coverage_status === 'INDEX_ETF_BYPASS') {
                container.innerHTML = `
                    <div style="background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.5); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 6px; padding: 12px; font-size: 12px;">
                        <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 6px;">
                            <span class="exchange-tag" style="background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.15); color: var(--accent-blue); font-weight: 700;">INDEX ETF BYPASS</span>
                            <span style="font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-primary);">Composite Index Benchmark Instrument</span>
                        </div>
                        <div style="color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.5;">
                            This security is an Index Exchange-Traded Fund (ETF). Corporate 10-K/10-Q balance sheet concepts are structurally non-applicable.
                            The Scoring Engine automatically renormalizes 100% of the raw model weight to tactical technical and trend factors, preventing ungrounded fundamental dilution.

                    </div>
                `;
                return;
            }

            const q = fd.quality || {};
            const v = fd.valuation || {};
            const ds = fd.dividend_safety || {};

            const fScore = fd.composite_fundamental_score || 50;
            const qScore = q.quality_score || 50;
            const vScore = v.valuation_score || 50;

            const fScoreColor = fScore >= 65 ? 'var(--accent-green)' : (fScore >= 45 ? 'var(--accent-blue)' : 'var(--accent-amber)');
            const covStatus = fd.coverage_status || 'FULL';
            const covTagColor = covStatus === 'FULL' ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-amber)';

            const accrualsClass = (q.accruals_ratio != null && q.accruals_ratio < 0) ? 'color: var(--accent-green);' : (q.accruals_ratio > 0.05 ? 'color: var(--accent-amber);' : '');
            const accrualsDesc = (q.accruals_ratio != null && q.accruals_ratio < 0) ? 'Cash-Backed' : (q.accruals_ratio > 0.05 ? 'Accrual-Heavy' : 'Neutral');

            const marginTrendColor = (q.margin_trend_yoy_bps != null && q.margin_trend_yoy_bps >= 0) ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-red)';
            const marginTrendSign = (q.margin_trend_yoy_bps != null && q.margin_trend_yoy_bps >= 0) ? '+' : '';

            // Missing concepts rendering
            let missingNotice = '';
            if (fd.missing_fields && fd.missing_fields.length > 0) {
                missingNotice = `

            }

            container.innerHTML = `
                <!-- Fundamental Header -->
                <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; background: var(--bg-card); padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border-color); margin-bottom: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px;">
                    <div>
                        <div style="font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">Fundamental Opportunity Score</div>
                        <div style="font-size: 16px; font-weight: 800; color: ${fScoreColor}; margin-top: 2px;">
                            ${fScore}/100 <span style="font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-secondary); font-weight: 600;">(Quality: ${qScore} · Valuation: ${vScore})</span>

        function drawCandlestickChart(bars) {
            const canvas = document.getElementById('candleChart');
            if (!canvas || !bars || bars.length === 0) return;

            const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
            const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
            canvas.width = rect.width * 2;
            canvas.height = rect.height * 2;
            ctx.scale(2, 2);

            const width = rect.width;
            const height = rect.height;
            const paddingBottom = 20;
            const paddingTop = 15;

            // Take last 45 bars for clean visual display
            const displayBars = bars.slice(-45);
            const highs = displayBars.map(b => b.high);
            const lows = displayBars.map(b => b.low);

            const minP = Math.min(...lows) * 0.995;
            const maxP = Math.max(...highs) * 1.005;
            const priceRange = maxP - minP;

            const candleWidth = (width / displayBars.length) * 0.7;
            const slotWidth = width / displayBars.length;

            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);

            displayBars.forEach((b, i) => {
                const x = (i * slotWidth) + (slotWidth / 2);
                const isGreen = b.close >= b.open;

                const openY = paddingTop + (1 - (b.open - minP) / priceRange) * (height - paddingTop - paddingBottom);
                const closeY = paddingTop + (1 - (b.close - minP) / priceRange) * (height - paddingTop - paddingBottom);
                const highY = paddingTop + (1 - (b.high - minP) / priceRange) * (height - paddingTop - paddingBottom);
                const lowY = paddingTop + (1 - (b.low - minP) / priceRange) * (height - paddingTop - paddingBottom);

                // Wick
                ctx.strokeStyle = isGreen ? '#10b981' : '#ef4444';
                ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(x, highY);
                ctx.lineTo(x, lowY);
                ctx.stroke();

                // Candle Body
                ctx.fillStyle = isGreen ? '#10b981' : '#ef4444';
                const bodyY = Math.min(openY, closeY);
                const bodyHeight = Math.max(2, Math.abs(closeY - openY));
                ctx.fillRect(x - candleWidth / 2, bodyY, candleWidth, bodyHeight);
            });
        }

        function closeDrawer() {
            document.getElementById('symbolDrawer').classList.remove('open');
            document.getElementById('drawerOverlay').style.display = 'none';

        // =========================================================================
        // Phase 22: QUANT INTEL™ Institutional Stock Intelligence Engine & Workstation
        // =========================================================================
        let quantIntelBundle = null;
        let currentQiPortfolio = 100000;
        let activeQiFilter = 'ALL';
        let quantIntelLoading = false;

        async function loadQuantIntelAndRender() {
            if (quantIntelBundle) {
                renderQuantIntelView();
                return;
            }
            if (quantIntelLoading) return;
            quantIntelLoading = true;

            const grid = document.getElementById('quantIntelGrid');
            if (grid) {
                grid.innerHTML = '<div style="grid-column: 1/-1; text-align: center; padding: 40px; color: var(--text-muted);"><div class="spinner" style="margin-right: 8px;"></div> Loading 6-layer QUANT INTEL dossiers across US & Canada...</div>';
            }

            try {
                quantIntelBundle = await fetchJson('/api/quant_intel.json', '/api/quant_intel');
                renderQuantIntelView();
            } catch (e) {
                console.error("Quant Intel load error:", e);
                if (grid) {
                    grid.innerHTML = `<div style="grid-column: 1/-1; text-align: center; padding: 24px; color: var(--accent-red);">Unable to load Quant Intel feed. <button class="filter-btn" style="margin-left: 10px;" onclick="loadQuantIntelAndRender()">Retry</button></div>`;
                }
            } finally {
                quantIntelLoading = false;
            }
        }

        function setQuantIntelPortfolio(amt) {
            currentQiPortfolio = amt;
            ['btnQiPort25k', 'btnQiPort50k', 'btnQiPort100k', 'btnQiPort250k', 'btnQiPort1M'].forEach(id => {
                const btn = document.getElementById(id);
                if (btn) btn.classList.remove('active');
            });
            if (amt === 25000) document.getElementById('btnQiPort25k')?.classList.add('active');
            else if (amt === 50000) document.getElementById('btnQiPort50k')?.classList.add('active');
            else if (amt === 100000) document.getElementById('btnQiPort100k')?.classList.add('active');
            else if (amt === 250000) document.getElementById('btnQiPort250k')?.classList.add('active');
            else if (amt === 1000000) document.getElementById('btnQiPort1M')?.classList.add('active');

            const budgetEl = document.getElementById('qiRiskBudgetBadge');
            if (budgetEl) {
                budgetEl.innerText = `Risk Budget: $${(amt * 0.01).toLocaleString()} (1%)`;
            }
            filterQuantIntelGrid();
        }

        function setQuantIntelFilter(filter) {
            activeQiFilter = filter;
            ['btnQiFilterAll', 'btnQiFilterB', 'btnQiFilterC', 'btnQiFilterTradeable', 'btnQiFilterSkip'].forEach(id => {
                const btn = document.getElementById(id);
                if (btn) btn.classList.remove('active');
            });
            if (filter === 'ALL') document.getElementById('btnQiFilterAll')?.classList.add('active');
            else if (filter === 'B') document.getElementById('btnQiFilterB')?.classList.add('active');
            else if (filter === 'C') document.getElementById('btnQiFilterC')?.classList.add('active');
            else if (filter === 'TRADEABLE') document.getElementById('btnQiFilterTradeable')?.classList.add('active');
            else if (filter === 'SKIP') document.getElementById('btnQiFilterSkip')?.classList.add('active');

            filterQuantIntelGrid();
        }

        function renderQuantIntelView() {
            if (!quantIntelBundle || !quantIntelBundle.dossiers) return;
            const dossiers = Object.values(quantIntelBundle.dossiers);

            const countAll = dossiers.length;
            const countB = dossiers.filter(d => d.conviction_grade === 'B' || d.conviction_grade === 'A').length;
            const countC = dossiers.filter(d => d.conviction_grade === 'C').length;
            const countTradeable = dossiers.filter(d => ['A', 'B', 'C'].includes(d.conviction_grade)).length;
            const countSkip = dossiers.filter(d => d.conviction_grade === 'SKIP').length;

            const elAll = document.getElementById('qiCountAll');
            const elB = document.getElementById('qiCountB');
            const elC = document.getElementById('qiCountC');
            const elT = document.getElementById('qiCountTradeable');
            const elS = document.getElementById('qiCountSkip');

            if (elAll) elAll.innerText = countAll;
            if (elB) elB.innerText = countB;
            if (elC) elC.innerText = countC;
            if (elT) elT.innerText = countTradeable;
            if (elS) elS.innerText = countSkip;

            filterQuantIntelGrid();
        }

        function filterQuantIntelGrid() {
            const grid = document.getElementById('quantIntelGrid');
            if (!grid || !quantIntelBundle || !quantIntelBundle.dossiers) return;

            const q = (document.getElementById('qiSearchInput')?.value || '').toLowerCase().trim();
            const dossiers = Object.values(quantIntelBundle.dossiers);

            const filtered = dossiers.filter(d => {
                const matchesFilter = (
                    activeQiFilter === 'ALL' ||
                    (activeQiFilter === 'B' && (d.conviction_grade === 'B' || d.conviction_grade === 'A')) ||
                    (activeQiFilter === 'C' && d.conviction_grade === 'C') ||
                    (activeQiFilter === 'TRADEABLE' && ['A', 'B', 'C'].includes(d.conviction_grade)) ||
                    (activeQiFilter === 'SKIP' && d.conviction_grade === 'SKIP')
                );
                if (!matchesFilter) return false;

                if (!q) return true;
                const sym = (d.symbol || '').toLowerCase();
                const pat = (d.layer_2_fingerprint?.dominant_pattern || '').toLowerCase();
                const arch = (d.layer_2_fingerprint?.archetype_label || '').toLowerCase();
                const thesis = (d.trade_plan?.trade_thesis || '').toLowerCase();
                return sym.includes(q) || pat.includes(q) || arch.includes(q) || thesis.includes(q);
            });

            // Sort: B-Grade first, then C-Grade, then SKIP; within grade by R:R descending
            const gradeOrder = { 'A': 1, 'B': 2, 'C': 3, 'SKIP': 4 };
            filtered.sort((a, b) => {
                const gA = gradeOrder[a.conviction_grade] || 5;
                const gB = gradeOrder[b.conviction_grade] || 5;
                if (gA !== gB) return gA - gB;
                return (b.trade_plan?.risk_reward_ratio || 0) - (a.trade_plan?.risk_reward_ratio || 0);
            });

            if (filtered.length === 0) {
                grid.innerHTML = '<div style="grid-column: 1/-1; text-align: center; padding: 40px; color: var(--text-muted);">No setups match the current filter criteria.</div>';
                return;
            }

            const riskBudget = currentQiPortfolio * 0.01;

            grid.innerHTML = filtered.map(d => {
                const p = d.trade_plan;
                const l1 = d.layer_1_regime;
                const l2 = d.layer_2_fingerprint;
                const l3 = d.layer_3_technical;
                const l4 = d.layer_4_fundamental;
                const l5 = d.layer_5_sentiment;
                const l6 = d.layer_6_memory;
                const grade = d.conviction_grade;

                const gradeColor = grade === 'A' ? 'var(--accent-green)' : (grade === 'B' ? 'var(--accent-cyan)' : (grade === 'C' ? 'var(--accent-amber)' : 'var(--accent-red)'));
                const gradeBg = grade === 'A' ? 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15)' : (grade === 'B' ? 'rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.15)' : (grade === 'C' ? 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15)' : 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15)'));

                // Calibrated shares for active portfolio capital
                const stopDist = p.stop_distance_dollars;
                let dynamicShares = 0;
                if (grade === 'A' || grade === 'B') {
                    dynamicShares = stopDist > 0 ? Math.floor(riskBudget / stopDist) : 0;
                } else if (grade === 'C') {
                    dynamicShares = stopDist > 0 ? Math.floor((riskBudget / stopDist) * 0.50) : 0;
                }
                const dynamicRiskDollars = (dynamicShares * stopDist).toFixed(2);
                const dynamicPosVal = (dynamicShares * p.entry_zone_ideal).toFixed(2);

                // Phase 23 ML Meta-Label Gating Badge
                const meta = d.meta_label_verdict || null;
                let metaBadgeHtml = '';
                if (meta) {
                    const metaProbPct = (meta.meta_probability * 100).toFixed(1);
                    let metaColor = 'var(--accent-green)';
                    let metaBg = 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15)';
                    let metaActionShort = 'PROCEED';
                    if (meta.action === 'CAUTION_THROTTLE') {
                        metaColor = 'var(--accent-amber)';
                        metaBg = 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15)';
                        metaActionShort = 'THROTTLE (0.50x)';
                    } else if (meta.action === 'GATED_EXCLUDE') {
                        metaColor = 'var(--accent-red)';
                        metaBg = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15)';
                        metaActionShort = 'GATED (0.00x)';
                    } else if (meta.action === 'MODERATE_PROCEED') {
                        metaColor = 'var(--accent-cyan)';
                        metaBg = 'rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.15)';
                        metaActionShort = 'PROCEED (0.85x)';
                    } else {
                        metaActionShort = 'HIGH CONVICTION (1.0x)';
                    }

                    metaBadgeHtml = `
                        <!-- Phase 23: ML Meta-Label Gating Badge -->
                        <div style="background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.7); border: 1px solid rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.25); border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 10px; margin-bottom: 10px; font-size: 11px;">
                            <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 4px;">
                                <span style="font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; color: #94a3b8; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.5px;">ML Meta-Label Gating:</span>
                                <span style="font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; background: ${metaBg}; color: ${metaColor}; border: 1px solid ${metaColor}40;">
                                    ${metaActionShort} (${metaProbPct}%)
                                </span>
                            </div>
                            <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-secondary);">
                                <span style="overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; max-width: 65%;" title="${meta.primary_driver}">Driver: <strong style="color: #e2e8f0;">${meta.primary_driver}</strong></span>
                                <span>Governor: <strong style="color: ${metaColor};">${meta.size_multiplier}x Sizing</strong></span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    `;
                }

                // Phase 24: Macro Regime Forward Hazard Governor
                let macroBadgeHtml = '';
                if (l1 && (l1.adverse_hazard_rate_20d !== undefined)) {
                    const haz20Pct = (l1.adverse_hazard_rate_20d * 100).toFixed(1);
                    const hTier = l1.hazard_tier || 'LOW_HAZARD';
                    const expDays = (l1.expected_regime_duration_days || 15).toFixed(1);
                    let hColor = 'var(--accent-green)';
                    let hBg = 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15)';
                    if (hTier === 'ELEVATED_HAZARD' || hTier === 'SEVERE_HAZARD' || l1.adverse_hazard_rate_20d >= 0.20) {
                        hColor = 'var(--accent-amber)';
                        hBg = 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15)';
                    }
                    macroBadgeHtml = `
                        <!-- Phase 24: Macro Regime Hazard Governor -->
                        <div style="background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.7); border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.25); border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 10px; margin-bottom: 10px; font-size: 11px;">
                            <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 4px;">
                                <span style="font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; color: #94a3b8; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.5px;">Markov Regime Hazard:</span>
                                <span style="font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; background: ${hBg}; color: ${hColor}; border: 1px solid ${hColor}40;">
                                    ${hTier.replace('_', ' ')} (20d: ${haz20Pct}%)
                                </span>
                            </div>
                            <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-secondary);">
                                <span>Regime: <strong style="color: #e2e8f0;">${l1.regime_state}</strong> (E[D]: ${expDays}d)</span>
                                <span>Posture: <strong style="color: var(--accent-cyan);">${(l1.cross_border_macro_divergence_posture || 'SYNCHRONIZED').replace(/_/g, ' ')}</strong></span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    `;
                }

                // Phase 25: Real-Time Microstructure & DOM Badge
                const micro = d.microstructure_metrics || null;
                let microBadgeHtml = '';
                if (micro) {
                    const obiPctVal = (micro.order_book_imbalance * 100).toFixed(0);
                    let obiCol = 'var(--accent-green)';
                    let obiBg = 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15)';
                    if (micro.order_book_imbalance < -0.20) {
                        obiCol = 'var(--accent-red)';
                        obiBg = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15)';
                    } else if (Math.abs(micro.order_book_imbalance) <= 0.20) {
                        obiCol = 'var(--accent-cyan)';
                        obiBg = 'rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.15)';
                    }
                    microBadgeHtml = `
                        <!-- Phase 25: Real-Time Microstructure Badge -->
                        <div style="background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.7); border: 1px solid rgba(234, 179, 8, 0.25); border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 10px; margin-bottom: 10px; font-size: 11px;">
                            <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 4px;">
                                <span style="font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; color: #94a3b8; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.5px;">Order Flow &amp; DOM:</span>
                                <span style="font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; background: ${obiBg}; color: ${obiCol}; border: 1px solid ${obiCol}40;">
                                    OBI: ${micro.order_book_imbalance > 0 ? '+' : ''}${obiPctVal}%
                                </span>
                            </div>
                            <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-secondary);">
                                <span>CVD (1m): <strong style="color: ${micro.cvd_1m_delta >= 0 ? '#34d399' : '#f87171'};">${micro.cvd_1m_delta > 0 ? '+' : ''}${micro.cvd_1m_delta.toLocaleString()} sh</strong></span>
                                <span>Liquidity: <strong style="color: ${micro.liquidity_state === 'NORMAL' ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-red)'};">${micro.liquidity_state}</strong></span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    `;
                }

                return `
                    <div class="scanner-card" style="border-top: 3px solid ${gradeColor}; cursor: default; transition: transform 0.15s ease;" onmouseenter="this.style.transform='translateY(-2px)'" onmouseleave="this.style.transform='translateY(0)'">
                        <!-- Card Header -->
                        <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; margin-bottom: 12px;">
                            <div>
                                <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;">
                                    <span style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 800; cursor: pointer;" onclick="openSymbol('${d.symbol}')" title="Inspect Full Dossier">
                                        ${d.symbol}
                                    </span>
                                    <span class="exchange-tag">${d.exchange}</span>
                                    <span class="exchange-tag" style="font-size: 10px;">${d.country}</span>
                                </div>
                                <div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-secondary); margin-top: 2px;">
                                    ${l2.dominant_pattern}
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <div style="text-align: right;">
                                <span style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: ${gradeBg}; color: ${gradeColor}; border: 1px solid ${gradeColor}40;">
                                    ${grade}-GRADE
                                </span>
                                <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 4px;">
                                    ${d.aligned_layers_count}/5 Layers Aligned
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <!-- 6-Layer Mini Strip -->
                        <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(6, 1fr); gap: 4px; background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.6); padding: 6px; border-radius: 6px; margin-bottom: 12px; text-align: center; font-size: 9px;">
                            <div title="L1 Macro Regime: ${l1.regime_fit}">
                                <div style="color: var(--text-muted);">REG</div>
                                <div style="font-weight: 700; color: ${l1.regime_fit === 'YES' ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-amber)'};">${l1.regime_fit}</div>
                            </div>
                            <div title="L2 Microstructure: Hurst ${l2.hurst_exponent}">
                                <div style="color: var(--text-muted);">HURST</div>
                                <div style="font-weight: 700; color: var(--accent-cyan);">${l2.hurst_exponent.toFixed(2)}</div>
                            </div>
                            <div title="L3 Technical Stack: ${l3.status}">
                                <div style="color: var(--text-muted);">TECH</div>
                                <div style="font-weight: 700; color: ${l3.status === 'BULLISH' ? 'var(--accent-green)' : (l3.status === 'NEUTRAL' ? 'var(--accent-amber)' : 'var(--accent-red)')};">${l3.status.slice(0,4)}</div>
                            </div>
                            <div title="L4 Fundamental Score: ${l4.score}/10">
                                <div style="color: var(--text-muted);">FUND</div>
                                <div style="font-weight: 700; color: ${l4.score >= 7 ? 'var(--accent-green)' : (l4.score >= 5 ? 'var(--accent-cyan)' : 'var(--accent-amber)')};">${l4.score.toFixed(1)}</div>
                            </div>
                            <div title="L5 Sentiment Net: ${l5.net_sentiment_score}">
                                <div style="color: var(--text-muted);">SENT</div>
                                <div style="font-weight: 700; color: ${l5.net_sentiment_score > 0 ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--text-muted)'};">${l5.net_sentiment_score > 0 ? '+' : ''}${l5.net_sentiment_score.toFixed(1)}</div>
                            </div>
                            <div title="L6 Historical Win Rate: ${l6.win_rate_pct}%">
                                <div style="color: var(--text-muted);">HIST</div>
                                <div style="font-weight: 700; color: var(--accent-green);">${l6.win_rate_pct.toFixed(0)}%</div>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        ${metaBadgeHtml}
                        ${macroBadgeHtml}
                        ${microBadgeHtml}

                        <!-- Trade Execution Plan -->
                        <div style="background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 6px; padding: 10px; margin-bottom: 12px; font-size: 11px;">
                            <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 6px;">
                                <span style="color: var(--text-muted);">Entry Zone:</span>
                                <strong style="color: var(--accent-cyan);">$${p.entry_zone_ideal.toFixed(2)} – $${p.entry_zone_max.toFixed(2)}</strong>
                            </div>
                            <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 6px;">
                                <span style="color: var(--text-muted);">Stop Loss:</span>
                                <strong style="color: var(--accent-red);">$${p.stop_loss.toFixed(2)} (-${p.stop_distance_pct.toFixed(1)}%)</strong>
                            </div>
                            <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 6px;">
                                <span style="color: var(--text-muted);">Blended R:R:</span>
                                <strong style="color: var(--accent-green);">1 : ${p.risk_reward_ratio.toFixed(2)}</strong>
                            </div>
                            <div style="border-top: 1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.08); padding-top: 6px; margin-top: 6px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-secondary);">
                                <span>T1: <strong>$${p.target_1.toFixed(2)}</strong> (40%)</span>
                                <span>T2: <strong>$${p.target_2.toFixed(2)}</strong> (40%)</span>
                                <span>T3: <strong>$${p.target_3.toFixed(2)}</strong> (20%)</span>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <!-- 1% Risk Sizer Scorecard for Active Capital -->
                        <div style="background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.05); border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2); border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 10px; margin-bottom: 12px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; font-size: 11px;">
                            <div>
                                <span style="font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">1% Risk Sizing:</span>
                                <div style="font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; color: #fff;">${dynamicShares} shares</div>
                            </div>
                            <div style="text-align: right; font-size: 10px;">
                                <div>Risk: <strong style="color: var(--accent-amber);">$${dynamicRiskDollars}</strong></div>
                                <div>Value: <strong style="color: var(--accent-cyan);">$${Number(dynamicPosVal).toLocaleString()}</strong></div>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <!-- Action Buttons -->
                        <div style="display: flex; gap: 8px; justify-content: space-between;">
                            <button class="filter-btn" style="flex: 1; font-size: 11px; padding: 5px; cursor: pointer;" onclick="openSymbol('${d.symbol}')">
                                🔍 Dossier
                            </button>
                            <button class="filter-btn" style="flex: 1; font-size: 11px; padding: 5px; cursor: pointer; color: var(--accent-cyan); border-color: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.3);" onclick="copyQuantIntelCard('${d.symbol}')">
                                📋 Copy Card
                            </button>
                            <button class="filter-btn" style="padding: 5px 10px; font-size: 11px; cursor: pointer;" onclick="quickAddCurrentSymbolToWatchlist('${d.symbol}')" title="Add to Watchlist">
                                ★
                            </button>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
            }).join('');
        }

        function copyQuantIntelCard(sym) {
            let cardText = '';
            if (quantIntelBundle && quantIntelBundle.dossiers && quantIntelBundle.dossiers[sym]) {
                cardText = quantIntelBundle.dossiers[sym].formatted_card;
            }
            if (!cardText) {
                alert(`No card found for ${sym}.`);
                return;
            }
            navigator.clipboard.writeText(cardText).then(() => {
                alert(`✓ Copied QUANT INTEL Card for ${sym} to clipboard!`);
            }).catch(e => {
                console.error("Clipboard copy error:", e);
                const ta = document.createElement('textarea');
                ta.value = cardText;
                document.body.appendChild(ta);
                ta.select();
                document.execCommand('copy');
                document.body.removeChild(ta);
                alert(`✓ Copied QUANT INTEL Card for ${sym} to clipboard!`);
            });
        }

        function renderQuantIntelInDrawer(qi, symbol) {
            const container = document.getElementById('drawerQuantIntelSection');
            if (!container) return;
            if (!qi) {
                container.innerHTML = `
                    <div style="background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.6); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px; text-align: center; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 12px;">
                        No QUANT INTEL dossier available for this symbol.
                    </div>
                `;
                return;
            }

            const p = qi.trade_plan;
            const l1 = qi.layer_1_regime;
            const l2 = qi.layer_2_fingerprint;
            const l3 = qi.layer_3_technical;
            const l4 = qi.layer_4_fundamental;
            const l5 = qi.layer_5_sentiment;
            const l6 = qi.layer_6_memory;
            const grade = qi.conviction_grade;

            const gradeColor = grade === 'A' ? 'var(--accent-green)' : (grade === 'B' ? 'var(--accent-cyan)' : (grade === 'C' ? 'var(--accent-amber)' : 'var(--accent-red)'));
            const gradeBg = grade === 'A' ? 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15)' : (grade === 'B' ? 'rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.15)' : (grade === 'C' ? 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15)' : 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15)'));

            container.innerHTML = `
                <div style="background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.8) 0%, rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.95) 100%); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 10px; padding: 18px; margin-bottom: 20px; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);">
                    <!-- Header -->
                    <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); padding-bottom: 12px; margin-bottom: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px;">
                        <div>
                            <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;">
                                <span style="font-size: 14px; font-weight: 800; color: #fff; letter-spacing: 0.5px;">QUANT INTEL™ EXECUTION PLAN</span>
                                <span style="font-size: 11px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: ${gradeBg}; color: ${gradeColor}; font-weight: 800; border: 1px solid ${gradeColor}40;">
                                    ${grade}-GRADE CONVICTION
                                </span>
                                <span style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 600;">
                                    ${qi.aligned_layers_count}/5 Layers Aligned
                                </span>
                            </div>
                            <div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-secondary); margin-top: 3px;">
                                ${l2.archetype_label} · ${l2.dominant_pattern}
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <button class="filter-btn" onclick="copyQuantIntelCard('${symbol}')" style="font-size: 11px; padding: 5px 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.15); color: var(--accent-blue); border-color: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.4); cursor: pointer;" title="Copy Institutional Text Card to Clipboard">
                            📋 Copy Text Card
                        </button>
                    </div>

                    <!-- 6-Layer Signal Status Strip -->
                    <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(130px, 1fr)); gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 16px;">
                        <div style="background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.5); padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);">
                            <div style="font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">L1 Macro Regime</div>
                            <div style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: ${l1.regime_fit === 'YES' ? 'var(--accent-green)' : (l1.regime_fit === 'PARTIAL' ? 'var(--accent-amber)' : 'var(--accent-red)')}; margin-top: 2px;">
                                Fit: ${l1.regime_fit}
                            </div>
                            <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted);">${l1.regime_state}</div>
                        </div>
                        <div style="background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.5); padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);">
                            <div style="font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">L2 Microstructure</div>
                            <div style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--accent-cyan); margin-top: 2px;">
                                H = ${l2.hurst_exponent.toFixed(2)}
                            </div>
                            <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted);">${l2.hurst_class}</div>
                        </div>
                        <div style="background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.5); padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);">
                            <div style="font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">L3 Technical Stack</div>
                            <div style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: ${l3.status === 'BULLISH' ? 'var(--accent-green)' : (l3.status === 'NEUTRAL' ? 'var(--accent-amber)' : 'var(--accent-red)')}; margin-top: 2px;">
                                ${l3.status}
                            </div>
                            <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted);">RSI ${l3.rsi_14.toFixed(1)} · RVOL ${l3.rvol_20.toFixed(1)}x</div>
                        </div>
                        <div style="background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.5); padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);">
                            <div style="font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">L4 Fundamental</div>
                            <div style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: ${l4.score >= 7.0 ? 'var(--accent-green)' : (l4.score >= 5.0 ? 'var(--accent-cyan)' : 'var(--accent-red)')}; margin-top: 2px;">
                                ${l4.score.toFixed(1)} / 10
                            </div>
                            <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted);">${l4.status}</div>
                        </div>

        function renderMicrostructureInDrawer(symbol, metrics, plan, country) {
            const container = document.getElementById('drawerMicrostructureSection');
            if (!container) return;

            const isUS = (country === 'US');
            const currencySym = isUS ? '$' : 'C$';

            if (!metrics) {
                container.innerHTML = `
                    <div style="background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.4); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 6px; padding: 12px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;">
                        <span>Microstructure metrics not currently cached for <strong>${symbol}</strong>.</span>
                        <button class="filter-btn" style="font-size: 10px; padding: 3px 8px;" onclick="document.getElementById('symbolDrawer').classList.remove('open'); document.getElementById('drawerOverlay').style.display='none'; switchTab('microstructure'); selectMicroSymbol('${symbol}');">Open Workstation</button>
                    </div>
                `;
                return;
            }

            const obi = metrics.order_book_imbalance || 0;
            const obiPct = (obi * 100).toFixed(1);
            const obiColor = obi > 0.2 ? 'var(--accent-green)' : (obi < -0.2 ? 'var(--accent-red)' : 'var(--text-secondary)');
            const cvdColor = (metrics.cvd_total >= 0) ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-red)';
            const liqColor = (metrics.liquidity_state === 'NORMAL') ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-amber)';

            container.innerHTML = `
                <div style="background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.5); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 6px; padding: 14px;">
                    <!-- Microstructure KPIs -->
                    <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 12px; font-family: monospace; text-align: center;">
                        <div style="background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); padding: 8px; border-radius: 4px;">
                            <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted);">OBI (Book Imbalance)</div>
                            <div style="font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; color: ${obiColor}; margin-top: 2px;">
                                ${obi > 0 ? '+' : ''}${obiPct}%
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div style="background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); padding: 8px; border-radius: 4px;">
                            <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted);">Session CVD</div>
                            <div style="font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; color: ${cvdColor}; margin-top: 2px;">
                                ${metrics.cvd_total > 0 ? '+' : ''}${metrics.cvd_total.toLocaleString()} sh
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div style="background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); padding: 8px; border-radius: 4px;">
                            <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted);">Kyle's λ (Impact)</div>
                            <div style="font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--accent-cyan); margin-top: 2px;">
                                $${(metrics.kyle_lambda || 0).toFixed(3)}
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div style="background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); padding: 8px; border-radius: 4px;">
                            <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted);">Liquidity State</div>
                            <div style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; color: ${liqColor}; margin-top: 2px;">
                                ${metrics.liquidity_state || 'NORMAL'}
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <!-- TCA Execution Routing Summary -->
                    <div style="background: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.08); border-left: 3px solid var(--accent-cyan); border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0; padding: 10px 12px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; font-size: 11px;">
                        <div>
                            <span style="color: var(--accent-cyan); font-weight: 700;">⚡ Algorithmic Routing:</span>
                            <strong style="color: #fff; margin-left: 4px;">${plan?.tca_execution_strategy || 'VWAP'}</strong>
                            <span style="color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 10px;"> (${plan?.tca_optimal_slices || 1} slice${(plan?.tca_optimal_slices || 1) > 1 ? 's' : ''})</span>
                            <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-secondary); margin-top: 2px;">
                                Est. Fill: <strong style="color: #fff;">${currencySym}${(plan?.tca_effective_fill_price || plan?.entry_zone_ideal || 0).toFixed(2)}</strong> · Slippage: <span style="color: ${(plan?.tca_expected_slippage_bps || 0) > 10 ? 'var(--accent-amber)' : 'var(--accent-green)'};">${(plan?.tca_expected_slippage_bps || 0) > 0 ? '+' : ''}${(plan?.tca_expected_slippage_bps || 0).toFixed(1)} bps</span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <button class="filter-btn" style="font-size: 10px; padding: 4px 10px; color: var(--accent-cyan); border-color: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.4);" onclick="document.getElementById('symbolDrawer').classList.remove('open'); document.getElementById('drawerOverlay').style.display='none'; switchTab('microstructure'); selectMicroSymbol('${symbol}');">
                            Launch DOM Workstation ➔
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;
        }

        // ==========================================
        // BACKTEST LAB ENGINE & INTERACTIVE LEDGER
        // ==========================================
        let backtestBundle = null;
        let selectedStrategyId = 'ENSEMBLE_8F';
        let selectedBenchmarkKey = 'SPY';
        let btCurrentPage = 1;
        let btPageSize = 50;
        let btFilteredTrades = [];
        let backtestLoading = false;

        async function loadBacktestsAndRender() {
            if (backtestBundle) {
                renderBacktestView();
                return;
            }
            if (backtestLoading) return;
            backtestLoading = true;

            const tBody = document.getElementById('backtestTradeBody');
            if (tBody) {
                tBody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="11" style="text-align: center; padding: 36px; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 13px;"><div class="spinner" style="margin-right: 8px;"></div> Loading simulated strategy executions from backtest engine...</td></tr>';
            }

            try {
                backtestBundle = await fetchJson('/api/backtests.json', '/api/backtests');
                renderBacktestView();
            } catch (e) {
                console.error("Backtest load error:", e);
                if (tBody) {
                    tBody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="11" style="text-align: center; padding: 24px; color: var(--accent-red);">Unable to load backtest bundle. <button class="filter-btn" style="margin-left: 10px;" onclick="loadBacktestsAndRender()">Retry</button></td></tr>';
                }
            } finally {
                backtestLoading = false;
            }
        }

        /* =====================================================================
           PHASE 24: CROSS-ASSET MACRO REGIME TRANSITION ENGINE & MARKOV MATRIX
           Hamilton (1989) & López de Prado (2018) Standards
           ===================================================================== */
        let macroRegimeBundle = null;
        let macroRegimeLoading = false;
        let activeMacroMarket = 'US'; // 'US' or 'CA'

        async function loadMacroRegimeAndRender() {
            if (macroRegimeBundle) {
                renderMacroRegimeView();
                return;
            }
            if (macroRegimeLoading) return;
            macroRegimeLoading = true;
            const container = document.getElementById('macroRegimeContainer');
            if (container) {
                container.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align: center; padding: 40px; color: var(--text-muted);"><div class="spinner" style="margin-right: 8px;"></div> Loading Bayesian Markov transition matrices and cross-border macro radar...</div>';
            }
            try {
                macroRegimeBundle = await fetchJson('/api/macro_regime_matrix.json', '/api/macro_regime_matrix');
                renderMacroRegimeView();
            } catch (e) {
                console.error("Macro Regime load error:", e);
                if (container) {
                    container.innerHTML = `<div style="text-align: center; padding: 24px; color: var(--accent-red);">Unable to load macro regime matrix feed. <button class="filter-btn" style="margin-left: 10px;" onclick="loadMacroRegimeAndRender()">Retry</button></div>`;
                }
            } finally {
                macroRegimeLoading = false;
            }
        }

        function setMacroMarket(mkt) {
            activeMacroMarket = mkt;
            document.getElementById('btnMacroUS')?.classList.toggle('active', mkt === 'US');
            document.getElementById('btnMacroCA')?.classList.toggle('active', mkt === 'CA');
            renderMacroRegimeView();
        }

        function renderMacroRegimeView() {
            const container = document.getElementById('macroRegimeContainer');
            if (!container || !macroRegimeBundle) return;

            const mktData = (activeMacroMarket === 'US') ? macroRegimeBundle.us_matrix : macroRegimeBundle.ca_matrix;
            const projections = (activeMacroMarket === 'US') ? macroRegimeBundle.us_forward_projections : macroRegimeBundle.ca_forward_projections;
            const div = macroRegimeBundle.cross_border_divergence;
            const disclaimers = macroRegimeBundle.disclaimers || [];

            // Active State & Hazard KPIs
            const currState = mktData.current_state;
            const currentRow = mktData.rows.find(r => r.from_state === currState) || mktData.rows[0];
            const pStayPct = ((currentRow?.probabilities?.[currState] || 0) * 100).toFixed(1);
            const expDuration = (currentRow?.expected_duration_days || 0).toFixed(1);

            const p1 = projections.find(p => p.horizon_days === 1) || { adverse_hazard_rate: 0, hazard_tier: 'LOW_HAZARD', projected_distribution: {} };
            const p5 = projections.find(p => p.horizon_days === 5) || { adverse_hazard_rate: 0, hazard_tier: 'LOW_HAZARD', projected_distribution: {} };
            const p20 = projections.find(p => p.horizon_days === 20) || { adverse_hazard_rate: 0, hazard_tier: 'LOW_HAZARD', projected_distribution: {} };

            const haz1Pct = (p1.adverse_hazard_rate * 100).toFixed(1);
            const haz5Pct = (p5.adverse_hazard_rate * 100).toFixed(1);
            const haz20Pct = (p20.adverse_hazard_rate * 100).toFixed(1);

            let hazTierColor = 'var(--accent-green)';
            let hazTierBg = 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15)';
            if (p20.hazard_tier === 'ELEVATED_HAZARD' || p20.hazard_tier === 'SEVERE_HAZARD') {
                hazTierColor = 'var(--accent-amber)';
                hazTierBg = 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15)';
            }

            const statBullPct = (((mktData.stationary_distribution?.STRONG_BULL || 0) + (mktData.stationary_distribution?.WEAK_BULL || 0)) * 100).toFixed(1);
            const statBearPct = (((mktData.stationary_distribution?.BEARISH || 0) + (mktData.stationary_distribution?.CRISIS || 0)) * 100).toFixed(1);
            const statConsPct = ((mktData.stationary_distribution?.CONSOLIDATION || 0) * 100).toFixed(1);

            // Regime state list
            const states = mktData.states;

            // Generate Heatmap Rows
            const heatmapRowsHtml = mktData.rows.map(row => {
                const isCurrentRow = (row.from_state === currState);
                const cellsHtml = states.map(toSt => {
                    const prob = row.probabilities[toSt] || 0;
                    const probPct = (prob * 100).toFixed(1);
                    const isDiagonal = (row.from_state === toSt);
                    const isAdverse = ['HIGH_VOLATILITY', 'BEARISH', 'CRISIS'].includes(toSt);

                    // Dynamic chromatic color styling
                    let cellBg = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02)';
                    let cellColor = 'var(--text-secondary)';
                    let cellFontWeight = '400';

                    if (isDiagonal) {
                        cellFontWeight = '700';
                        if (prob >= 0.85) {
                            cellBg = 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.30)';
                            cellColor = '#34d399';
                        } else if (prob >= 0.70) {
                            cellBg = 'rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.25)';
                            cellColor = '#38bdf8';
                        } else {
                            cellBg = 'rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.20)';
                            cellColor = '#93c5fd';
                        }
                    } else if (isAdverse && prob >= 0.05) {
                        cellBg = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.20)';
                        cellColor = '#f87171';
                        cellFontWeight = '600';
                    } else if (prob >= 0.10) {
                        cellBg = 'rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.12)';
                        cellColor = '#cbd5e1';
                    }

                    return `
                        <td style="background: ${cellBg}; color: ${cellColor}; font-weight: ${cellFontWeight}; text-align: center; padding: 10px 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); font-family: monospace; font-size: 12px;" title="${row.from_state} → ${toSt}: ${probPct}%">
                            ${probPct}%
                        </td>
                    `;
                }).join('');
