        /* =====================================================================
           PHASE 25: REAL-TIME TICK MICROSTRUCTURE & DEPTH OF MARKET (DOM) PIPELINE
           Lee-Ready (1991), Order Book Imbalance, CVD, Kyle's Lambda
           ===================================================================== */
        let microstructureBundle = null;
        let microstructureLoading = false;
        let activeMicroSymbol = 'SPY';
        let microWebSocket = null;
        let microEventSource = null;
        let microStreamActive = true;
        let microPollInterval = null;

        // Phase 25.3: Algorithmic Execution Simulator & TCA State
        let tcaSimShares = 500;
        let tcaSimSide = 'BUY';
        let tcaSelectedStrategy = 'ALL';

        function setTcaShares(n) {
            tcaSimShares = parseInt(n) || 100;
            renderMicrostructureView();
        }

        function setTcaSide(side) {
            tcaSimSide = side;
            renderMicrostructureView();
        }

        function setTcaStrategy(strat) {
            tcaSelectedStrategy = strat;
            renderMicrostructureView();
        }

        function calculateTcaInBrowser(dossier, shares, side) {
            const isUS = (dossier.country === 'US');
            const currencySym = isUS ? '$' : 'C$';
            const book = dossier.order_book;
            const metrics = dossier.metrics;
            const arrivalPrice = book.mid_price;
            const spreadDollars = book.spread_dollars;
            const kLambda = metrics.kyle_lambda || 0.015;
            const obi = metrics.order_book_imbalance || 0.0;

            const takerFeePerSh = isUS ? 0.0030 + 0.000166 : 0.0016 + 0.000150;
            const makerRebatePerSh = isUS ? -0.0020 + 0.000166 : -0.0009 + 0.000150;

            // 1. Direct Market Order
            const levels = (side === 'BUY') ? book.asks : book.bids;
            let remaining = shares;
            let filledCost = 0;
            let directSlices = [];
            let sliceIdx = 1;

            for (let i = 0; i < levels.length; i++) {
                if (remaining <= 0) break;
                const lvl = levels[i];
                const fillQty = Math.min(remaining, lvl.size);
                const impactBps = Math.abs(lvl.price - arrivalPrice) / arrivalPrice * 10000;
                directSlices.push({
                    slice_idx: sliceIdx++,
                    offset_sec: 0,
                    shares: fillQty,
                    price: lvl.price,
                    impact_bps: impactBps,
                    fee: fillQty * takerFeePerSh
                });
                filledCost += fillQty * lvl.price;
                remaining -= fillQty;
            }
            if (remaining > 0) {
                const lastPrice = levels[levels.length - 1].price;
                const residualImpact = (remaining / 10000) * kLambda;
                const penaltyPrice = (side === 'BUY') ? (lastPrice + residualImpact) : Math.max(0.01, lastPrice - residualImpact);
                const impactBps = Math.abs(penaltyPrice - arrivalPrice) / arrivalPrice * 10000;
                directSlices.push({
                    slice_idx: sliceIdx++,
                    offset_sec: 1,
                    shares: remaining,
                    price: penaltyPrice,
                    impact_bps: impactBps,
                    fee: remaining * takerFeePerSh
                });
                filledCost += remaining * penaltyPrice;
                remaining = 0;
            }
            const directEffPrice = filledCost / Math.max(1, shares);
            const directSlipPerSh = (side === 'BUY') ? (directEffPrice - arrivalPrice) : (arrivalPrice - directEffPrice);
            const directSlipBps = (directSlipPerSh / arrivalPrice) * 10000;
            const directFee = shares * takerFeePerSh;
            const directTotalCost = (Math.abs(directSlipPerSh) * shares) + directFee;

            // 2. Limit Passive Order
            const postedPrice = (side === 'BUY') ? book.bids[0].price : book.asks[0].price;
            const topDepth = (side === 'BUY') ? book.bids[0].size : book.asks[0].size;
            const logit = 1.2 + (obi * 1.5) - (0.8 * (shares / Math.max(100, topDepth)));
            const limitFillProb = Math.min(92, Math.max(25, Math.round((1.0 / (1.0 + Math.exp(-logit))) * 1000) / 10));
            const advFactor = ((side === 'BUY' && obi < -0.2) || (side === 'SELL' && obi > 0.2)) ? 0.35 : 0.15;
            const adverseImpact = (kLambda * 0.25) * advFactor;
            const limitEffPrice = postedPrice + ((side === 'BUY') ? adverseImpact : -adverseImpact);
            const limitSlipPerSh = (side === 'BUY') ? (limitEffPrice - arrivalPrice) : (arrivalPrice - limitEffPrice);
            const limitSlipBps = (limitSlipPerSh / arrivalPrice) * 10000;
            const limitFee = shares * makerRebatePerSh;
            const limitTotalCost = (limitSlipPerSh * shares) + limitFee;

            // 3. TWAP (5 Slices)
            const twapNumSlices = 5;
            const twapSliceQty = Math.floor(shares / twapNumSlices);
            const twapRem = shares % twapNumSlices;
            const twapReduction = 1.0 / Math.pow(twapNumSlices, 0.55);
            let twapCost = 0;
            let twapFee = 0;
            let twapSlices = [];
            for (let i = 0; i < twapNumSlices; i++) {
                const sQty = twapSliceQty + (i < twapRem ? 1 : 0);
                const sImpact = (sQty / 10000) * kLambda * twapReduction;
                const sSpread = (spreadDollars / 2) * 0.7;
                const sPrice = (side === 'BUY') ? (arrivalPrice + sSpread + sImpact) : Math.max(0.01, arrivalPrice - sSpread - sImpact);
                const isMaker = (i % 2 === 1);
                const sFee = sQty * (isMaker ? makerRebatePerSh : takerFeePerSh);
                twapCost += sQty * sPrice;
                twapFee += sFee;
                twapSlices.push({
                    slice_idx: i + 1,
                    offset_sec: i * 180,
                    shares: sQty,
                    price: sPrice,
                    impact_bps: Math.abs(sPrice - arrivalPrice) / arrivalPrice * 10000,
                    fee: sFee
                });
            }
            const twapEffPrice = twapCost / shares;
            const twapSlipPerSh = (side === 'BUY') ? (twapEffPrice - arrivalPrice) : (arrivalPrice - twapEffPrice);
            const twapSlipBps = (twapSlipPerSh / arrivalPrice) * 10000;
            const twapTotalCost = (twapSlipPerSh * shares) + twapFee;

            // 4. VWAP (5 U-curve Slices)
            const vwapWeights = [0.28, 0.16, 0.12, 0.16, 0.28];
            let vwapSliceShares = vwapWeights.map(w => Math.round(shares * w));
            const vwapDiff = shares - vwapSliceShares.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
            vwapSliceShares[0] += vwapDiff;
            const vwapReduction = (1.0 / Math.pow(5, 0.62)) * 0.85;
            let vwapCost = 0;
            let vwapFee = 0;
            let vwapSlices = [];
            for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
                const sQty = vwapSliceShares[i];
                const sImpact = (sQty / 10000) * kLambda * vwapReduction * (1.0 / Math.sqrt(Math.max(0.01, vwapWeights[i] * 3.5)));
                const sSpread = (spreadDollars / 2) * 0.6;
                const sPrice = (side === 'BUY') ? (arrivalPrice + sSpread + sImpact) : Math.max(0.01, arrivalPrice - sSpread - sImpact);
                const isMaker = (i === 1 || i === 2 || i === 3);
                const sFee = sQty * (isMaker ? makerRebatePerSh : takerFeePerSh);
                vwapCost += sQty * sPrice;
                vwapFee += sFee;
                vwapSlices.push({
                    slice_idx: i + 1,
                    offset_sec: i * 360,
                    shares: sQty,
                    price: sPrice,
                    impact_bps: Math.abs(sPrice - arrivalPrice) / arrivalPrice * 10000,
                    fee: sFee
                });
            }
            const vwapEffPrice = vwapCost / shares;
            const vwapSlipPerSh = (side === 'BUY') ? (vwapEffPrice - arrivalPrice) : (arrivalPrice - vwapEffPrice);
            const vwapSlipBps = (vwapSlipPerSh / arrivalPrice) * 10000;
            const vwapTotalCost = (vwapSlipPerSh * shares) + vwapFee;

            // 5. POV 10% (Iceberg)
            const totalAskDepth = book.asks.reduce((a, b) => a + b.size, 0);
            const estMinVol = Math.max(500, totalAskDepth * 2);
            const povSliceSize = Math.max(25, Math.floor(estMinVol * 0.10));
            let povSliceShares = [];
            if (povSliceSize >= shares) {
                const nSl = (shares >= 50) ? Math.max(2, Math.min(4, Math.floor(shares / 25))) : 1;
                povSliceShares = Array(nSl).fill(Math.floor(shares / nSl));
                for (let i = 0; i < (shares % nSl); i++) povSliceShares[i]++;
            } else {
                const nFull = Math.floor(shares / povSliceSize);
                const rem = shares % povSliceSize;
                povSliceShares = Array(nFull).fill(povSliceSize);
                if (rem > 0) povSliceShares.push(rem);
            }
            let povCost = 0;
            let povFee = 0;
            let povSlices = [];
            for (let i = 0; i < povSliceShares.length; i++) {
                const sQty = povSliceShares[i];
                const sImpact = (sQty / 10000) * kLambda * 0.45;
                const sSpread = (spreadDollars / 2) * 0.5;
                const sPrice = (side === 'BUY') ? (arrivalPrice + sSpread + sImpact) : Math.max(0.01, arrivalPrice - sSpread - sImpact);
                const sFee = sQty * makerRebatePerSh; // Icebergs rest as makers
                povCost += sQty * sPrice;
                povFee += sFee;
                povSlices.push({
                    slice_idx: i + 1,
                    offset_sec: i * 60,
                    shares: sQty,
                    price: sPrice,
                    impact_bps: Math.abs(sPrice - arrivalPrice) / arrivalPrice * 10000,
                    fee: sFee
                });
            }
            const povEffPrice = povCost / shares;
            const povSlipPerSh = (side === 'BUY') ? (povEffPrice - arrivalPrice) : (arrivalPrice - povEffPrice);
            const povSlipBps = (povSlipPerSh / arrivalPrice) * 10000;
            const povTotalCost = (povSlipPerSh * shares) + povFee;

            // Recommendation Logic
            let recStrat = 'TWAP';
            let rationale = 'Moderate order size; uniform TWAP time-slicing stabilizes execution price across time intervals.';
            if (metrics.liquidity_state === 'LIQUIDITY_VOID' || metrics.liquidity_state === 'SPREAD_EXPANSION') {
                recStrat = (shares > 300) ? 'POV_10' : 'LIMIT_PASSIVE';
                rationale = 'Liquidity void or spread expansion detected; passive execution mandatory to avoid sweeping empty books.';
            } else if (shares <= (side === 'BUY' ? book.asks[0].size : book.bids[0].size) * 0.4) {
                recStrat = 'DIRECT_MARKET';
                rationale = 'Order size is less than 40% of top-of-book depth; immediate direct execution incurs minimal impact.';
            } else if (shares > 1000 || shares > totalAskDepth * 0.5) {
                recStrat = 'VWAP';
                rationale = 'Large order relative to visible book depth; VWAP volume curve slicing optimizes Kyle\'s lambda impact.';
            } else if (Math.abs(obi) > 0.4 && ((side === 'BUY' && obi > 0) || (side === 'SELL' && obi < 0))) {
                recStrat = 'LIMIT_PASSIVE';
                rationale = 'Favorable order book imbalance allows passive queue posting to earn maker rebates.';
            }

            const strats = {
                DIRECT_MARKET: { key: 'DIRECT_MARKET', name: 'DIRECT MARKET', desc: 'Aggressive DOM Sweep', type: 'TAKER', effPrice: directEffPrice, slipBps: directSlipBps, slipPerSh: directSlipPerSh, fee: directFee, totalCost: directTotalCost, fillProb: 99.9, slices: directSlices },
                LIMIT_PASSIVE: { key: 'LIMIT_PASSIVE', name: 'LIMIT PASSIVE', desc: 'Resting BBO Limit', type: 'MAKER', effPrice: limitEffPrice, slipBps: limitSlipBps, slipPerSh: limitSlipPerSh, fee: limitFee, totalCost: limitTotalCost, fillProb: limitFillProb, slices: [{ slice_idx: 1, offset_sec: 0, shares: shares, price: limitEffPrice, impact_bps: limitSlipBps, fee: limitFee }] },
                TWAP: { key: 'TWAP', name: 'TWAP', desc: 'Uniform Time-Slicing', type: 'MIXED', effPrice: twapEffPrice, slipBps: twapSlipBps, slipPerSh: twapSlipPerSh, fee: twapFee, totalCost: twapTotalCost, fillProb: 95.0, slices: twapSlices },
                VWAP: { key: 'VWAP', name: 'VWAP', desc: 'Intraday Volume Curve', type: 'MIXED', effPrice: vwapEffPrice, slipBps: vwapSlipBps, slipPerSh: vwapSlipPerSh, fee: vwapFee, totalCost: vwapTotalCost, fillProb: 96.5, slices: vwapSlices },
                POV_10: { key: 'POV_10', name: 'POV 10%', desc: 'Dynamic Iceberg', type: 'MAKER', effPrice: povEffPrice, slipBps: povSlipBps, slipPerSh: povSlipPerSh, fee: povFee, totalCost: povTotalCost, fillProb: 91.0, slices: povSlices }
            };

            return {
                arrivalPrice,
                currencySym,
                recommendedStrategy: recStrat,
                rationale,
                strategies: strats
            };
        }

        async function loadMicrostructureAndRender() {
            if (microstructureBundle) {
                renderMicrostructureView();
                startMicroStreaming();
                return;
            }
            if (microstructureLoading) return;
            microstructureLoading = true;
            const container = document.getElementById('microstructureContainer');
            if (container) {
                container.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align: center; padding: 40px; color: var(--text-muted);"><div class="spinner" style="margin-right: 8px;"></div> Loading dual-market order book snapshots and tick streams...</div>';
            }
            try {
                microstructureBundle = await fetchJson('/api/microstructure_snapshot.json', '/api/microstructure_snapshot');
                renderMicrostructureView();
                startMicroStreaming();
            } catch (e) {
                console.error("Microstructure feed load error:", e);
                if (container) {
                    container.innerHTML = `<div style="text-align: center; padding: 24px; color: var(--accent-red);">Unable to load microstructure feed. <button class="filter-btn" style="margin-left: 10px;" onclick="loadMicrostructureAndRender()">Retry</button></div>`;
                }
            } finally {
                microstructureLoading = false;
            }
        }

        function selectMicroSymbol(sym) {
            activeMicroSymbol = sym;
            document.querySelectorAll('[id^="chip-"]').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
            document.getElementById(`chip-${sym}`)?.classList.add('active');
            renderMicrostructureView();
            if (microWebSocket && microWebSocket.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
                microWebSocket.send(JSON.stringify({ action: "subscribe", symbols: [sym], channels: ["ticks", "book", "metrics"] }));
            } else if (microStreamActive) {
                startMicroStreaming();
            }
        }

        function toggleMicroStreaming() {
            microStreamActive = !microStreamActive;
            const btn = document.getElementById('btnToggleStream');
            const badge = document.getElementById('microConnBadge');
            if (microStreamActive) {
                if (btn) btn.innerText = 'Pause';
                if (badge) {
                    badge.innerHTML = '<span style="display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; background: var(--accent-green); border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent-green);"></span> LIVE STREAMING';
                    badge.style.color = 'var(--accent-green)';
                }
                startMicroStreaming();
            } else {
                if (btn) btn.innerText = 'Resume';
                if (badge) {
                    badge.innerHTML = '<span style="display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; background: var(--accent-amber); border-radius: 50%;"></span> PAUSED';
                    badge.style.color = 'var(--accent-amber)';
                }
                stopMicroStreaming();
            }
        }

        function stopMicroStreaming() {
            if (microWebSocket) {
                try { microWebSocket.close(); } catch(e) {}
                microWebSocket = null;
            }
            if (microEventSource) {
                try { microEventSource.close(); } catch(e) {}
                microEventSource = null;
            }
            if (microPollInterval) {
                clearInterval(microPollInterval);
                microPollInterval = null;
            }
        }

        function startMicroStreaming() {
            stopMicroStreaming();
            if (!microStreamActive) return;

            const badge = document.getElementById('microConnBadge');

            // 1. Try Native WebSocket first (Port 8001 / ws protocol)
            if (typeof WebSocket !== 'undefined' && location.protocol !== 'https:') {
                try {
                    const wsHost = location.hostname || 'localhost';
                    microWebSocket = new WebSocket(`ws://${wsHost}:8001/ws/microstructure`);
                    microWebSocket.onopen = () => {
                        if (badge) {
                            badge.innerHTML = '<span style="display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; background: var(--accent-green); border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent-green);"></span> LIVE WS (8001)';
                            badge.style.color = 'var(--accent-green)';
                        }
                        microWebSocket.send(JSON.stringify({
                            action: 'subscribe',
                            symbols: [activeMicroSymbol],
                            channels: ['ticks', 'book', 'metrics']
                        }));
                    };

                    microWebSocket.onmessage = (ev) => {
                        try {
                            const data = JSON.parse(ev.data);
                            if (data.type === 'MICROSTRUCTURE_BURST' && data.events) {
                                for (const evt of data.events) {
                                    if (evt.symbol === activeMicroSymbol && microstructureBundle?.symbols?.[activeMicroSymbol]) {
                                        const dossier = microstructureBundle.symbols[activeMicroSymbol];
                                        if (evt.order_book) dossier.order_book = evt.order_book;
                                        if (evt.metrics) dossier.metrics = evt.metrics;
                                        if (evt.tick) {
                                            dossier.last_price = evt.tick.price;
                                            dossier.recent_ticks.unshift(evt.tick);
                                            if (dossier.recent_ticks.length > 40) dossier.recent_ticks.pop();
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                                updateLiveMicroUI();
                            }
                        } catch (e) {}
                    };

                    microWebSocket.onerror = () => {
                        // Fallback to SSE
                        if (microWebSocket) {
                            try { microWebSocket.close(); } catch(e) {}
                            microWebSocket = null;
                        }
                        startSseStreaming();
                    };
                    return;
                } catch (e) {
                    // Fall back to SSE
                }
            }

            // 2. Fallback to Server-Sent Events (SSE)
            startSseStreaming();
        }

        function startSseStreaming() {
            const badge = document.getElementById('microConnBadge');
            if (typeof EventSource !== 'undefined') {
                try {
                    microEventSource = new EventSource(`/api/stream/ticks?symbol=${activeMicroSymbol}`);
                    microEventSource.onopen = () => {
                        if (badge) {
                            badge.innerHTML = '<span style="display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; background: var(--accent-green); border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent-green);"></span> LIVE SSE (2Hz)';
                            badge.style.color = 'var(--accent-green)';
                        }
                    };

                    microEventSource.addEventListener('snapshot', (ev) => {
                        try {
                            const data = JSON.parse(ev.data);
                            if (microstructureBundle && microstructureBundle.symbols && data.symbol === activeMicroSymbol) {
                                microstructureBundle.symbols[activeMicroSymbol].order_book = data.order_book;
                                microstructureBundle.symbols[activeMicroSymbol].metrics = data.metrics;
                                updateLiveMicroUI();
                            }
                        } catch (e) {}
                    });

                    microEventSource.addEventListener('tick', (ev) => {
                        try {
                            const data = JSON.parse(ev.data);
                            if (microstructureBundle && microstructureBundle.symbols && data.symbol === activeMicroSymbol) {
                                const dossier = microstructureBundle.symbols[activeMicroSymbol];
                                if (data.order_book) dossier.order_book = data.order_book;
                                if (data.metrics) dossier.metrics = data.metrics;
                                if (data.tick) {
                                    dossier.last_price = data.tick.price;
                                    dossier.recent_ticks.unshift(data.tick);
                                    if (dossier.recent_ticks.length > 40) dossier.recent_ticks.pop();
                                }
                                updateLiveMicroUI();
                            }
                        } catch (e) {}
                    });

                    microEventSource.onerror = () => {
                        stopMicroStreaming();
                        startMicroPolling();
                    };
                    return;
                } catch (e) {}
            }
            startMicroPolling();
        }

        function startMicroPolling() {
            const badge = document.getElementById('microConnBadge');
            if (badge) {
                badge.innerHTML = '<span style="display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; background: var(--accent-amber); border-radius: 50%;"></span> BUFFERED POLLING';
                badge.style.color = 'var(--accent-amber)';
            }
            if (microPollInterval) clearInterval(microPollInterval);
            microPollInterval = setInterval(async () => {
                if (!microStreamActive) return;
                try {
                    const fresh = await fetchJson('/api/microstructure_snapshot.json', '/api/microstructure_snapshot');
                    if (fresh && fresh.symbols) {
                        microstructureBundle = fresh;
                        updateLiveMicroUI();
                    }
                } catch (e) {}
            }, 2500);
        }

        function updateLiveMicroUI() {
            const container = document.getElementById('microstructureContainer');
            if (!container || !microstructureBundle || !microstructureBundle.symbols) return;
            renderMicrostructureView();
        }

        function renderMicrostructureView() {
            const container = document.getElementById('microstructureContainer');
            if (!container || !microstructureBundle || !microstructureBundle.symbols) return;

            const dossier = microstructureBundle.symbols[activeMicroSymbol] || Object.values(microstructureBundle.symbols)[0];
            const book = dossier.order_book;
            const metrics = dossier.metrics;
            const ticks = dossier.recent_ticks || [];
            const disclaimers = microstructureBundle.disclaimers || [];

            const isUS = (dossier.country === 'US');
            const currencySym = isUS ? '$' : 'C$';

            // Top KPIs
            const bestBid = book.bids[0]?.price || 0;
            const bestAsk = book.asks[0]?.price || 0;
            const spread = book.spread_dollars.toFixed(2);
            const spreadBps = book.spread_bps.toFixed(1);
            const midPrice = book.mid_price.toFixed(2);
            const microPrice = book.microprice.toFixed(3);
            const obi = metrics.order_book_imbalance;
            const obiPct = (obi * 100).toFixed(1);

            let obiColor = 'var(--text-secondary)';
            let obiLabel = 'NEUTRAL EQUILIBRIUM';
            if (obi > 0.20) {
                obiColor = 'var(--accent-green)';
                obiLabel = 'BUYER REPLENISHMENT';
            } else if (obi < -0.20) {
                obiColor = 'var(--accent-red)';
                obiLabel = 'ASK-SIDE WALL';
            }

            let liqColor = 'var(--accent-green)';
            let liqBg = 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15)';
            if (metrics.liquidity_state === 'LIQUIDITY_VOID') {
                liqColor = 'var(--accent-red)';
                liqBg = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15)';
            } else if (metrics.liquidity_state === 'SPREAD_EXPANSION') {
                liqColor = 'var(--accent-amber)';
                liqBg = 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15)';
            }

            let absColor = 'var(--text-secondary)';
            let absBg = 'rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.1)';
            if (metrics.absorption_signal === 'BULLISH_ABSORPTION') {
                absColor = 'var(--accent-green)';
                absBg = 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15)';
            } else if (metrics.absorption_signal === 'BEARISH_EXHAUSTION') {
                absColor = 'var(--accent-red)';
                absBg = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15)';
            }

            // Max size for relative DOM bars
            const maxSize = Math.max(
                ...book.bids.map(b => b.size),
                ...book.asks.map(a => a.size),
                1000
            );

            // DOM Asks (Reverse so highest ask is at top)
            const asksReversed = [...book.asks].reverse();
            const asksHtml = asksReversed.map(a => {
                const widthPct = Math.min(100, Math.round((a.size / maxSize) * 100));
                return `
                    <tr style="position: relative; font-size: 11px; font-family: monospace;">
                        <td style="padding: 4px 8px; color: var(--text-muted); width: 35px;">L${a.depth_tier}</td>
                        <td style="padding: 4px 8px; color: #f87171; font-weight: 700; width: 75px;">${currencySym}${a.price.toFixed(2)}</td>
                        <td style="padding: 4px 8px; text-align: right; color: #e2e8f0; width: 80px;">${a.size.toLocaleString()}</td>
                        <td style="padding: 4px 8px; width: 140px;">
                            <div style="height: 6px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-radius: 3px; overflow: hidden;">
                                <div style="height: 100%; width: ${widthPct}%; background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.7); border-radius: 3px;"></div>
                            </div>
                        </td>
                    </tr>
                `;
            }).join('');

            // DOM Bids
            const bidsHtml = book.bids.map(b => {
                const widthPct = Math.min(100, Math.round((b.size / maxSize) * 100));
                return `
                    <tr style="position: relative; font-size: 11px; font-family: monospace;">
                        <td style="padding: 4px 8px; color: var(--text-muted); width: 35px;">L${b.depth_tier}</td>
                        <td style="padding: 4px 8px; color: #34d399; font-weight: 700; width: 75px;">${currencySym}${b.price.toFixed(2)}</td>
                        <td style="padding: 4px 8px; text-align: right; color: #e2e8f0; width: 80px;">${b.size.toLocaleString()}</td>
                        <td style="padding: 4px 8px; width: 140px;">
                            <div style="height: 6px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-radius: 3px; overflow: hidden;">
                                <div style="height: 100%; width: ${widthPct}%; background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.7); border-radius: 3px;"></div>
                            </div>
                        </td>
                    </tr>
                `;
            }).join('');

            // Ticks Tape HTML
            const ticksHtml = ticks.slice(0, 25).map(t => {
                const isBuy = (t.aggressor_side === 'BUY_AGGRESSOR');
                const sideCol = isBuy ? '#34d399' : '#f87171';
                const timeStr = t.timestamp.split('T')[1]?.replace('Z', '') || t.timestamp;
                const isBlock = t.volume >= 1000;
                return `
                    <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 4px 8px; font-size: 11px; font-family: monospace; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04); background: ${isBlock ? 'rgba(234, 179, 8, 0.08)' : 'transparent'};">
                        <span style="color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 10px;">${timeStr}</span>
                        <span style="color: ${sideCol}; font-weight: 700;">${currencySym}${t.price.toFixed(2)}</span>
                        <span style="color: #f1f5f9; text-align: right;">${t.volume.toLocaleString()} sh</span>
                        <span style="font-size: 9px; padding: 1px 4px; border-radius: 3px; background: ${sideCol}20; color: ${sideCol};">
                            ${isBuy ? 'LIFT ASK' : 'HIT BID'}
                        </span>
                    </div>
                `;
            }).join('');

            container.innerHTML = `
                <!-- 1. Top KPI Summary Grid -->
                <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr)); gap: 14px; margin-bottom: 20px;">
                    <!-- Card 1: Active Symbol & Spread -->
                    <div class="kpi-card" style="background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px;">
                        <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 4px;">
                            <span style="font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">Active Symbol (${dossier.exchange})</span>
                            <span class="exchange-tag" style="font-size: 10px;">${dossier.country}</span>

'<span style="background: rgba(6,182,212,0.25); color: var(--accent-cyan); font-size: 9px; font-weight: 800; padding: 3px 6px; border-radius: 4px;">★ OPTIMAL</span>' : '<button class="filter-btn" style="padding: 2px 6px; font-size: 9px;" onclick="setTcaStrategy(\'' + s.key + '\')">Select</button>'}

Execution prices in live trading venues will diverge due to hidden liquidity, market latency, order queue priority, and fluctuating cancellation rates.

        // =========================================================================
        // PHASE 26 & 27: HIERARCHICAL RISK PARITY (HRP) & MULTI-ASSET FACTOR LAB

        let activeHrpSection = 'weights'; // 'weights', 'bayesian', 'factors', 'stress', 'orchestrator', 'tree'

        async function loadPortfolioHrpAndRender() {
            if (portfolioHrpBundle && portfolioStressBundle && portfolioOrchestratorBundle && factorRiskBundle && factorAttribBundle && portfolioBayesianBundle) {
                renderPortfolioHrpView();
                return;
            }
            if (portfolioHrpLoading) return;
            portfolioHrpLoading = true;
            const container = document.getElementById('portfolioHrpContainer');
            if (container) {
                container.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align: center; padding: 40px; color: var(--text-muted);"><div class="spinner" style="margin-right: 8px;"></div> Loading Hierarchical Risk Parity, Black-Litterman Bayesian rebalancing, and stress matrices...</div>';
            }
            try {
                const [hrpRes, stressRes, orchRes, factorRiskRes, factorAttribRes, bayesianRes] = await Promise.all([
                    fetchJson('/api/portfolio_hrp.json', '/api/portfolio_hrp'),
                    fetchJson('/api/portfolio_stress.json', '/api/portfolio_stress'),
                    fetchJson('/api/portfolio_orchestration.json', '/api/portfolio_orchestration'),
                    fetchJson('/api/factor_risk.json', '/api/factor_risk'),
                    fetchJson('/api/factor_attribution.json', '/api/factor_attribution'),
                    fetchJson('/api/portfolio_bayesian.json', '/api/portfolio_bayesian')
                ]);
                portfolioHrpBundle = hrpRes;
                portfolioStressBundle = stressRes;
                portfolioOrchestratorBundle = orchRes;
                factorRiskBundle = factorRiskRes;
                factorAttribBundle = factorAttribRes;
                portfolioBayesianBundle = bayesianRes;
                renderPortfolioHrpView();
            } catch (e) {
                console.error("Portfolio HRP / Factor / Bayesian load error:", e);
                if (container) {
                    container.innerHTML = `<div style="text-align: center; padding: 24px; color: var(--accent-red);">Unable to load Portfolio Risk, Factor & Bayesian feeds. <button class="filter-btn" style="margin-left: 10px;" onclick="loadPortfolioHrpAndRender()">Retry</button></div>`;
                }
            } finally {
                portfolioHrpLoading = false;
            }
        }

        function refreshPortfolioHrpData() {
            portfolioHrpBundle = null;
            portfolioStressBundle = null;
            portfolioOrchestratorBundle = null;
            factorRiskBundle = null;
            factorAttribBundle = null;
            portfolioBayesianBundle = null;
            loadPortfolioHrpAndRender();
        }

        function setPortfolioCapital(cap) {
            activePortfolioCapital = cap;
            document.querySelectorAll('[id^="btnHrpCap"]').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
            if (cap === 50000) document.getElementById('btnHrpCap50k')?.classList.add('active');
            else if (cap === 100000) document.getElementById('btnHrpCap100k')?.classList.add('active');
            else if (cap === 250000) document.getElementById('btnHrpCap250k')?.classList.add('active');
            renderPortfolioHrpView();
        }

        function selectStressScenario(scenarioId) {
            activeStressScenarioId = scenarioId;
            renderPortfolioHrpView();
        }

        function setAttribBenchmark(bm) {
            activeAttribBenchmark = bm;
            renderPortfolioHrpView();
        }

        function setHrpSection(section) {
            activeHrpSection = section;
            renderPortfolioHrpView();
        }

        function quickLaunchTcaFromHrp(symbol, shares) {
            switchTab('microstructure');
            selectMicroSymbol(symbol);
            setTimeout(() => {
                const inputShares = document.getElementById('tcaSimShares');
                if (inputShares) {
                    inputShares.value = shares;
                    inputShares.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
                }
            }, 300);
        }

        function renderPortfolioHrpView() {
            const container = document.getElementById('portfolioHrpContainer');
            if (!container || !portfolioHrpBundle || !portfolioStressBundle || !portfolioOrchestratorBundle) return;

            const hrp = portfolioHrpBundle;
            const stress = portfolioStressBundle;
            const orch = portfolioOrchestratorBundle;

            const capScale = activePortfolioCapital / 100000.0;
            const hrpVol = (hrp.portfolio_volatility_annualized * 100).toFixed(2);
            const ewVol = (hrp.benchmark_comparisons?.EQUAL_WEIGHT?.portfolio_volatility_annualized * 100 || 16.10).toFixed(2);
            const volReduction = (hrp.benchmark_comparisons?.EQUAL_WEIGHT?.vol_reduction_pct || 22.5).toFixed(1);

            const var1dPct = Math.abs(stress.var_95_1d_pct).toFixed(2);
            const var1dDollars = Math.round(Math.abs(stress.var_95_1d_dollars) * capScale);
            const cvar1dPct = Math.abs(stress.cvar_99_1d_pct).toFixed(2);
            const cvar1dDollars = Math.round(Math.abs(stress.cvar_99_1d_dollars) * capScale);

            const var10dPct = Math.abs(stress.var_95_10d_pct).toFixed(2);
            const var10dDollars = Math.round(Math.abs(stress.var_95_10d_dollars) * capScale);
            const cvar10dPct = Math.abs(stress.cvar_99_10d_pct).toFixed(2);
            const cvar10dDollars = Math.round(Math.abs(stress.cvar_99_10d_dollars) * capScale);

            const deployedDollars = Math.round(orch.deployed_pct / 100.0 * activePortfolioCapital);
            const cashReserveDollars = Math.round(orch.cash_reserve_pct / 100.0 * activePortfolioCapital);

            // Calculate crisis alpha in 2022 rate shock and 2008 GFC
            const gfcScenario = stress.scenarios?.['2008_GFC'] || {};
            const rateShockScenario = stress.scenarios?.['2022_RATE_SHOCK'] || {};
            const tariffScenario = stress.scenarios?.['2026_STAGFLATION_TARIFF'] || {};

            const ratePreserved = Math.round((rateShockScenario.capital_preservation_delta || 5711.51) * capScale);
            const gfcPreserved = Math.round((gfcScenario.capital_preservation_delta || 2751.49) * capScale);
            const tariffPreserved = Math.round((tariffScenario.capital_preservation_delta || 1831.36) * capScale);

            // Sentinel check
            const alerts = orch.portfolio_alerts || [];

                        </div>

                    <!-- Card 2: 1-Day Tail Risk -->

                    const weightPct = (a.weight * 100).toFixed(2);
                    const dollarVal = Math.round(a.weight * activePortfolioCapital);
                    const volPct = (a.volatility_annualized * 100).toFixed(1);
                    const riskShare = a.risk_share_pct.toFixed(2);
                    const mcr = a.marginal_risk_contribution.toFixed(3);
                    const ewWeight = (100.0 / allocations.length).toFixed(2);

                    return `
                        <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); font-size: 12px;">
                            <td style="padding: 10px 12px;">
                                <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;">
                                    <span style="font-size: 14px;">${meta.flag}</span>
                                    <div>
                                        <div style="font-weight: 700; color: #fff;">${a.symbol}</div>

                                </div>

                                </div>
                            </td>
                            <td style="padding: 10px 12px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace; color: var(--text-muted);">${ewWeight}%</td>
                            <td style="padding: 10px 12px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace; color: #fff;">$${dollarVal.toLocaleString()}</td>
                            <td style="padding: 10px 12px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace; color: var(--accent-cyan);">${riskShare}%</td>
                            <td style="padding: 10px 12px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace; color: var(--text-secondary);">${mcr}</td>
                        </tr>

                                <span class="exchange-tag" style="background: rgba(156, 163, 175, 0.15); color: var(--text-secondary); border-color: rgba(156, 163, 175, 0.3);">EW VOL: ${ewVol}%</span>
                            </div>

                        <div style="overflow-x: auto;">
                            <table style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse;">
                                <thead>
                                    <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color); color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase;">
                                        <th style="padding: 8px 12px; text-align: left;">Asset / Company</th>
                                        <th style="padding: 8px 12px; text-align: left;">Sector</th>
                                        <th style="padding: 8px 12px; text-align: right;">Realized Vol</th>
                                        <th style="padding: 8px 12px; text-align: right;">HRP Weight</th>
                                        <th style="padding: 8px 12px; text-align: right;">EW Weight</th>
                                        <th style="padding: 8px 12px; text-align: right;">Target Capital</th>
                                        <th style="padding: 8px 12px; text-align: right;">Euler Risk Share</th>
                                        <th style="padding: 8px 12px; text-align: right;">MCR (Marginal)</th>
                                    </tr>
                                </thead>
                                <tbody>
                                    ${rowsHtml}

            } else if (activeHrpSection === 'bayesian') {
                // Section: Black-Litterman Bayesian View Blending & Turnover-Constrained Rebalancer
                const bayes = portfolioBayesianBundle || {};
                const views = bayes.views || [];
                const allocations = Object.values(bayes.allocations || {});
                allocations.sort((a, b) => b.constrained_weight - a.constrained_weight);
                const frontier = bayes.turnover_frontier || [];

                const priorRet = (bayes.prior_portfolio_return_pct !== undefined ? bayes.prior_portfolio_return_pct : 3.89).toFixed(2);
                const postRet = (bayes.posterior_portfolio_return_pct !== undefined ? bayes.posterior_portfolio_return_pct : 5.46).toFixed(2);
                const deltaRet = (parseFloat(postRet) - parseFloat(priorRet)).toFixed(2);
                const priorVol = (bayes.prior_portfolio_volatility_pct !== undefined ? bayes.prior_portfolio_volatility_pct : 12.47).toFixed(2);
                const postVol = (bayes.posterior_portfolio_volatility_pct !== undefined ? bayes.posterior_portfolio_volatility_pct : 14.66).toFixed(2);
                const turnoverPct = (bayes.total_one_way_turnover_pct !== undefined ? bayes.total_one_way_turnover_pct : 20.0).toFixed(1);
                const tcBps = (bayes.total_transaction_cost_bps !== undefined ? bayes.total_transaction_cost_bps : 1.8).toFixed(1);
                const tcDollars = Math.round(bayes.total_transaction_cost_dollars || 18.20);
                const traceRatio = (bayes.estimation_error_trace_ratio !== undefined ? bayes.estimation_error_trace_ratio : 1.082).toFixed(3);

                const isTurnoverPass = parseFloat(turnoverPct) <= 25.0;
                const isTracePass = parseFloat(traceRatio) <= 1.40;

                // Views Table Rows
                const viewRowsHtml = views.map(v => {
                    const meta = ASSET_METADATA[v.symbol] || { name: v.symbol, sector: 'Asset', flag: '🇺🇸' };
                    const isRel = v.view_type === 'RELATIVE';
                    const relMeta = isRel && v.relative_symbol ? (ASSET_METADATA[v.relative_symbol] || { flag: '🇺🇸' }) : null;
                    const dirColor = v.direction === 'OUTPERFORM' ? 'var(--accent-green)' : (v.direction === 'BULLISH' ? 'var(--accent-cyan)' : '#f87171');

                    return `
                        <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); font-size: 11px;">
                            <td style="padding: 8px 10px;">

                                    ${v.view_type}
                                </span>

                                    </div>
                                    <span style="font-family: monospace; color: var(--accent-green); font-size: 10px;">${v.confidence_pct.toFixed(0)}%</span>
                                </div>
                            </td>
                            <td style="padding: 8px 10px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace; font-weight: 800; color: var(--accent-green);">${v.posterior_expected_return_pct >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${v.posterior_expected_return_pct.toFixed(2)}%</td>

                const allocRowsHtml = allocations.map(a => {

                    const pW = (a.prior_weight * 100).toFixed(2);
                    const cW = (a.constrained_weight * 100).toFixed(2);
                    const dW = a.delta_weight_pct.toFixed(2);
                    const dColor = a.delta_weight_pct > 0.05 ? 'var(--accent-green)' : (a.delta_weight_pct < -0.05 ? '#fb923c' : 'var(--text-muted)');
                    const targetCap = Math.round(a.constrained_weight * activePortfolioCapital);
                    const turnContrib = a.turnover_contribution_pct.toFixed(2);

                    return `

                            <td style="padding: 7px 10px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace; color: var(--accent-cyan);">${f.sharpe_ratio.toFixed(2)}</td>
                            <td style="padding: 7px 10px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace; color: #fb923c;">${f.estimated_transaction_cost_bps.toFixed(1)} bps</td>
                            <td style="padding: 7px 10px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace; color: var(--text-secondary);">${f.active_share_pct.toFixed(1)}%</td>
                        </tr>
                    `;
                }).join('');

                sectionContentHtml = `
                    <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 20px;">
                        <!-- Master Bayesian KPI Ribbon -->
                        <div style="background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 20px;">
                            <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 16px; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px;">
                                <div>
                                    <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 4px;">
                                        <h3 style="font-size: 15px; font-weight: 800; color: #fff;">
                                            🧠 Black-Litterman Bayesian View Blending &amp; Turnover Rebalancer
                                        </h3>
                                        <span class="exchange-tag" style="background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15); color: #f59e0b; border-color: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.3); font-weight: 700;">QUADRATIC UTILITY REBALANCER</span>
                                    </div>

                                    </p>
                                </div>
                                <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;">

                                    <span class="exchange-tag" style="background: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.15); color: var(--accent-cyan); border-color: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.3);">RISK AVERSION: ${bayes.risk_aversion || 2.5}</span>
                                </div>
                            </div>

                            <!-- 4-Card Summary Strip -->
                            <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr)); gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 16px;">
                                <div style="background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.6); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 6px; padding: 12px;">
                                    <div style="font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 2px;">Expected Return Uplift</div>
                                    <div style="font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--accent-green);">
                                        ${postRet}% <span style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-muted);">(+${deltaRet}%)</span>
                                    </div>
                                    <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-secondary); margin-top: 2px;">
                                        Prior: ${priorRet}% &rarr; Posterior: ${postRet}%
                                    </div>
                                </div>

                                <div style="background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.6); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 6px; padding: 12px;">
                                    <div style="font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 2px;">Portfolio Volatility</div>
                                    <div style="font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; color: #fff;">
                                        ${postVol}% <span style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-muted);">(Prior: ${priorVol}%)</span>
                                    </div>
                                    <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-secondary); margin-top: 2px;">
                                        Annualized 19-Asset Covariance
                                    </div>

                                <div style="background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.6); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 6px; padding: 12px;">
                                    <div style="font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 2px;">One-Way Turnover</div>
                                    <div style="font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; color: ${isTurnoverPass ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-red)'};">
                                        ${turnoverPct}% <span style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-muted);">(&le; 20.0% Cap)</span>
                                    </div>
                                    <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-secondary); margin-top: 2px;">
                                        Friction Drag: ${tcBps} bps (~$${tcDollars})

                                </div>
                            </div>

                            <!-- Sentinels Monitor Strip -->
                            <div style="display: flex; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.2); padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); margin-bottom: 16px;">
                                <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 11px;">
                                    <span style="display: inline-block; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: ${isTurnoverPass ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-red)'};"></span>
                                    <span style="color: var(--text-muted);">Predicate 16 (Turnover &lt; 25%):</span>
                                    <strong style="color: ${isTurnoverPass ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-red)'};">${isTurnoverPass ? 'PASS (' + turnoverPct + '%)' : 'BREACH'}</strong>
                                </div>
                                <span style="color: var(--border-color);">|</span>
                                <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 11px;">
                                    <span style="display: inline-block; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: ${isTracePass ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-red)'};"></span>
                                    <span style="color: var(--text-muted);">Predicate 17 (Trace Inflation &lt; 1.40x):</span>
                                    <strong style="color: ${isTracePass ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-red)'};">${isTracePass ? 'PASS (' + traceRatio + 'x)' : 'BREACH'}</strong>
                                </div>
                            </div>

                            <!-- Views Table -->
                            <h4 style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 8px; text-transform: uppercase;">
                                🎯 Quant Intel Active Subjective Views (${views.length} Views Integrated)
                            </h4>
                            <div style="overflow-x: auto; margin-bottom: 18px;">
                                <table style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse;">

                                        <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color); color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase;">

                                            <th style="padding: 6px 10px; text-align: right;">View Return Q</th>
                                            <th style="padding: 6px 10px; text-align: right;">Confidence</th>
                                            <th style="padding: 6px 10px; text-align: right;">Posterior &mu;_BL</th>
                                            <th style="padding: 6px 10px; text-align: left;">Attribution Source</th>
                                        </tr>
                                    </thead>
                                    <tbody>
                                        ${viewRowsHtml}
                                    </tbody>
                                </table>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <!-- 2-Column Allocations & Turnover Frontier -->
                        <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.2fr 1fr; gap: 16px;">
                            <!-- Column 1: Rebalanced Allocations -->
                            <div style="background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 18px;">
                                <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 12px;">
                                    <h4 style="font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; color: #fff;">
                                        ⚖️ Prior HRP vs Bayesian Constrained Allocations
                                    </h4>
                                    <span class="exchange-tag" style="background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15); color: var(--accent-green); font-size: 10px;">MAX ASSET: 18%</span>
                                </div>
                                <div style="overflow-x: auto;">
                                    <table style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse;">
                                        <thead>
                                            <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color); color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase;">
                                                <th style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: left;">Asset</th>
                                                <th style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right;">Prior (w0)</th>
                                                <th style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right;">Target (w*)</th>

                                                <th style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right;">Target $</th>
                                                <th style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right;">Prior Ret</th>
                                                <th style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right;">Post Ret</th>
                                                <th style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right;">Turnover</th>
                                            </tr>
                                        </thead>
                                        <tbody>
                                            ${allocRowsHtml}
                                        </tbody>
                                    </table>
                                </div>
                            </div>

                            <!-- Column 2: Efficient Turnover Frontier -->
                            <div style="background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 18px;">
                                <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 12px;">
                                    <h4 style="font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; color: #fff;">
                                        📈 Efficient Turnover vs Return Frontier
                                    </h4>
                                    <span class="exchange-tag" style="background: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.15); color: var(--accent-cyan); font-size: 10px;">L1 REGULARIZATION</span>
                                </div>
                                <div style="overflow-x: auto;">
                                    <table style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse;">
                                        <thead>
                                            <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color); color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase;">
                                                <th style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: left;">Turnover Cap</th>
                                                <th style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right;">Turnover</th>
                                                <th style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right;">Exp Ret</th>
                                                <th style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right;">Exp Vol</th>
                                                <th style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right;">Sharpe</th>
                                                <th style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right;">Cost</th>
                                                <th style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right;">Active Share</th>
                                            </tr>

                `;
            } else if (activeHrpSection === 'factors') {
                // Section: Multi-Asset Factor Risk Decomposition & Active Style Return Attribution
                const fr = factorRiskBundle || {};
                const fa = factorAttribBundle || {};
                const benchmarks = fa.benchmarks || {};
                const selectedBmKey = activeAttribBenchmark in benchmarks ? activeAttribBenchmark : 'BLENDED_CROSS_BORDER';
                const bm = benchmarks[selectedBmKey] || {};

                const bmBtnsHtml = [

                        ${b.label}
                    </button>
                `).join('');

                const factorSummaries = fr.factor_risk_summaries || {};
                const factorTilts = bm.factor_tilts || {};
                const factorKeys = Object.keys(factorTilts);

                const activeRetPct = (bm.active_return_pct !== undefined ? bm.active_return_pct : 1.73).toFixed(2);
                const factorContribPct = (bm.factor_return_contribution_pct !== undefined ? bm.factor_return_contribution_pct : (bm.factor_return_pct !== undefined ? bm.factor_return_pct : 1.05)).toFixed(2);
                const specificAlphaPct = (bm.specific_alpha_pct !== undefined ? bm.specific_alpha_pct : 0.68).toFixed(2);
                const trackingErrPct = (bm.tracking_error_pct !== undefined ? bm.tracking_error_pct : 4.55).toFixed(2);
                const infoRatio = (bm.information_ratio !== undefined ? bm.information_ratio : 0.38).toFixed(2);
                const bmRetPct = (bm.benchmark_return_pct !== undefined ? bm.benchmark_return_pct : 16.39).toFixed(2);
                const portRetPct = (bm.portfolio_return_pct !== undefined ? bm.portfolio_return_pct : 18.12).toFixed(2);

                const sysVol = ((fr.systematic_volatility || 0.123) * 100).toFixed(2);
                const specVol = ((fr.specific_volatility || 0.0255) * 100).toFixed(2);
                const sysShare = ((fr.systematic_risk_share_pct || 95.88)).toFixed(1);
                const specShare = ((fr.specific_risk_share_pct || 4.12)).toFixed(1);

                const topPosPills = (fa.top_positive_factors || []).map(p => `

                const topNegPills = (fa.top_negative_factors || []).map(n => `

                const factorRowsHtml = factorKeys.map(fKey => {

                    const bExp = (tilt.benchmark_exposure !== undefined ? tilt.benchmark_exposure : 0.0).toFixed(2);
                    const aTilt = (tilt.active_tilt !== undefined ? tilt.active_tilt : 0.0);
                    const aTiltStr = (aTilt >= 0 ? '+' : '') + aTilt.toFixed(2);
                    const fRet = (tilt.factor_return_1y_pct !== undefined ? tilt.factor_return_1y_pct : 0.0).toFixed(1);
                    const pnlPct = (tilt.pnl_contribution_pct !== undefined ? tilt.pnl_contribution_pct : 0.0);
                    const pnlStr = (pnlPct >= 0 ? '+' : '') + pnlPct.toFixed(2) + '%';
                    const riskShare = (riskSum.percent_of_systematic_risk !== undefined ? riskSum.percent_of_systematic_risk : 0.0).toFixed(1);
                    const isMacro = fKey.includes('beta') || fKey.includes('yield') || fKey.includes('oil') || fKey.includes('fx');

                    const pnlColor = pnlPct > 0 ? 'var(--accent-green)' : (pnlPct < 0 ? '#f87171' : 'var(--text-muted)');
                    const tiltColor = aTilt > 0.05 ? 'var(--accent-green)' : (aTilt < -0.05 ? '#fb923c' : 'var(--text-muted)');
                    const dirBadgeColor = tilt.tilt_direction === 'OVERWEIGHT' ? 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15)' : (tilt.tilt_direction === 'UNDERWEIGHT' ? 'rgba(251, 146, 60, 0.15)' : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)');
                    const dirTextColor = tilt.tilt_direction === 'OVERWEIGHT' ? 'var(--accent-green)' : (tilt.tilt_direction === 'UNDERWEIGHT' ? '#fb923c' : 'var(--text-muted)');

                    return `

'rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.15)' : 'rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.15)'}; color: ${isMacro ? 'var(--accent-cyan)' : 'var(--accent-purple)'}; border: 1px solid ${isMacro ? 'rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.3)' : 'rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.3)'};">

                                    ${tilt.tilt_direction || 'NEUTRAL'}

                            <td style="padding: 10px 12px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace; color: #f1f5f9;">${fRet}%</td>

                            <td style="padding: 10px 12px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace; color: var(--accent-cyan);">${riskShare}%</td>

                // 19 Securities Factor Loadings Heatmap Rows
                const secLoadings = fr.factor_loadings || {};

                function getHeatmapBg(val) {
                    if (val > 0.8) return 'background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.25); color: #34d399; font-weight: 700;';
                    if (val > 0.2) return 'background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.10); color: #6ee7b7;';
                    if (val < -0.8) return 'background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.25); color: #f87171; font-weight: 700;';
                    if (val < -0.2) return 'background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.10); color: #fca5a5;';
                    return 'color: var(--text-muted);';
                }

                const secRowsHtml = symbols.map(sym => {
                    const l = secLoadings[sym] || {};

                            <td style="padding: 8px 6px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace; ${getHeatmapBg(l.crude_oil_beta)}">${(l.crude_oil_beta || 0).toFixed(2)}</td>

                            <td style="padding: 8px 6px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace; ${getHeatmapBg(l.yield_curve_beta)}">${(l.yield_curve_beta || 0).toFixed(2)}</td>
                            <td style="padding: 8px 6px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace; color: var(--accent-cyan); font-weight: 600;">${r2Pct}%</td>
                        </tr>
                    `;

                // Sentinel limits monitor status
                const maxNonMktRisk = Math.max(...Object.entries(factorSummaries)

                const maxOilTilt = Math.abs(factorTilts['crude_oil_beta']?.active_tilt || 0);
                const maxFxTilt = Math.abs(factorTilts['cad_usd_fx_beta']?.active_tilt || 0);
                const isCrowdingPass = maxNonMktRisk <= 45.0;

                const isAlphaPass = parseFloat(specificAlphaPct) >= -1.50;

                                    ${bmBtnsHtml}
                                </div>
                            </div>

                            <!-- 4-Pillar Metric Strip -->
                            <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr)); gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 16px;">
                                <div style="background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.6); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 6px; padding: 12px;">
                                    <div style="font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 2px;">Active Return (Rp - Rb)</div>
                                    <div style="font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; color: ${parseFloat(activeRetPct) >= 0 ? 'var(--accent-green)' : '#f87171'};">
                                        ${parseFloat(activeRetPct) >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${activeRetPct}%
                                    </div>

                                    <div style="font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--accent-cyan);">
                                        ${parseFloat(factorContribPct) >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${factorContribPct}%

                                    <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-secondary); margin-top: 2px;">

                                    <div style="font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; color: ${parseFloat(specificAlphaPct) >= 0 ? 'var(--accent-green)' : '#f87171'};">
                                        ${parseFloat(specificAlphaPct) >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${specificAlphaPct}%
                                    </div>
                                    <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-secondary); margin-top: 2px;">
                                        Idiosyncratic Stock Conviction
                                    </div>

                                <div style="background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.6); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 6px; padding: 12px;">
                                    <div style="font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 2px;">Tracking Error &amp; Info Ratio</div>
                                    <div style="font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--accent-purple);">

                            <!-- Factor Sentinels Monitor Strip -->
                            <div style="display: flex; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.2); padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); margin-bottom: 16px;">

                                </div>

                                    <strong style="color: ${isOverexpPass ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-red)'};">${isOverexpPass ? 'PASS (Crude ' + (maxOilTilt >= 0 ? '+' : '') + maxOilTilt.toFixed(2) + ')' : 'BREACH'}</strong>

                                    <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px;">

                                        `).join('')}

                        <!-- 19-Security Factor Loadings Heatmap -->

                                <div>

                                    </h3>

                                </div>
                                <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted);">
                                    <span style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;"><span style="display: inline-block; width: 10px; height: 10px; background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.25); border-radius: 2px;"></span> &gt; +0.80 Loading</span>
                                    <span style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;"><span style="display: inline-block; width: 10px; height: 10px; background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.25); border-radius: 2px;"></span> &lt; -0.80 Loading</span>
                                </div>
                            </div>

                            <div style="overflow-x: auto;">
                                <table style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse;">
                                    <thead>
                                        <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color); color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase;">
                                            <th style="padding: 6px 10px; text-align: left;">Symbol</th>
                                            <th style="padding: 6px 6px; text-align: right;">Mkt Beta</th>
                                            <th style="padding: 6px 6px; text-align: right;">SMB</th>
                                            <th style="padding: 6px 6px; text-align: right;">HML</th>
                                            <th style="padding: 6px 6px; text-align: right;">UMD</th>
                                            <th style="padding: 6px 6px; text-align: right;">RMW</th>
                                            <th style="padding: 6px 6px; text-align: right;">BAB</th>
                                            <th style="padding: 6px 6px; text-align: right;">Oil Beta</th>
                                            <th style="padding: 6px 6px; text-align: right;">FX Beta</th>
                                            <th style="padding: 6px 6px; text-align: right;">Yield Beta</th>
                                            <th style="padding: 6px 6px; text-align: right;">R² Fit</th>
                                        </tr>
                                    </thead>
                                    <tbody>
                                        ${secRowsHtml}
                                    </tbody>
                                </table>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
            } else if (activeHrpSection === 'stress') {
                // Section 2: Crisis Replay & Historical Stress Testing Lab
                const scenarios = stress.scenarios || {};
                const scenarioList = Object.values(scenarios);
                const activeScen = scenarios[activeStressScenarioId] || scenarioList[0] || {};

            } else if (activeHrpSection === 'orchestrator') {

            } else if (activeHrpSection === 'tree') {

Simulated performance, factor exposures, risk reduction metrics, and crisis replay drawdowns are subject to statistical estimation error and market regime instability.         // =========================================================================
        // PHASE 29: CROSS-BORDER FX, OPTIMAL HEDGING & DUAL-LISTED ARBITRAGE LAB
        // =========================================================================
        let crossBorderFxBundle = null;
        let activeFxBaseCurrency = 'CAD'; // 'CAD' or 'USD'
        let simulatedHedgeRatio = 0.23;
        let activeFxSubSection = 'overview'; // 'overview', 'curves', 'hedging', 'arbitrage', 'sentinels'
        let activeArbVenueFilter = 'ALL'; // 'ALL', 'ACTIONABLE', 'EXECUTE_TSX', 'EXECUTE_NYSE'

        async function loadCrossBorderFxAndRender() {
            try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/cross_border_fx.json');
                if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
                crossBorderFxBundle = await res.json();
            } catch (err) {
                console.warn('Direct fetch /api/cross_border_fx.json failed, trying extensionless /api/cross_border_fx:', err);
                try {
                    const res2 = await fetch('/api/cross_border_fx');
                    if (!res2.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res2.status);
                    crossBorderFxBundle = await res2.json();
                } catch (err2) {
                    console.error('All fetches for cross_border_fx failed:', err2);
                    const container = document.getElementById('crossBorderFxContainer');
                    if (container) {
                        container.innerHTML = '<div style="padding: 24px; color: var(--accent-red);">Failed to load Cross-Border FX feed. Please ensure data service is operational.</div>';
                    }
                    return;
                }
            }

            if (crossBorderFxBundle) {
                if (activeFxBaseCurrency === 'CAD') {
                    simulatedHedgeRatio = crossBorderFxBundle.cad_base_hedging?.optimal_hedge_ratio || 0.23;
                } else {
                    simulatedHedgeRatio = crossBorderFxBundle.usd_base_hedging?.optimal_hedge_ratio || 0.12;
                }
            }
            renderCrossBorderFxView();
        }

        function refreshCrossBorderFxData() {
            crossBorderFxBundle = null;
            const container = document.getElementById('crossBorderFxContainer');
            if (container) {
                container.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align: center; padding: 40px; color: var(--text-muted);"><div class="spinner" style="margin-right: 8px;"></div> Refreshing live forward curves, optimal hedge ratios, and interlisted spreads...</div>';
            }
            loadCrossBorderFxAndRender();
        }

        function setFxBaseCurrency(curr) {
            activeFxBaseCurrency = curr;
            document.querySelectorAll('#btnFxBaseCad, #btnFxBaseUsd').forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove('active'));
            if (curr === 'CAD') {
                const b = document.getElementById('btnFxBaseCad');
                if (b) b.classList.add('active');
                if (crossBorderFxBundle?.cad_base_hedging) {
                    simulatedHedgeRatio = crossBorderFxBundle.cad_base_hedging.optimal_hedge_ratio;
                }
            } else {
                const b = document.getElementById('btnFxBaseUsd');
                if (b) b.classList.add('active');
                if (crossBorderFxBundle?.usd_base_hedging) {
                    simulatedHedgeRatio = crossBorderFxBundle.usd_base_hedging.optimal_hedge_ratio;
                }
            }
            renderCrossBorderFxView();
        }

        function setFxSubSection(section) {
            activeFxSubSection = section;
            renderCrossBorderFxView();
        }

        function setArbVenueFilter(filter) {
            activeArbVenueFilter = filter;
            renderCrossBorderFxView();
        }

        function updateSimulatedHedgeRatio(val) {
            simulatedHedgeRatio = parseFloat(val);
            const hedgeObj = (activeFxBaseCurrency === 'CAD') ? crossBorderFxBundle?.cad_base_hedging : crossBorderFxBundle?.usd_base_hedging;
            if (!hedgeObj) return;

            const h = simulatedHedgeRatio;
            const hStar = hedgeObj.optimal_hedge_ratio || 0.23;
            const volUnhedged = hedgeObj.unhedged_portfolio_volatility_pct || 19.18;
            const volHedged = hedgeObj.fully_hedged_portfolio_volatility_pct || 18.86;
            const volOptimal = hedgeObj.optimal_hedged_portfolio_volatility_pct || 18.82;

            const denom = Math.max(0.001, hStar * hStar);
            const varFx = Math.max(0.01, (Math.pow(volHedged, 2) - Math.pow(volOptimal, 2)) / denom);
            const cov = -hStar * varFx;
            const varForeign = Math.pow(volHedged, 2);

            const simVar = Math.max(1.0, varForeign + Math.pow(h, 2) * varFx + 2.0 * h * cov);
            const simVol = Math.sqrt(simVar);
            const simReduction = Math.max(0.0, ((volUnhedged - simVol) / volUnhedged) * 100.0);
            const interestDiff = Math.abs((crossBorderFxBundle?.boc_policy_rate_pct || 4.25) - (crossBorderFxBundle?.fed_funds_rate_pct || 4.85));
            const simDrag = interestDiff * 100.0 * h;

            const lblHedge = document.getElementById('simHedgeVal');
            if (lblHedge) lblHedge.innerText = Math.round(h * 100) + '%';
            const lblVol = document.getElementById('simVolVal');
            if (lblVol) lblVol.innerText = simVol.toFixed(2) + '%';
            const lblRed = document.getElementById('simReductionVal');
            if (lblRed) lblRed.innerText = (simReduction > 0 ? '-' : '') + simReduction.toFixed(2) + '%';
            const lblDrag = document.getElementById('simDragVal');
            if (lblDrag) lblDrag.innerText = simDrag.toFixed(1) + ' bps';
        }

'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3)' : arb.routing_recommendation === 'EXECUTE_NYSE' ? 'rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.3)' : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)'}; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700;">

        // =========================================================================

        let optionsBundle = null;

        let activeOptionsMarketFilter = 'ALL'; // 'ALL', 'US_CBOE', 'CA_MX'

        async function loadOptionsAndRender() {
            try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/options_intelligence.json');
                if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
                optionsBundle = await res.json();
            } catch (err) {
                console.warn('Direct fetch /api/options_intelligence.json failed, trying extensionless /api/options_intelligence:', err);
                try {
                    const res2 = await fetch('/api/options_intelligence');
                    if (!res2.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res2.status);
                    optionsBundle = await res2.json();
                } catch (err2) {

                    if (container) {
                        container.innerHTML = '<div style="padding: 24px; color: var(--accent-red);">Failed to load Options Intelligence feed. Please ensure data service is operational.</div>';

                    return;

            }

            renderOptionsView();

        function refreshOptionsData() {

            }
            loadOptionsAndRender();
        }

        function setOptionsSymbol(sym) {

            renderOptionsView();

            activeOptionsSubSection = section;

        function setOptionsMarketFilter(mkt) {
            activeOptionsMarketFilter = mkt;
            document.querySelectorAll('#btnOptMktAll, #btnOptMktUs, #btnOptMktCa').forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove('active'));
