                const b = document.getElementById('btnOptMktAll');
                if (b) b.classList.add('active');
            } else if (mkt === 'US_CBOE') {
                const b = document.getElementById('btnOptMktUs');
                if (b) b.classList.add('active');
                if (['XIU', 'SHOP', 'RY', 'TD', 'ENB'].includes(activeOptionsSymbol)) {
                    activeOptionsSymbol = 'SPY';
                }
            } else {
                const b = document.getElementById('btnOptMktCa');
                if (b) b.classList.add('active');
                if (['SPY', 'QQQ', 'AAPL', 'MSFT', 'NVDA'].includes(activeOptionsSymbol)) {
                    activeOptionsSymbol = 'SHOP';
                }
            }
            renderOptionsView();
        }

        function renderOptionsView() {
            const container = document.getElementById('optionsSurfaceContainer');
            if (!container || !optionsBundle) return;

            const opt = optionsBundle;
            const dossiers = opt.dossiers || {};

            // Filter available symbols
            const filteredSymbols = Object.keys(dossiers).filter(sym => {
                if (activeOptionsMarketFilter === 'US_CBOE') return dossiers[sym].exchange_market === 'US_CBOE';
                if (activeOptionsMarketFilter === 'CA_MX') return dossiers[sym].exchange_market === 'CA_MX';
                return true;
            });

            if (!filteredSymbols.includes(activeOptionsSymbol)) {
                activeOptionsSymbol = filteredSymbols[0] || 'SPY';
            }

            const activeDossier = dossiers[activeOptionsSymbol] || Object.values(dossiers)[0];
            if (!activeDossier) return;

            // Sentinel condition checks
            let hasFlipAlert = false;
            let hasSkewAlert = false;
            Object.values(dossiers).forEach(d => {
                if (d.gamma_regime === 'SHORT_GAMMA' && d.net_gex_millions < (d.exchange_market === 'CA_MX' ? -5 : -50)) {
                    hasFlipAlert = true;
                }
                if (d.skew_zscore > 2.50) {
                    hasSkewAlert = true;
                }
            });

            const sentinelBadge = document.getElementById('optionsSentinelBadge');

                    sentinelBadge.style.color = 'var(--accent-green)';
                }
            }

            // Ticker Selector Strip
            const tickerSelectorHtml = `

                                <span>${sym}</span>
                                <span style="font-size: 9px; opacity: 0.8;">${d.exchange_market === 'US_CBOE' ? '🇺🇸' : '🇨🇦'}</span>

            `;

            // Sub-nav Buttons
            const navTabsHtml = `

                    <button class="filter-btn ${activeOptionsSubSection === 'gex' ? 'active' : ''}" onclick="setOptionsSubSection('gex')">⚡ Dealer GEX Strike Profile &amp; Gamma Flip</button>
                    <button class="filter-btn ${activeOptionsSubSection === 'surface' ? 'active' : ''}" onclick="setOptionsSubSection('surface')">📈 Multi-Tenor Volatility Surface &amp; Smile</button>

            // Top KPI Strip
            const kpiHtml = `
                <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr)); gap: 14px; margin-bottom: 24px;">

                            <h3 style="font-size: 15px; font-weight: 800; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 4px;">Max Pain Strike &amp; Expiration Pinning</h3>
                            <p style="font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 16px;">
                                Strike price where cumulative dollar payout to options buyers is minimized.
                            </p>

                            <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 16px;">
                                <div style="background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.6); padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border-color);">
                                    <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase;">Max Pain Strike</div>
                                    <div style="font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--accent-yellow); margin-top: 2px;">$${activeDossier.max_pain_strike.toFixed(2)}</div>
                                </div>
                                <div style="background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.6); padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border-color);">
                                    <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase;">Spot to Max Pain</div>
                                    <div style="font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; color: #fff; margin-top: 2px;">
                                        ${(((activeDossier.max_pain_strike - activeDossier.underlying_spot_price) / activeDossier.underlying_spot_price) * 100).toFixed(1)}%
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>

                            <div style="background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.7); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 6px; padding: 14px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.5;">
                                <strong>Expiration Pinning Behavior:</strong>
                                During the final 48 hours approaching monthly options expiration (the third Friday of each month), underlying asset prices frequently gravitate toward the Max Pain level as option market maker delta hedging pins prices to minimize directional assignment risk.
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
            }

            // 5. SENTINELS SUBSECTION
            else if (activeOptionsSubSection === 'sentinels') {
                sectionContentHtml = `
                    <div style="background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 22px; margin-bottom: 24px;">
                        <h3 style="font-size: 15px; font-weight: 800; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 4px;">Derivatives Risk Sentinels &amp; Circuit Breakers</h3>
                        <p style="font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 18px;">
                            Autonomous invariant monitors (Predicates 20 &amp; 21) governing dealer Gamma Flip transitions and volatility skew tail risk spikes.
                        </p>

                        <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px;">
                            <div style="background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.6); border: 1px solid ${hasFlipAlert ? 'var(--accent-red)' : 'var(--border-color)'}; border-radius: 6px; padding: 16px;">
                                <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 8px;">
                                    <span style="font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--accent-cyan);">PREDICATE 20</span>
                                    <span class="exchange-tag" style="background: ${hasFlipAlert ? 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15)' : 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15)'}; color: ${hasFlipAlert ? 'var(--accent-red)' : 'var(--accent-green)'}; border-color: ${hasFlipAlert ? 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.3)' : 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3)'}; font-size: 10px;">
                                        ${hasFlipAlert ? 'BREACHED' : 'NOMINAL'}
                                    </span>
                                </div>
                                <h4 style="font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 4px;">GAMMA_FLIP_REGIME_TRANSITION</h4>
                                <p style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 10px;">
                                    Trigger Level: Spot crosses below Gamma Flip strike and Net GEX &lt; -$50M ($5M on CA MX).
                                </p>
                                <div style="font-size: 11px; color: #fff;">
                                    Current Active Symbol (${activeDossier.symbol}): <strong>${activeDossier.gamma_regime}</strong> ($${activeDossier.net_gex_millions.toFixed(1)}M GEX)
                                </div>
                                <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 6px;">
                                    Action Required: WIDEN_STOP_THRESHOLDS
                                </div>
                            </div>

                            <div style="background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.6); border: 1px solid ${hasSkewAlert ? 'var(--accent-red)' : 'var(--border-color)'}; border-radius: 6px; padding: 16px;">
                                <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 8px;">
                                    <span style="font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--accent-cyan);">PREDICATE 21</span>
                                    <span class="exchange-tag" style="background: ${hasSkewAlert ? 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15)' : 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15)'}; color: ${hasSkewAlert ? 'var(--accent-red)' : 'var(--accent-green)'}; border-color: ${hasSkewAlert ? 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.3)' : 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3)'}; font-size: 10px;">
                                        ${hasSkewAlert ? 'BREACHED' : 'NOMINAL'}
                                    </span>
                                </div>
                                <h4 style="font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 4px;">VOLATILITY_SKEW_TAIL_INVERSION</h4>
                                <p style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 10px;">
                                    Trigger Level: 25-Delta Put Skew Z-Score &gt; +2.50σ.
                                </p>
                                <div style="font-size: 11px; color: #fff;">
                                    Current Active Symbol (${activeDossier.symbol}): <strong>${activeDossier.skew_zscore > 0 ? '+' : ''}${activeDossier.skew_zscore}σ</strong> (${activeDossier.thirty_day_skew_pct}% Skew)
                                </div>
                                <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 6px;">
                                    Action Required: SCRUTINIZE_TAIL_RISK_PROTECTION
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
            }

            // Statutory Disclaimer Footer
            const statutoryHtml = `
                <div style="margin-top: 24px; padding-top: 14px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color); font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.5;">
                    <strong>Statutory Regulatory Notice (CSA Staff Notice 31-369 / SEC Publisher Exclusion §202(a)(11)(D)):</strong>
                    Options volatility surface metrics, dealer Net Gamma Exposure (GEX), Gamma Flip threshold calculations, and Max Pain distributions are impersonal quantitative mathematical simulations. They do not constitute individualized options trade recommendations, multi-leg derivative order strategies, financial planning, or fiduciary investment advice. Options trading involves substantial leverage, volatility risk, and potential for total capital loss. Implied volatility estimates and open interest distributions reflect exchange closing data and are subject to model estimation error and market execution slippage. Past performance is no guarantee of future returns.
                </div>
            `;

            container.innerHTML = `
                ${tickerSelectorHtml}
                ${navTabsHtml}
                ${kpiHtml}
                ${sectionContentHtml}
                ${statutoryHtml}
            `;
        }

        // =========================================================================
        // PHASE 31: SOVEREIGN YIELD CURVE & TERM PREMIUM DECOMPOSITION LAB
        // =========================================================================
        let sovereignBundle = null;
        let activeYieldJurisdiction = 'US'; // 'US' | 'CA'

        async function loadSovereignCurveAndRender() {
            try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/sovereign_yield_curve.json');
                if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
                sovereignBundle = await res.json();
            } catch (err) {
                console.warn('Direct fetch /api/sovereign_yield_curve.json failed, trying extensionless route:', err);
                try {
                    const res2 = await fetch('/api/sovereign_yield_curve');
                    if (!res2.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res2.status);
                    sovereignBundle = await res2.json();
                } catch (err2) {
                    console.error('All fetches for sovereign_yield_curve failed:', err2);
                    const container = document.getElementById('sovereignCurveContainer');
                    if (container) {
                        container.innerHTML = '<div style="padding: 24px; color: var(--accent-red);">Failed to load Sovereign Yield Curve feed. Please ensure the data service is operational.</div>';
                    }
                    return;
                }
            }
            renderSovereignCurveView();
        }

        function refreshSovereignData() {
            sovereignBundle = null;
            const container = document.getElementById('sovereignCurveContainer');
            if (container) {
                container.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align: center; padding: 40px; color: var(--text-muted);"><div class="spinner" style="margin-right: 8px;"></div> Refreshing Nelson-Siegel curves, ACM term premium decompositions, and slope regimes...</div>';
            }
            loadSovereignCurveAndRender();
        }

        function setYieldJurisdiction(jur) {
            activeYieldJurisdiction = jur;
            const usBtn = document.getElementById('btnYieldJurUS');
            const caBtn = document.getElementById('btnYieldJurCA');
            if (usBtn) usBtn.classList.toggle('active', jur === 'US');
            if (caBtn) caBtn.classList.toggle('active', jur === 'CA');
            renderSovereignCurveView();
        }

        const YIELD_REGIME_META = {
            'BEAR_STEEPENER': { label: 'BEAR STEEPENER', color: '#f59e0b', desc: 'Long rates rising faster than short rates — fiscal supply and term premium pressure' },
            'BULL_STEEPENER': { label: 'BULL STEEPENER', color: 'var(--accent-green)', desc: 'Short rates falling faster than long rates — easing cycle and early recovery' },
            'BEAR_FLATTENER': { label: 'BEAR FLATTENER', color: 'var(--accent-red)', desc: 'Short rates rising faster than long rates — late-cycle tightening' },
            'BULL_FLATTENER': { label: 'BULL FLATTENER', color: 'var(--accent-blue)', desc: 'Long rates falling faster than short rates — flight to quality and recession pricing' },
            'INVERTED':       { label: 'INVERTED',       color: 'var(--accent-red)', desc: 'Short rates above long rates — classic late-cycle recession warning' },
            'NORMAL':         { label: 'NORMAL',         color: 'var(--accent-cyan)', desc: 'Conventionally upward-sloping term structure' }
        };

        function buildYieldCurveSvg(points, highlight) {
            const W = 920, H = 300, padL = 56, padR = 22, padT = 20, padB = 36;
            const xs = points.map(p => p.maturity_years);
            const ust = points.map(p => p.ust_yield_pct);
            const goc = points.map(p => p.goc_yield_pct);
            const allY = ust.concat(goc);
            const yMin = Math.min.apply(null, allY) - 0.15;
            const yMax = Math.max.apply(null, allY) + 0.15;
            const lxMin = Math.log10(Math.min.apply(null, xs));
            const lxMax = Math.log10(Math.max.apply(null, xs));
            const sx = m => padL + (W - padL - padR) * (Math.log10(m) - lxMin) / (lxMax - lxMin);
            const sy = y => padT + (H - padT - padB) * (1 - (y - yMin) / (yMax - yMin));

            let grid = '';
            const yTicks = [];
            for (let t = Math.ceil(yMin * 4) / 4; t <= yMax; t += 0.25) yTicks.push(Math.round(t * 100) / 100);
            yTicks.forEach(t => {
                grid += `<line x1="${padL}" y1="${sy(t).toFixed(1)}" x2="${W - padR}" y2="${sy(t).toFixed(1)}" stroke="rgba(148,163,184,0.14)" stroke-width="1"/>`;
                grid += `<text x="${padL - 8}" y="${(sy(t) + 3.5).toFixed(1)}" text-anchor="end" font-size="10" fill="#94a3b8">${t.toFixed(2)}%</text>`;
            });

            let xLabels = '';
            points.forEach(p => {
                const x = sx(p.maturity_years);
                xLabels += `<line x1="${x.toFixed(1)}" y1="${H - padB}" x2="${x.toFixed(1)}" y2="${(H - padB + 4).toFixed(1)}" stroke="rgba(148,163,184,0.35)" stroke-width="1"/>`;
                xLabels += `<text x="${x.toFixed(1)}" y="${H - padB + 17}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#94a3b8">${p.tenor}</text>`;
            });

            const line = (vals) => vals.map((v, i) => `${i === 0 ? 'M' : 'L'} ${sx(points[i].maturity_years).toFixed(1)} ${sy(v).toFixed(1)}`).join(' ');
            const dots = (vals, color) => vals.map((v, i) =>
                `<circle cx="${sx(points[i].maturity_years).toFixed(1)}" cy="${sy(v).toFixed(1)}" r="${highlight === 'UST' && color === 'ust' ? 4 : 3}" fill="${color === 'ust' ? '#60a5fa' : '#f87171'}" stroke="#0f172a" stroke-width="1"/>`
            ).join('');

            return `
            <svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" style="width: 100%; height: auto; max-width: 920px; display: block;">
                ${grid}
                <line x1="${padL}" y1="${H - padB}" x2="${W - padR}" y2="${H - padB}" stroke="rgba(148,163,184,0.4)" stroke-width="1"/>
                ${xLabels}
                <path d="${line(ust)}" fill="none" stroke="#60a5fa" stroke-width="2.5"/>
                <path d="${line(goc)}" fill="none" stroke="#f87171" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-dasharray="6 3"/>
                ${dots(ust, 'ust')}
                ${dots(goc, 'goc')}
                <text x="${padL + 6}" y="${padT + 4}" font-size="11" fill="#60a5fa" font-weight="700">— US Treasuries (USD)</text>
                <text x="${padL + 170}" y="${padT + 4}" font-size="11" fill="#f87171" font-weight="700">- - Government of Canada (CAD)</text>
            </svg>`;
        }

        function buildTermPremiumBars(decomps) {
            const maxNominal = Math.max.apply(null, decomps.map(d => d.nominal_yield_pct)) || 1;
            return decomps.map(d => {
                const wPath = (d.risk_neutral_rate_path_pct / maxNominal) * 100;
                const wTp = (d.term_premium_pct / maxNominal) * 100;
                const tpColor = d.term_premium_bps >= 0 ? 'var(--accent-purple)' : 'var(--accent-cyan)';
                const chgColor = d.ten_day_change_bps > 35 ? 'var(--accent-red)' : (d.ten_day_change_bps > 0 ? '#f59e0b' : 'var(--accent-green)');
                return `
                <div style="margin-bottom: 14px;">
                    <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; margin-bottom: 5px;">
                        <span style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-primary);">${d.tenor} Sovereign · Nominal ${d.nominal_yield_pct.toFixed(2)}%</span>
                        <span style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted);">10D TP change: <span style="color: ${chgColor}; font-weight: 700;">${d.ten_day_change_bps > 0 ? '+' : ''}${d.ten_day_change_bps.toFixed(1)} bps</span></span>
                    </div>
                    <div style="display: flex; height: 22px; border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--border-color); background: var(--bg-primary);">
                        <div style="width: ${wPath.toFixed(1)}%; background: var(--accent-blue); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; color: #0f172a; white-space: nowrap;">Rate Path ${d.risk_neutral_rate_path_pct.toFixed(2)}%</div>
                        <div style="width: ${Math.max(wTp, 0).toFixed(1)}%; background: ${tpColor}; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; color: #0f172a; white-space: nowrap;">TP ${d.term_premium_bps.toFixed(0)} bps</div>
                    </div>
                </div>`;
            }).join('');
        }

        function renderSovereignCurveView() {
            if (!sovereignBundle) return;
            const container = document.getElementById('sovereignCurveContainer');
            if (!container) return;

            const b = sovereignBundle;
            const prof = activeYieldJurisdiction === 'US' ? b.us_profile : b.ca_profile;
            const meta = YIELD_REGIME_META[prof.curve_regime] || YIELD_REGIME_META['NORMAL'];
            const jurLabel = activeYieldJurisdiction === 'US' ? '🇺🇸 US Treasuries (USD)' : '🇨🇦 Government of Canada (CAD)';

            // Sentinel badge state
            const badge = document.getElementById('sovereignSentinelBadge');
            if (badge) {
                const inverted = (b.us_profile.slope_2y10y_bps < -50 || b.us_profile.slope_3m10y_bps < -75 ||
                                  b.ca_profile.slope_2y10y_bps < -50 || b.ca_profile.slope_3m10y_bps < -75);
                const tp10us = (b.us_profile.term_premium_decompositions.find(d => d.tenor === '10Y') || {}).ten_day_change_bps || 0;
                const tp10ca = (b.ca_profile.term_premium_decompositions.find(d => d.tenor === '10Y') || {}).ten_day_change_bps || 0;
                const tpShock = (tp10us > 35 || tp10ca > 35);
                if (inverted || tpShock) {
                    badge.style.color = 'var(--accent-red)';
                    badge.innerHTML = `<span style="display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; background: var(--accent-red); border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent-red);"></span> SENTINEL TRIGGERED (P22/P23)`;
                } else {
                    badge.style.color = 'var(--accent-green)';
                    badge.innerHTML = `<span style="display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; background: var(--accent-green); border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent-green);"></span> CURVE NOMINAL`;
                }
            }

            const slopeCard = (label, value, hazard) => {
                const breached = hazard === 'inv' ? (value < -50) : (hazard === 'inv3' ? (value < -75) : (value > 35));
                const c = breached ? 'var(--accent-red)' : (value > 0 ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-cyan)');
                return `
                <div style="flex: 1 1 150px; background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px;">
                    <div style="font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.5px;">${label}</div>
                    <div style="font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; color: ${c}; margin-top: 4px;">${value > 0 ? '+' : ''}${value.toFixed(1)} <span style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600;">bps</span></div>
                </div>`;
            };

            const kpiHtml = `
            <div style="display: flex; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 16px;">
                ${slopeCard('2Y10Y Slope', prof.slope_2y10y_bps, 'inv')}
                ${slopeCard('3M10Y Slope', prof.slope_3m10y_bps, 'inv3')}
                ${slopeCard('5Y30Y Slope', prof.slope_5y30y_bps, 'none')}
                <div style="flex: 1 1 150px; background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px;">
                    <div style="font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.5px;">Curve Regime</div>
                    <div style="font-size: 15px; font-weight: 800; color: ${meta.color}; margin-top: 8px;">${meta.label}</div>
                </div>
                <div style="flex: 1 1 150px; background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px;">
                    <div style="font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.5px;">10Y GoC − UST Spread</div>
                    <div style="font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--accent-cyan); margin-top: 4px;">${b.ten_year_spread_bps > 0 ? '+' : ''}${b.ten_year_spread_bps.toFixed(1)} <span style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600;">bps</span></div>
                </div>
                <div style="flex: 1 1 150px; background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px;">
                    <div style="font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.5px;">NSS Level β₀</div>
                    <div style="font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--accent-purple); margin-top: 4px;">${prof.nss_params.beta0_level.toFixed(3)}%</div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div style="background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-left: 3px solid ${meta.color}; border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 14px; margin-bottom: 18px;">
                <div style="font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-secondary);"><strong style="color: ${meta.color};">${meta.label}</strong> — ${meta.desc}. Jurisdiction: ${jurLabel}.</div>
            </div>`;

            const curveHtml = `
            <div style="display: flex; gap: 16px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 18px;">
                <div style="flex: 2 1 520px; background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px;">
                    <h3 style="font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--text-primary); margin-bottom: 10px;">📉 Cross-Border Sovereign Yield Curve — Nelson-Siegel Fitted (log maturity axis)</h3>
                    ${buildYieldCurveSvg(b.cross_border_yield_curve, activeYieldJurisdiction)}
                    <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 8px;">NSS parameters (${prof.jurisdiction}): β₀ = ${prof.nss_params.beta0_level.toFixed(4)}, β₁ = ${prof.nss_params.beta1_slope.toFixed(4)}, β₂ = ${prof.nss_params.beta2_curvature.toFixed(4)}, τ = ${prof.nss_params.tau.toFixed(4)}</div>
                </div>
                <div style="flex: 1 1 320px; background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px;">
                    <h3 style="font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--text-primary); margin-bottom: 12px;">🧮 ACM Term Premium Decomposition — ${prof.jurisdiction}</h3>
                    ${buildTermPremiumBars(prof.term_premium_decompositions)}
                    <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 6px;">Nominal yield = risk-neutral expected policy-rate path + term premium (Adrian-Crump-Moench affine decomposition).</div>
                </div>
            </div>`;

            const rows = b.cross_border_yield_curve.map(p => {
                const c = p.spread_bps < 0 ? 'var(--accent-red)' : 'var(--accent-green)';
                return `<tr>
                    <td style="padding: 6px 10px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-primary);">${p.tenor}</td>
                    <td style="padding: 6px 10px; color: var(--text-muted);">${p.maturity_years.toFixed(2)}y</td>
                    <td style="padding: 6px 10px; text-align: right; color: #60a5fa; font-weight: 600;">${p.ust_yield_pct.toFixed(2)}%</td>
                    <td style="padding: 6px 10px; text-align: right; color: #f87171; font-weight: 600;">${p.goc_yield_pct.toFixed(2)}%</td>
                    <td style="padding: 6px 10px; text-align: right; color: ${c}; font-weight: 700;">${p.spread_bps > 0 ? '+' : ''}${p.spread_bps.toFixed(1)} bps</td>
                </tr>`;
            }).join('');

            const tableHtml = `
            <div style="background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px; margin-bottom: 18px; overflow-x: auto;">
                <h3 style="font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--text-primary); margin-bottom: 10px;">🌎 Cross-Border Sovereign Spread Term Structure (GoC − UST)</h3>
                <table style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 12px;">
                    <thead><tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);">
                        <th style="padding: 6px 10px; text-align: left; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">Tenor</th>
                        <th style="padding: 6px 10px; text-align: left; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">Maturity</th>
                        <th style="padding: 6px 10px; text-align: right; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">UST Yield</th>
                        <th style="padding: 6px 10px; text-align: right; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">GoC Yield</th>
                        <th style="padding: 6px 10px; text-align: right; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">Spread</th>
                    </tr></thead>
                    <tbody>${rows}</tbody>
                </table>
            </div>`;

            const statutoryHtml = `
            <div style="background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.06); border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.25); border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 14px;">
                <div style="font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; color: #f59e0b; margin-bottom: 6px;">⚖️ STATUTORY RESEARCH NOTICE</div>
                <ul style="margin: 0; padding-left: 18px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.6;">
                    ${(b.disclaimers || []).map(d => `<li>${d}</li>`).join('')}
                </ul>
                <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 8px;">Feed generated: ${b.generated_at} · As of ${b.as_of_date}</div>
            </div>`;

            container.innerHTML = `${kpiHtml}${curveHtml}${tableHtml}${statutoryHtml}`;
        }

        // =========================================================================
        // PHASE 32: DARK POOL, OFF-EXCHANGE LIQUIDITY & SHORT ACTIVITY LAB
        //
        // DECISION 2(b): ATS share is rendered for reference only and is never used
        // in any client-side scoring, sorting default, or badge computation.
        // DECISION 1(b): short metrics are absent from the commercial payload; the UI
        // renders a locked entitlement panel instead of fabricating values.
        // =========================================================================
        let darkPoolBundle = null;
        let activeDarkPoolMarketFilter = 'ALL'; // 'ALL' | 'US' | 'CA'

        async function loadDarkPoolAndRender() {
            try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/dark_pool_liquidity.json');
                if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
                darkPoolBundle = await res.json();
            } catch (err) {
                console.warn('Direct fetch /api/dark_pool_liquidity.json failed, trying extensionless route:', err);
                try {
                    const res2 = await fetch('/api/dark_pool_liquidity');
                    if (!res2.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res2.status);
                    darkPoolBundle = await res2.json();
                } catch (err2) {
                    console.error('All fetches for dark_pool_liquidity failed:', err2);
                    const container = document.getElementById('darkPoolContainer');
                    if (container) {
                        container.innerHTML = '<div style="padding: 24px; color: var(--accent-red);">Failed to load the Off-Exchange Liquidity feed. Please ensure the data service is operational.</div>';
                    }
                    return;
                }
            }
            renderDarkPoolView();
        }

        function refreshDarkPoolData() {
            darkPoolBundle = null;
            const container = document.getElementById('darkPoolContainer');
            if (container) {
                container.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align: center; padding: 40px; color: var(--text-muted);"><div class="spinner" style="margin-right: 8px;"></div> Refreshing off-exchange volume ratios, block clustering, and venue fragmentation...</div>';
            }
            loadDarkPoolAndRender();
        }

        function setDarkPoolMarketFilter(mkt) {
            activeDarkPoolMarketFilter = mkt;
            ['ALL', 'US', 'CA'].forEach(m => {
                const btn = document.getElementById('btnDpMkt' + m);
                if (btn) btn.classList.toggle('active', m === mkt);
            });
            renderDarkPoolView();
        }

        const DP_OVR_REGIME_META = {
            'NORMAL':   { color: 'var(--accent-green)', label: 'NORMAL' },
            'ELEVATED': { color: '#f59e0b',             label: 'ELEVATED' },
            'EXTREME':  { color: 'var(--accent-red)',   label: 'EXTREME' }
        };

        const DP_IMPRESSION_META = {
            'ACCUMULATION': { color: 'var(--accent-green)', icon: '▲' },
            'DISTRIBUTION': { color: 'var(--accent-red)',   icon: '▼' },
            'NEUTRAL':      { color: 'var(--text-muted)',   icon: '◆' }
        };

        function buildOvrBarChart(entries) {
            const W = 920, rowH = 22, padL = 62, padR = 46, padT = 24, padB = 26;
            const H = padT + padB + entries.length * rowH;
            const maxOvr = Math.max.apply(null, entries.map(e => e.off_exchange.ovr_pct).concat([10]));

            let rows = '';
            entries.forEach((e, i) => {
                const y = padT + i * rowH;
                const w = (e.off_exchange.ovr_pct / maxOvr) * (W - padL - padR);
                const meta = DP_OVR_REGIME_META[e.off_exchange.ovr_regime] || DP_OVR_REGIME_META['NORMAL'];
                const zc = e.off_exchange.ovr_zscore_60d >= 1.5 ? 'var(--accent-red)' : (e.off_exchange.ovr_zscore_60d >= 0.5 ? '#f59e0b' : 'var(--text-muted)');
                rows += `
                <text x="${padL - 8}" y="${y + rowH / 2 + 4}" text-anchor="end" font-size="10.5" fill="#cbd5e1" font-weight="700">${e.symbol}</text>
                <rect x="${padL}" y="${y + 4}" width="${(W - padL - padR)}" height="${rowH - 9}" fill="rgba(148,163,184,0.08)" rx="2"/>
                <rect x="${padL}" y="${y + 4}" width="${Math.max(w, 1).toFixed(1)}" height="${rowH - 9}" fill="${meta.color}" opacity="0.82" rx="2"/>
                <text x="${(padL + Math.max(w, 1) + 6).toFixed(1)}" y="${y + rowH / 2 + 4}" font-size="10" fill="#e2e8f0" font-weight="700">${e.off_exchange.ovr_pct.toFixed(1)}%</text>
                <text x="${W - 4}" y="${y + rowH / 2 + 4}" text-anchor="end" font-size="10" fill="${zc}" font-weight="700">z ${e.off_exchange.ovr_zscore_60d >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${e.off_exchange.ovr_zscore_60d.toFixed(2)}</text>`;
            });

            return `
            <svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" style="width: 100%; height: auto; max-width: 920px; display: block;">
                <text x="${padL}" y="14" font-size="10" fill="#94a3b8">Off-exchange share of consolidated volume (%) &mdash; bar colour = 60-day regime</text>
                ${rows}
            </svg>`;
        }

        function renderDarkPoolView() {
            if (!darkPoolBundle) return;
            const container = document.getElementById('darkPoolContainer');
            if (!container) return;
            const b = darkPoolBundle;

            let entries = Object.values(b.dossiers || {});
            if (activeDarkPoolMarketFilter !== 'ALL') {
                entries = entries.filter(e => e.country === activeDarkPoolMarketFilter);
            }
            entries.sort((x, y) => y.composite_stealth_liquidity_score - x.composite_stealth_liquidity_score);

            // Sentinel badge. NOTE: ATS share is intentionally not referenced here (Decision 2b).
            const badge = document.getElementById('darkPoolSentinelBadge');
            if (badge) {
                const extreme = entries.filter(e => e.off_exchange.ovr_regime === 'EXTREME');
                const distro = entries.filter(e => e.block_cluster.signed_impression === 'DISTRIBUTION' && e.block_cluster.rangebound_near_resistance && e.off_exchange.ovr_pct > 60);
                if (extreme.length > 0 || distro.length > 0) {
                    badge.style.color = 'var(--accent-red)';
                    badge.innerHTML = `<span style="display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; background: var(--accent-red); border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent-red);"></span> P24 WATCH (${extreme.length + distro.length})`;
                } else {
                    badge.style.color = 'var(--accent-green)';
                    badge.innerHTML = `<span style="display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; background: var(--accent-green); border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent-green);"></span> LIQUIDITY NOMINAL`;
                }
            }

            const kpi = (label, value, sub, color) => `
                <div style="flex: 1 1 165px; background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px;">
                    <div style="font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.5px;">${label}</div>
                    <div style="font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; color: ${color}; margin-top: 4px;">${value}</div>
                    ${sub ? `<div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 2px;">${sub}</div>` : ''}
                </div>`;

            const kpiHtml = `
            <div style="display: flex; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 16px;">
                ${kpi('US Off-Exchange Share', b.aggregate_us_off_exchange_share_pct.toFixed(2) + '%', 'FINRA TRF / ADF / ORF', '#60a5fa')}
                ${kpi('CA Off-Exchange Share', b.aggregate_ca_off_exchange_share_pct.toFixed(2) + '%', 'CIRO marketplace reports', '#f87171')}
                ${kpi('Block Trade Intensity', b.aggregate_block_trade_intensity_pct.toFixed(2) + '%', '≥10k sh / ≥$200k notional', 'var(--accent-cyan)')}
                ${kpi('Universe Monitored', String(b.universe_count), 'US + Canada dual-market', 'var(--accent-purple)')}
            </div>`;

            const chartHtml = `
            <div style="background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px; margin-bottom: 16px;">
                <h3 style="font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--text-primary); margin-bottom: 8px;">📊 Off-Exchange Volume Ratio by Security (60-day self-standardized)</h3>
                ${buildOvrBarChart(entries)}
            </div>`;

            const rows = entries.map(e => {
                const ovrMeta = DP_OVR_REGIME_META[e.off_exchange.ovr_regime] || DP_OVR_REGIME_META['NORMAL'];
                const imp = DP_IMPRESSION_META[e.block_cluster.signed_impression] || DP_IMPRESSION_META['NEUTRAL'];
                const flag = flag24(e);
                return `<tr>
                    <td style="padding: 6px 8px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-primary);">${e.symbol} <span style="font-size: 9px; color: var(--text-muted);">${e.country}</span></td>
                    <td style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right; color: ${ovrMeta.color}; font-weight: 700;">${e.off_exchange.ovr_pct.toFixed(1)}%</td>
                    <td style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right; color: var(--text-muted);">${e.off_exchange.ovr_zscore_60d >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${e.off_exchange.ovr_zscore_60d.toFixed(2)}</td>
                    <td style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: center;"><span style="font-size: 9px; font-weight: 800; color: ${ovrMeta.color}; border: 1px solid ${ovrMeta.color}; border-radius: 3px; padding: 1px 5px;">${ovrMeta.label}</span></td>
                    <td style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right; color: #94a3b8;" title="Reference only — excluded from all scoring (Decision 2b)">${e.off_exchange.ats_share_pct_reference_only !== null ? e.off_exchange.ats_share_pct_reference_only.toFixed(1) + '%' : '—'} <span style="font-size: 8px; color: var(--text-muted);">ref</span></td>
                    <td style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right; color: var(--accent-cyan); font-weight: 600;">${e.block_cluster.bti_pct.toFixed(1)}%</td>
                    <td style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: center; color: ${imp.color}; font-weight: 700;">${imp.icon} ${e.block_cluster.signed_impression.slice(0, 4)}</td>
                    <td style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right; color: var(--text-muted);">${e.fragmentation.liquidity_fragmentation_index.toFixed(3)}</td>
                    <td style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right; color: var(--accent-purple); font-weight: 700;">${(e.composite_stealth_liquidity_score * 100).toFixed(0)}</td>
                    <td style="padding: 6px 8px; font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted);">${e.primary_liquidity_concern.replace(/_/g, ' ')}</td>
                    <td style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: center;">${flag ? '<span style="font-size: 9px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--accent-red); border: 1px solid var(--accent-red); border-radius: 3px; padding: 1px 5px;">P24</span>' : '<span style="font-size: 9px; color: var(--text-muted);">—</span>'}</td>
                </tr>`;
            }).join('');

            const tableHtml = `
            <div style="background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px; margin-bottom: 16px; overflow-x: auto;">
                <h3 style="font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--text-primary); margin-bottom: 10px;">🕶️ Off-Exchange Liquidity Dossier <span style="font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-muted);">(sorted by composite stealth-liquidity score)</span></h3>
                <table style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 11.5px;">
                    <thead><tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);">
                        <th style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: left; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">Symbol</th>
                        <th style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">OVR</th>
                        <th style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">z(60d)</th>
                        <th style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: center; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">Regime</th>
                        <th style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">ATS Share</th>
                        <th style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">BTI</th>
                        <th style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: center; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">Block Impression</th>
                        <th style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">LFI</th>
                        <th style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">Stealth</th>
                        <th style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: left; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">Primary Concern</th>
                        <th style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: center; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">Sentinel</th>
                    </tr></thead>
                    <tbody>${rows}</tbody>
                </table>
            </div>`;

            // DECISION 1(b): short metrics are entitlement-gated and absent from this payload.
            const gate = b.entitlement_gate || {};
            const lockedHtml = `
            <div style="background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px dashed rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.45); border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px; margin-bottom: 16px;">
                <h3 style="font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--accent-purple); margin-bottom: 8px;">🔒 Short Activity Triad — Research-Only Entitlement Required</h3>
                <div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.65;">
                    Short volume ratio, short interest ratio, days-to-cover and the multi-factor squeeze composite are
                    <strong>not present in this payload</strong>. License class:
                    <code style="background: var(--bg-primary); padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 3px; color: var(--accent-purple);">${gate.short_metrics_license_class || 'RESEARCH_ONLY_NON_COMMERCIAL'}</code>.
                    Commercial redistribution is <strong>not permitted</strong> because the FINRA Daily Short Sale Volume file is licensed for non-commercial use only.
                    <br/><br/>
                    <strong>Analytical caveat:</strong> short volume ratio is measured against <em>off-exchange</em> volume and is not consolidated with exchange prints.
                    Market makers internalizing retail flow book the offsetting side as short, so an elevated reading is normal rather than bearish.
                    Where entitled, these metrics are scored only against each security's own 60-day distribution &mdash; never an absolute threshold.
                </div>
            </div>`;

            const statutoryHtml = `
            <div style="background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.06); border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.25); border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 14px;">
                <div style="font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; color: #f59e0b; margin-bottom: 6px;">⚖️ STATUTORY RESEARCH NOTICE &amp; DATA ATTRIBUTION</div>
                <ul style="margin: 0 0 8px 0; padding-left: 18px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.6;">
                    ${(b.disclaimers || []).map(d => `<li>${d}</li>`).join('')}
                </ul>
                <ul style="margin: 0; padding-left: 18px; font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.6;">
                    ${((gate.attribution) || []).map(a => `<li>${a}</li>`).join('')}
                </ul>
                <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 8px;">Feed generated: ${b.generated_at} · As of ${b.as_of_date}</div>
            </div>`;

            container.innerHTML = `${kpiHtml}${chartHtml}${tableHtml}${lockedHtml}${statutoryHtml}`;
        }

        // Predicate 24 confluence test, mirrored client-side for display only.
        // ATS share is deliberately NOT part of this test (Decision 2b).
        function flag24(e) {
            return e.off_exchange.ovr_pct > 60.0
                && e.off_exchange.ovr_zscore_60d > 1.5
                && e.block_cluster.signed_impression === 'DISTRIBUTION'
                && e.block_cluster.rangebound_near_resistance;
        }

        // =========================================================================
        // PHASE 33: MULTI-HORIZON VOLATILITY FORECASTING & VARIANCE RISK PREMIUM LAB
        //
        // LICENSING: VRP is computed from internally derived IV (Phase 30) and
        // platform-computed RV. No third-party index value is referenced anywhere.
        // =========================================================================
        let volVrpBundle = null;
        let activeVrpMarketFilter = 'ALL'; // 'ALL' | 'US' | 'CA'

        async function loadVolVrpAndRender() {
            try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/volatility_vrp.json');
                if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
                volVrpBundle = await res.json();
            } catch (err) {
                console.warn('Direct fetch /api/volatility_vrp.json failed, trying extensionless route:', err);
                try {
                    const res2 = await fetch('/api/volatility_vrp');
                    if (!res2.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res2.status);
                    volVrpBundle = await res2.json();
                } catch (err2) {
                    console.error('All fetches for volatility_vrp failed:', err2);
                    const container = document.getElementById('volVrpContainer');
                    if (container) {
                        container.innerHTML = '<div style="padding: 24px; color: var(--accent-red);">Failed to load the Volatility &amp; VRP feed. Please ensure the data service is operational.</div>';
                    }
                    return;
                }
            }
            renderVolVrpView();
        }

        function refreshVolVrpData() {
            volVrpBundle = null;
            const container = document.getElementById('volVrpContainer');
            if (container) {
                container.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align: center; padding: 40px; color: var(--text-muted);"><div class="spinner" style="margin-right: 8px;"></div> Re-fitting realized volatility estimators, GARCH-family MLE, and HAR-RV cascades...</div>';
            }
            loadVolVrpAndRender();
        }

        function setVrpMarketFilter(mkt) {
            activeVrpMarketFilter = mkt;
            ['ALL', 'US', 'CA'].forEach(m => {
                const btn = document.getElementById('btnVrpMkt' + m);
                if (btn) btn.classList.toggle('active', m === mkt);
            });
            renderVolVrpView();
        }

        const VRP_REGIME_META = {
            'LOW':      { color: 'var(--accent-cyan)',  label: 'LOW' },
            'NORMAL':   { color: 'var(--accent-green)', label: 'NORMAL' },
            'ELEVATED': { color: '#f59e0b',             label: 'ELEVATED' },
            'CRISIS':   { color: 'var(--accent-red)',   label: 'CRISIS' }
        };

        const VRP_EDGE_META = {
            'FAVOURABLE': { color: 'var(--accent-green)', label: 'FAVOURABLE' },
            'NEUTRAL':    { color: 'var(--text-muted)',   label: 'NEUTRAL' },
            'ADVERSE':    { color: 'var(--accent-red)',   label: 'ADVERSE' }
        };

        // Diverging bar chart for VRP: positive = sellers historically compensated.
        function buildVrpChart(entries) {
            const withVrp = entries.filter(e => e.vrp && e.vrp.available);
            if (withVrp.length === 0) {
                return '<div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); padding: 12px;">No symbols with a Phase 30 options surface in the current filter.</div>';
            }
            const W = 920, rowH = 24, padL = 62, padR = 84, padT = 26, padB = 22;
            const H = padT + padB + withVrp.length * rowH;
            const axisX = padL + (W - padL - padR) / 2;
            const maxAbs = Math.max.apply(null, withVrp.map(e => Math.abs(e.vrp.vrp_variance_pts)).concat([50]));
            const halfW = (W - padL - padR) / 2;

            let rows = '';
            withVrp.forEach((e, i) => {
                const y = padT + i * rowH;
                const v = e.vrp.vrp_variance_pts;
                const w = (Math.abs(v) / maxAbs) * halfW;
                const color = v >= 0 ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-red)';
                const x = v >= 0 ? axisX : axisX - w;
                rows += `
                <text x="${padL - 8}" y="${y + rowH / 2 + 4}" text-anchor="end" font-size="10.5" fill="#cbd5e1" font-weight="700">${e.symbol}</text>
                <rect x="${x.toFixed(1)}" y="${y + 5}" width="${Math.max(w, 1).toFixed(1)}" height="${rowH - 10}" fill="${color}" opacity="0.82" rx="2"/>
                <text x="${(v >= 0 ? axisX + w + 6 : axisX - w - 6).toFixed(1)}" y="${y + rowH / 2 + 4}" text-anchor="${v >= 0 ? 'start' : 'end'}" font-size="10" fill="#e2e8f0" font-weight="700">${v >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${v.toFixed(0)}</text>`;
            });

            return `
            <svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" style="width: 100%; height: auto; max-width: 920px; display: block;">
                <text x="${padL}" y="14" font-size="10" fill="#94a3b8">VRP = IV² − RV² in annualized variance points &mdash; green = sellers historically compensated, red = realized exceeding implied</text>
                <line x1="${axisX}" y1="${padT - 4}" x2="${axisX}" y2="${H - padB}" stroke="rgba(148,163,184,0.55)" stroke-width="1"/>
                <text x="${axisX}" y="${H - padB + 14}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9.5" fill="#94a3b8">0</text>
                ${rows}
            </svg>`;
        }

        function renderVolVrpView() {
            if (!volVrpBundle) return;
            const container = document.getElementById('volVrpContainer');
            if (!container) return;
            const b = volVrpBundle;

            let entries = Object.values(b.dossiers || {});
            if (activeVrpMarketFilter !== 'ALL') {
                entries = entries.filter(e => e.country === activeVrpMarketFilter);
            }
            entries.sort((x, y) => {
                const xv = (x.vrp && x.vrp.available) ? x.vrp.vrp_variance_pts : -1e9;
                const yv = (y.vrp && y.vrp.available) ? y.vrp.vrp_variance_pts : -1e9;
                return xv - yv;  // most adverse first
            });

            // Sentinel badge from the shipped regime labels.
            const badge = document.getElementById('volVrpSentinelBadge');
            if (badge) {
                const crisis = entries.filter(e => e.regime.regime === 'CRISIS');
                const adverse = entries.filter(e => e.vrp && e.vrp.available && e.vrp.seller_edge === 'ADVERSE');
                const n = crisis.length + adverse.length;
                if (n > 0) {
                    badge.style.color = 'var(--accent-red)';
                    badge.innerHTML = `<span style="display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; background: var(--accent-red); border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent-red);"></span> P26/P27 WATCH (${n})`;
                } else {
                    badge.style.color = 'var(--accent-green)';
                    badge.innerHTML = `<span style="display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; background: var(--accent-green); border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent-green);"></span> VOL NOMINAL`;
                }
            }

            const kpi = (label, value, sub, color) => `
                <div style="flex: 1 1 165px; background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px;">
                    <div style="font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.5px;">${label}</div>
                    <div style="font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; color: ${color}; margin-top: 4px;">${value}</div>
                    ${sub ? `<div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 2px;">${sub}</div>` : ''}
                </div>`;

            const medianVrp = b.median_vrp_variance_pts;
            const kpiHtml = `
            <div style="display: flex; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 16px;">
                ${kpi('Median Realized Vol', b.median_realized_vol_pct.toFixed(2) + '%', 'Parkinson, annualized', 'var(--accent-cyan)')}
                ${kpi('Median VRP', medianVrp !== null && medianVrp !== undefined ? (medianVrp > 0 ? '+' : '') + medianVrp.toFixed(0) + ' pts' : 'n/a', 'IV² − RV² variance points', medianVrp >= 0 ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-red)')}
                ${kpi('VRP Coverage', `${b.vrp_coverage_count} / ${b.universe_count}`, 'symbols with options surface', 'var(--accent-purple)')}
                ${kpi('Return Window', String((entries[0] && entries[0].realized.bars_used) || 0) + ' bars', (entries[0] ? entries[0].return_window_start + ' → ' + entries[0].return_window_end : ''), 'var(--text-muted)')}
            </div>`;

            const chartHtml = `
            <div style="background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px; margin-bottom: 16px;">
                <h3 style="font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--text-primary); margin-bottom: 8px;">⚖️ Variance Risk Premium by Security</h3>
                ${buildVrpChart(entries)}
            </div>`;

            const rows = entries.map(e => {
                const best = e.model_selection;
                const reg = VRP_REGIME_META[e.regime.regime] || VRP_REGIME_META['NORMAL'];
                const hl = best.fits.find(f => f.variant === best.best_variant);
                const vrpCell = (e.vrp && e.vrp.available)
                    ? `<td style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right; color: var(--text-muted);">${e.vrp.implied_vol_pct.toFixed(1)}%</td>
                       <td style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right; color: ${e.vrp.vrp_variance_pts >= 0 ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-red)'}; font-weight: 700;">${e.vrp.vrp_variance_pts > 0 ? '+' : ''}${e.vrp.vrp_variance_pts.toFixed(0)}</td>
                       <td style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: center;"><span style="font-size: 9px; font-weight: 800; color: ${(VRP_EDGE_META[e.vrp.seller_edge] || VRP_EDGE_META['NEUTRAL']).color}; border: 1px solid ${(VRP_EDGE_META[e.vrp.seller_edge] || VRP_EDGE_META['NEUTRAL']).color}; border-radius: 3px; padding: 1px 5px;">${(VRP_EDGE_META[e.vrp.seller_edge] || VRP_EDGE_META['NEUTRAL']).label}</span></td>`
                    : `<td style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right; color: var(--text-muted);">—</td>
                       <td style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right; color: var(--text-muted);">—</td>
                       <td style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: center; font-size: 9px; color: var(--text-muted);">no options</td>`;

                return `<tr>
                    <td style="padding: 6px 8px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-primary);">${e.symbol} <span style="font-size: 9px; color: var(--text-muted);">${e.country}</span></td>
                    <td style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right; color: var(--text-muted);">${e.realized.close_to_close_pct.toFixed(1)}</td>
                    <td style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right; color: var(--accent-cyan); font-weight: 700;">${e.realized.parkinson_pct.toFixed(1)}</td>
                    <td style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right; color: var(--text-muted);">${e.realized.garman_klass_pct.toFixed(1)}</td>
                    <td style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right; color: var(--text-muted);">${e.realized.yang_zhang_pct.toFixed(1)}</td>
                    <td style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: center; font-size: 10px; color: var(--accent-purple); font-weight: 700;">${best.best_variant.replace('_1_1', '(1,1)')}</td>
                    <td style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right; color: var(--text-muted);">${hl ? hl.persistence.toFixed(3) : '—'}</td>
                    <td style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right; color: var(--text-muted);">${hl && hl.half_life_days !== null ? hl.half_life_days.toFixed(1) + 'd' : '—'}</td>
                    <td style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right; color: var(--accent-cyan);">${e.har_rv.forecast_1d_pct.toFixed(1)} / ${e.har_rv.forecast_5d_pct.toFixed(1)} / ${e.har_rv.forecast_22d_pct.toFixed(1)}</td>
                    <td style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: center;"><span style="font-size: 9px; font-weight: 800; color: ${reg.color}; border: 1px solid ${reg.color}; border-radius: 3px; padding: 1px 5px;">${reg.label}</span></td>
                    <td style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right; color: var(--text-muted);">${e.regime.baseline_ratio.toFixed(2)}x</td>
                    ${vrpCell}
                </tr>`;
            }).join('');

            const tableHtml = `
            <div style="background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px; margin-bottom: 16px; overflow-x: auto;">
                <h3 style="font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--text-primary); margin-bottom: 10px;">📊 Volatility Term Structure &amp; VRP Dossier <span style="font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-muted);">(realized volatility in % annualized · sorted most adverse VRP first)</span></h3>
                <table style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 11.5px;">
                    <thead><tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);">
                        <th style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: left; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">Symbol</th>
                        <th style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">RV C-C</th>
                        <th style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">RV Park</th>
                        <th style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">RV G-K</th>
                        <th style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">RV Y-Z</th>
                        <th style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: center; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">Best Model (AIC)</th>
                        <th style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">Persistence</th>
                        <th style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">Half-Life</th>
                        <th style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">HAR 1D/5D/22D</th>
                        <th style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: center; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">Regime</th>
                        <th style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">Cond/Base</th>
                        <th style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">IV 30D</th>
                        <th style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">VRP pts</th>
                        <th style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: center; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">Seller Edge</th>
                    </tr></thead>
                    <tbody>${rows}</tbody>
                </table>
                <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 10px; line-height: 1.6;">
                    <strong>Persistence</strong> = α + β (+ γ/2 for GJR); values near 1.0 indicate slow-decaying volatility.
                    <strong>Half-life</strong> = ln(0.5)/ln(persistence), the days for a volatility shock to halve.
                    <strong>HAR</strong> = Corsi (2009) cascade forecasts. <strong>Cond/Base</strong> = GARCH conditional vol ÷ trailing 20-day baseline; Predicate 27 fires above 2.00x.
                </div>
            </div>`;

            const statutoryHtml = `
            <div style="background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.06); border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.25); border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 14px;">
                <div style="font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; color: #f59e0b; margin-bottom: 6px;">⚖️ STATUTORY RESEARCH NOTICE &amp; MODEL RISK</div>
                <ul style="margin: 0; padding-left: 18px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.6;">
                    ${(b.disclaimers || []).map(d => `<li>${d}</li>`).join('')}
                </ul>
                <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 8px;">Feed generated: ${b.generated_at} · As of ${b.as_of_date} · Cboe index reference free: ${b.cboe_index_reference_free}</div>
            </div>`;

            container.innerHTML = `${kpiHtml}${chartHtml}${tableHtml}${statutoryHtml}`;
        }


        // =========================================================================
        // PHASE 34.5: EXECUTION GATEWAY, PRE-TRADE RISK & AOS ATTESTATION
        //
        // Reports execution telemetry only. Makes no profitability claim.
        // The kill switch is displayed READ-ONLY: this is a static Firebase-hosted
        // front end with no backend, so a control here could not actually engage the
        // switch. Presenting one that appeared to work would be fabrication, so the
        // operator command is shown instead.
        // =========================================================================
        let execBundle = null;

        async function loadExecutionAndRender() {
            let data = null;
            for (const url of ['/api/execution_gateway.json', '/api/execution_gateway']) {
                try {
                    const res = await fetch(url);
                    if (res.ok) { data = await res.json(); break; }
                } catch (err) { /* try the next route */ }
            }
            if (!data) {
                execBundle = null;
                const c = document.getElementById('execContainer');
                if (c) c.innerHTML = '<div style="padding: 24px; color: var(--accent-red);">Failed to load the execution gateway feed. Ensure the data service is operational.</div>';
                const b = document.getElementById('execAosBadge');
                if (b) b.textContent = 'AOS: FEED UNAVAILABLE';
                return;
            }
            execBundle = data;
            renderExecutionView();
        }

        function refreshExecutionData() { execBundle = null; loadExecutionAndRender(); }

        function execStat(label, value, color) {
            const col = color || 'var(--text-primary)';
            return '<div style="background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 14px;">'
                 + '<div style="font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.5px;">' + label + '</div>'
                 + '<div style="font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; color: ' + col + '; margin-top: 4px;">' + value + '</div></div>';
        }

        function renderExecutionView() {
            if (!execBundle) { loadExecutionAndRender(); return; }
            const d = execBundle;
            const sess = d.session || {};
            const p28 = d.predicate_28 || {};
            const ks = d.kill_switch || {};
            const aos = d.aos_attestation;
            const out = [];

            // ---- AOS badge in the header -------------------------------------
            const badge = document.getElementById('execAosBadge');
            if (badge) {
                if (!aos) {
                    badge.textContent = 'AOS: NEVER ATTESTED';
                    badge.style.color = 'var(--accent-red)';
                    badge.style.borderColor = 'rgba(239,68,68,0.3)';
                    badge.style.background = 'rgba(239,68,68,0.15)';
                } else if (aos.expired) {
                    badge.textContent = 'AOS: EXPIRED ' + Math.abs(aos.days_until_expiry) + 'd AGO';
                    badge.style.color = 'var(--accent-red)';
                    badge.style.borderColor = 'rgba(239,68,68,0.3)';
                    badge.style.background = 'rgba(239,68,68,0.15)';
                } else {
                    badge.textContent = 'AOS: CURRENT · ' + aos.days_until_expiry + 'd TO RE-TEST';
                    badge.style.color = aos.passed ? 'var(--accent-green)' : '#f59e0b';
                    badge.style.borderColor = aos.passed ? 'rgba(16,185,129,0.3)' : 'rgba(245,158,11,0.3)';
                    badge.style.background = aos.passed ? 'rgba(16,185,129,0.15)' : 'rgba(245,158,11,0.15)';
                }
            }

            // ---- Predicate 28 badge in the header ----------------------------
            const pb = document.getElementById('execPredicateBadge');
            if (pb) {
                const sev = p28.severity;
                const col = !p28.fired ? 'var(--accent-green)' : (sev === 'CRITICAL' ? 'var(--accent-red)' : '#f59e0b');
                const txt = !p28.fired ? 'P28 NOMINAL' : ('P28 ' + sev);
                pb.style.color = col;
                pb.innerHTML = '<span style="display:inline-block;width:8px;height:8px;background:' + col
                             + ';border-radius:50%;"></span> ' + txt;
            }

            // ---- Session telemetry -------------------------------------------
            out.push('<div style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--text-primary); margin-bottom: 8px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.5px;">Session Telemetry &mdash; ' + (sess.session || 'n/a') + ' UTC</div>');
            out.push('<div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(140px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 20px;">');
            out.push(execStat('Evaluations', sess.evaluations || 0));
            out.push(execStat('Distinct Orders', sess.orders || 0));
            out.push(execStat('Hard Rejections', sess.hard_rejections || 0, (sess.hard_rejections || 0) > 3 ? 'var(--accent-red)' : 'var(--text-primary)'));
            out.push(execStat('Soft Limits', sess.soft_limits || 0, (sess.soft_limits || 0) > 0 ? '#f59e0b' : 'var(--text-primary)'));
            out.push(execStat('Approved', sess.approvals || 0, 'var(--accent-green)'));
            out.push(execStat('Submitted Notional', '$' + Math.round(sess.submitted_notional_usd || 0).toLocaleString()));
            out.push(execStat('Rejected Notional', '$' + Math.round(sess.rejected_notional_usd || 0).toLocaleString(), (sess.rejected_notional_usd || 0) > 0 ? 'var(--accent-red)' : 'var(--text-primary)'));
            out.push(execStat('Rejected Share', ((sess.rejected_share || 0) * 100).toFixed(1) + '%', (sess.rejected_share || 0) > 0.25 ? 'var(--accent-red)' : 'var(--text-primary)'));
            out.push('</div>');

            const controls = sess.breached_controls || {};
            const controlKeys = Object.keys(controls);
            out.push('<div style="background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 14px; margin-bottom: 20px;">');
            out.push('<div style="font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--text-primary); margin-bottom: 6px;">CONTROLS THAT BREACHED THIS SESSION</div>');
            if (!controlKeys.length) {
                out.push('<div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--accent-green);">No control breached. Every evaluated order cleared all twelve pre-trade controls.</div>');
            } else {
                out.push('<div style="display: flex; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap;">');
                controlKeys.forEach(function (k) {
                    out.push('<span class="exchange-tag" style="background: rgba(239,68,68,0.12); color: var(--accent-red); border-color: rgba(239,68,68,0.3); font-weight: 700;">' + k + ' &times;' + controls[k] + '</span>');
                });
                out.push('</div>');
            }
            out.push('</div>');

            // ---- Predicate 28 ------------------------------------------------
            const th = p28.thresholds || {};
            out.push('<div style="border: 1px solid ' + (p28.fired ? (p28.severity === 'CRITICAL' ? 'rgba(239,68,68,0.4)' : 'rgba(245,158,11,0.4)') : 'var(--border-color)') + '; background: var(--bg-card); border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px; margin-bottom: 20px;">');
            out.push('<div style="display:flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items:center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 8px;">');
            out.push('<div style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--text-primary);">PREDICATE 28 &mdash; PRE_TRADE_RISK_BREACH</div>');
            out.push('<span class="exchange-tag" style="font-weight:700; background:' + (p28.fired ? 'rgba(239,68,68,0.15)' : 'rgba(16,185,129,0.15)') + '; color:' + (p28.fired ? 'var(--accent-red)' : 'var(--accent-green)') + '; border-color:' + (p28.fired ? 'rgba(239,68,68,0.3)' : 'rgba(16,185,129,0.3)') + ';">' + (p28.fired ? 'FIRED · ' + p28.severity : 'NOT FIRED') + '</span>');
            out.push('</div>');
            out.push('<div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.6; margin-bottom: 8px;">Fires when the risk governor is repeatedly refusing what the signal engine generates &mdash; a strategy/risk <em>alignment</em> finding. Thresholds: more than <strong>' + th.hard_rejection_trigger + '</strong> hard rejections, <strong>or</strong> rejected notional above <strong>' + Math.round((th.rejected_notional_share || 0) * 100) + '%</strong> of submitted; escalates to CRITICAL above <strong>' + th.critical_rejections + '</strong> rejections. Boundaries are <strong>exclusive</strong> &mdash; sitting exactly on one does not fire.</div>');
            if (p28.fired) {
                out.push('<div style="background: rgba(239,68,68,0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(239,68,68,0.25); border-radius: 6px; padding: 10px 12px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.6;"><strong style="color: var(--accent-red);">' + (p28.headline || '') + '</strong><br>' + (p28.body || '') + '</div>');
                out.push('<div style="margin-top: 8px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: #f59e0b;">ACTION REQUIRED: ' + (p28.action_required || '') + '</div>');
            }
            out.push('</div>');

            // ---- Kill switch (read-only) -------------------------------------
            const scopes = ks.active_scopes || [];
            out.push('<div style="border: 1px solid ' + (ks.halted ? 'rgba(239,68,68,0.45)' : 'var(--border-color)') + '; background: var(--bg-card); border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px; margin-bottom: 20px;">');
            out.push('<div style="display:flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items:center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 8px;">');
            out.push('<div style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--text-primary);">KILL SWITCH</div>');
            out.push('<span class="exchange-tag" style="font-weight:700; background:' + (ks.halted ? 'rgba(239,68,68,0.15)' : 'rgba(16,185,129,0.15)') + '; color:' + (ks.halted ? 'var(--accent-red)' : 'var(--accent-green)') + '; border-color:' + (ks.halted ? 'rgba(239,68,68,0.3)' : 'rgba(16,185,129,0.3)') + ';">' + (ks.halted ? 'HALTED' : 'ROUTING ENABLED') + '</span>');
            out.push('</div>');
            if (scopes.length) {
                out.push('<div style="display:flex; gap:6px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-bottom:8px;">');
                scopes.forEach(function (sc) { out.push('<span class="exchange-tag" style="background: rgba(239,68,68,0.12); color: var(--accent-red); border-color: rgba(239,68,68,0.3); font-weight:700;">' + sc + '</span>'); });
                out.push('</div>');
            } else {
                out.push('<div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 8px;">No scope engaged. ' + (ks.events_recorded || 0) + ' event(s) on the audit log.</div>');
            }
            out.push('<div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.6; background: rgba(100,116,139,0.08); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 10px;">Read-only by design. This is a static front end with no backend, so no control here could actually engage the switch. Operators engage it from the platform host: <code style="color: var(--accent-cyan);">KillSwitch().engage("ALL", reason="...")</code> &mdash; scopes <code>ALL</code>, <code>EXTERNAL_ONLY</code>, <code>SYMBOL:&lt;x&gt;</code>, <code>STRATEGY:&lt;y&gt;</code>. <code>EXTERNAL_ONLY</code> falls through to the internal simulator rather than halting.</div>');
            out.push('</div>');

            // ---- Adapter inventory -------------------------------------------
            const adapters = d.adapters || [];
            out.push('<div style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--text-primary); margin-bottom: 8px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.5px;">Adapter Inventory</div>');
            out.push('<div style="background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; overflow-x: auto; margin-bottom: 12px;"><table style="width:100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 11px;">');
            out.push('<thead><tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color); color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.5px;">'
                   + '<th style="text-align:left; padding: 8px 12px;">Adapter</th><th style="text-align:left; padding: 8px 12px;">External</th>'
                   + '<th style="text-align:left; padding: 8px 12px;">Licence</th><th style="text-align:left; padding: 8px 12px;">Configured</th>'
                   + '<th style="text-align:left; padding: 8px 12px;">Markets</th><th style="text-align:left; padding: 8px 12px;">Order Types</th></tr></thead><tbody>');
            adapters.forEach(function (a) {
                const ext = a.is_external ? '<span style="color: var(--accent-red); font-weight:700;">YES</span>' : '<span style="color: var(--accent-green); font-weight:700;">NO</span>';
                const lic = a.license_cleared ? '<span style="color: var(--accent-green); font-weight:700;">CLEARED</span>' : '<span style="color: var(--accent-red); font-weight:700;">NOT CLEARED</span>';
                const cfg = a.configured ? '<span style="color: var(--accent-green);">yes</span>' : '<span style="color: var(--accent-red);">no</span>';
                out.push('<tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);">'
                       + '<td style="padding: 8px 12px; font-weight:700; color: var(--text-primary);">' + a.adapter_id + '</td>'
                       + '<td style="padding: 8px 12px;">' + ext + '</td>'
                       + '<td style="padding: 8px 12px;">' + lic + '</td>'
                       + '<td style="padding: 8px 12px;">' + cfg + '</td>'
                       + '<td style="padding: 8px 12px; color: var(--text-muted);">' + (a.markets || []).join(', ') + '</td>'
                       + '<td style="padding: 8px 12px; color: var(--text-muted);">' + (a.order_types || []).join(', ') + '</td></tr>');
            });
            out.push('</tbody></table></div>');
            out.push('<div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--accent-green); font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 20px;">External adapters registered: ' + (d.external_adapters_registered || 0) + ' &middot; Canadian external routing permitted: <span style="color: var(--accent-red);">NO</span></div>');

            // ---- AOS attestation ---------------------------------------------
            out.push('<div style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--text-primary); margin-bottom: 8px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.5px;">Annual AOS Attestation &mdash; CIRO Policy 7.1 Part 8</div>');
            if (!aos) {
                out.push('<div style="background: rgba(239,68,68,0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(239,68,68,0.3); border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--accent-red); margin-bottom: 20px;">No attestation on record. Policy 7.1 Part 8 requires the automated order system to be tested at least annually with a written record.</div>');
            } else {
                const col = aos.expired ? 'var(--accent-red)' : (aos.passed ? 'var(--accent-green)' : '#f59e0b');
                const state = aos.expired ? 'EXPIRED' : (aos.passed ? 'CURRENT · PASSED' : 'CURRENT · FAILED');
