                out.push('<div style="border: 1px solid ' + (aos.expired ? 'rgba(239,68,68,0.4)' : 'var(--border-color)') + '; background: var(--bg-card); border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px; margin-bottom: 20px;">');
                out.push('<div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px; margin-bottom:10px;">');
                out.push('<span class="exchange-tag" style="font-weight:700; background: rgba(100,116,139,0.12); color:' + col + '; border-color: var(--border-color);">' + state + '</span>');
                out.push('<span style="font-size:11px; color: var(--text-muted);">' + aos.days_until_expiry + ' day(s) until re-test due</span>');
                out.push('</div>');
                out.push('<div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(150px, 1fr)); gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 10px;">');
                out.push(execStat('Attested', String(aos.attested_at || '').slice(0, 10)));
                out.push(execStat('Controls Covered', aos.controls_with_tests + '/' + aos.controls_registered, aos.controls_with_tests === aos.controls_registered ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-red)'));
                out.push(execStat('Kill Switch Verified', aos.kill_switch_verified ? 'YES' : 'NO', aos.kill_switch_verified ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-red)'));
                out.push(execStat('Tests Passed', aos.tests_passed, 'var(--accent-green)'));
                out.push(execStat('Tests Failed', aos.tests_failed, aos.tests_failed === 0 ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-red)'));
                out.push(execStat('Code Version', String(aos.code_version || '').slice(0, 10)));
                out.push('</div>');
                out.push('<div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.6; background: rgba(100,116,139,0.08); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 10px;">' + (aos.scope_note || '') + '</div>');
                out.push('</div>');
            }

            // ---- Disclaimers --------------------------------------------------
            const dis = d.disclaimers || [];
            if (dis.length) {
                out.push('<div style="background: rgba(100,116,139,0.07); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 14px;"><div style="font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 6px;">DISCLOSURES</div><ul style="margin:0; padding-left: 18px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.7;">');
                dis.forEach(function (t) { out.push('<li>' + t + '</li>'); });
                out.push('</ul></div>');
            }
            out.push('<div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 12px; text-align: right;">Feed generated ' + (d.generated_at || 'n/a') + ' &middot; session ' + (d.as_of_date || 'n/a') + '</div>');

            const c = document.getElementById('execContainer');
            if (c) c.innerHTML = out.join('');
        }

        function switchTab(tabId, ev) {
            document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove('active'));
            if (ev && ev.currentTarget) {
                ev.currentTarget.classList.add('active');
            } else {
                const targetBtn = document.querySelector(`.tab-btn[data-tab="${tabId}"]`);
                if (targetBtn) targetBtn.classList.add('active');
            }

            const tabIds = [
                'leaderboard', 'quantintel', 'macroregime', 'microstructure', 'portfoliohrp', 'crossborderfx', 'optionssurface', 'sovereigncurve', 'darkpool', 'volatilityvrp', 'execution', 'scanners', 'signals', 'backtest', 'paper',
                'portfolio', 'alerts', 'deepread', 'production', 'catalysts', 'journal'
            ];
            tabIds.forEach(id => {
                const el = document.getElementById(`tab-${id}`);
                if (el) el.style.display = (id === tabId) ? 'block' : 'none';
            });

            // Pause SSE stream when switching away from microstructure tab
            if (tabId !== 'microstructure') {
                stopMicroStreaming();
            }

            if (tabId === 'quantintel') {
                if (!quantIntelBundle) {
                    loadQuantIntelAndRender();
                } else {
                    renderQuantIntelView();
                }
            } else if (tabId === 'macroregime') {
                if (!macroRegimeBundle) {
                    loadMacroRegimeAndRender();
                } else {
                    renderMacroRegimeView();
                }
            } else if (tabId === 'microstructure') {
                if (!microstructureBundle) {
                    loadMicrostructureAndRender();
                } else {
                    renderMicrostructureView();
                    startMicroStreaming();
                }
            } else if (tabId === 'portfoliohrp') {
                if (!portfolioHrpBundle || !portfolioStressBundle || !portfolioOrchestratorBundle || !factorRiskBundle || !factorAttribBundle || !portfolioBayesianBundle) {
                    loadPortfolioHrpAndRender();
                } else {
                    renderPortfolioHrpView();
                }
            } else if (tabId === 'crossborderfx') {
                if (!crossBorderFxBundle) {
                    loadCrossBorderFxAndRender();
                } else {
                    renderCrossBorderFxView();
                }
            } else if (tabId === 'optionssurface') {
                if (!optionsBundle) {
                    loadOptionsAndRender();
                } else {
                    renderOptionsView();
                }
            } else if (tabId === 'sovereigncurve') {
                if (!sovereignBundle) {
                    loadSovereignCurveAndRender();
                } else {
                    renderSovereignCurveView();
                }
            } else if (tabId === 'darkpool') {
                if (!darkPoolBundle) {
                    loadDarkPoolAndRender();
                } else {
                    renderDarkPoolView();
                }
            } else if (tabId === 'execution') {
                if (!execBundle) {
                    loadExecutionAndRender();
                } else {
                    renderExecutionView();
                }
            } else if (tabId === 'volatilityvrp') {
                if (!volVrpBundle) {
                    loadVolVrpAndRender();
                } else {
                    renderVolVrpView();
                }
            } else if (tabId === 'backtest') {
                if (!backtestBundle) {
                    loadBacktestsAndRender();
                } else {
                    setTimeout(() => renderBacktestView(), 40);
                }
            } else if (tabId === 'paper') {
                if (!paperBundle) {
                    loadPaperAndRender();
                } else {
                    renderPaperView();
                }
            } else if (tabId === 'portfolio') {
                if (!portfolioBundle) {
                    loadPortfolioAndRender();
                } else {
                    renderPortfolioView();
                }
            } else if (tabId === 'alerts') {
                if (!alertsBundle) {
                    loadAlertsAndRender();
                } else {
                    renderAlertsView();
                }
            } else if (tabId === 'deepread') {
                if (!deepreadBundle) {
                    loadDeepreadAndRender();
                } else {
                    renderDeepreadView();
                }
            } else if (tabId === 'production') {
                if (!productionBundle) {
                    loadProductionAndRender();
                } else {
                    renderProductionView();
                }
            } else if (tabId === 'catalysts') {
                if (!catalystsBundle) {

                } else {

                }
            } else if (tabId === 'journal') {

        function toggleBacktestBenchmark(bm) {
            selectedBenchmarkKey = bm;
            const spyBtn = document.getElementById('bmSpyBtn');
            const xiuBtn = document.getElementById('bmXiuBtn');
            if (spyBtn) spyBtn.classList.toggle('active', bm === 'SPY');
            if (xiuBtn) xiuBtn.classList.toggle('active', bm === 'XIU');

            if (backtestBundle) {
                const currentStrat = backtestBundle.strategies[selectedStrategyId];
                if (currentStrat) {
                    document.getElementById('equityTitle').innerText = `${currentStrat.strategy_name} — Net Equity vs ${bm === 'SPY' ? 'SPY (S&P 500)' : 'XIU (TSX 60)'}`;
                    renderBacktestScorecards(currentStrat);
                    drawEquityCurve(currentStrat.equity_curve, currentStrat.config.train_cutoff, currentStrat.config.val_cutoff);
                }
            }
        }

        function getActiveStrategyTrades() {
            if (!backtestBundle || !backtestBundle.strategies) return [];
            const strat = backtestBundle.strategies[selectedStrategyId];
            if (!strat) return [];
            return strat.all_trades || strat.trades || strat.recent_trades || [];
        }

        function populateSymbolFilter(trades) {
            const sel = document.getElementById('btSymbolFilter');
            if (!sel) return;
            const curVal = sel.value || 'ALL';
            const symbols = Array.from(new Set(trades.map(t => t.symbol))).sort();
            
            let html = '<option value="ALL">All Securities (' + symbols.length + ')</option>';
            symbols.forEach(sym => {
                html += `<option value="${sym}">${sym}</option>`;
            });
            sel.innerHTML = html;
            if (symbols.includes(curVal)) {
                sel.value = curVal;
            } else {
                sel.value = 'ALL';
            }
        }

        function filterBacktestTrades() {
            const allTrades = getActiveStrategyTrades();
            const symbolFilter = document.getElementById('btSymbolFilter') ? document.getElementById('btSymbolFilter').value : 'ALL';
            const partFilter = document.getElementById('btPartitionFilter') ? document.getElementById('btPartitionFilter').value : 'ALL';
            const outcomeFilter = document.getElementById('btOutcomeFilter') ? document.getElementById('btOutcomeFilter').value : 'ALL';
            const exitFilter = document.getElementById('btExitFilter') ? document.getElementById('btExitFilter').value : 'ALL';

            btFilteredTrades = allTrades.filter(t => {
                if (symbolFilter !== 'ALL' && t.symbol !== symbolFilter) return false;
                if (partFilter !== 'ALL' && t.partition !== partFilter) return false;
                const netPnl = t.net_pnl_usd != null ? t.net_pnl_usd : (t.net_pnl || 0);
                if (outcomeFilter === 'WIN' && netPnl <= 0) return false;
                if (outcomeFilter === 'LOSS' && netPnl >= 0) return false;
                if (exitFilter !== 'ALL') {
                    if (exitFilter === 'PROFIT_TARGET_1') {
                        if (!t.exit_reason.includes('TARGET_1') && !t.exit_reason.includes('PROFIT_TARGET_1')) return false;
                    } else if (exitFilter === 'PROFIT_TARGET_2') {
                        if (!t.exit_reason.includes('TARGET_2') && !t.exit_reason.includes('PROFIT_TARGET_2')) return false;
                    } else if (t.exit_reason !== exitFilter) {
                        return false;
                    }
                }
                return true;
            });

            btCurrentPage = 1;
            renderTradeTablePage();
        }

        function renderTradeTablePage() {
            const tBody = document.getElementById('backtestTradeBody');
            if (!tBody) return;
            tBody.innerHTML = '';

            const totalFiltered = btFilteredTrades.length;
            const allTrades = getActiveStrategyTrades();

            // Update Summary Badge
            const badge = document.getElementById('tradeSummaryBadge');
            if (badge) {
                if (totalFiltered === 0) {
                    badge.innerText = 'No matching trades';
                    badge.style.color = 'var(--text-muted)';
                } else {
                    let winCount = 0;
                    let sumPnl = 0;
                    let sumR = 0;
                    btFilteredTrades.forEach(t => {
                        const net = t.net_pnl_usd != null ? t.net_pnl_usd : (t.net_pnl || 0);
                        if (net > 0) winCount++;
                        sumPnl += net;
                        sumR += (t.r_multiple || 0);
                    });
                    const wr = ((winCount / totalFiltered) * 100).toFixed(1);
                    const expR = (sumR / totalFiltered).toFixed(2);
                    const pnlFormatted = (sumPnl >= 0 ? '+$' : '-$') + Math.abs(sumPnl).toLocaleString(undefined, {minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2});
                    badge.innerHTML = `Showing <strong>${totalFiltered}</strong> of ${allTrades.length} trades · Win Rate: <strong>${wr}%</strong> · Net P&L: <strong style="color: ${sumPnl >= 0 ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-red)'}">${pnlFormatted}</strong> · Expectancy: <strong>${expR}R</strong>`;
                }
            }

            if (totalFiltered === 0) {
                tBody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="11" style="text-align: center; padding: 28px; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 13px;">No simulated trades match the selected filter criteria.</td></tr>`;
                renderBtPagination(0, 0, 0);
                return;
            }

            // Determine slice
            let startIdx = 0;
            let endIdx = totalFiltered;
            if (btPageSize !== 'ALL') {
                const size = parseInt(btPageSize, 10);
                startIdx = (btCurrentPage - 1) * size;
                endIdx = Math.min(startIdx + size, totalFiltered);
            }

            // Reverse order to show newest trades first
            const pageSlice = btFilteredTrades.slice().reverse().slice(startIdx, endIdx);

            pageSlice.forEach(t => {
                const netPnl = t.net_pnl_usd != null ? t.net_pnl_usd : (t.net_pnl || 0);
                const isWin = netPnl > 0;
                const pColor = t.partition === 'TRAIN' ? 'var(--accent-green)' : (t.partition === 'VALIDATION' ? 'var(--accent-purple)' : 'var(--accent-cyan)');
                
                let exitBadgeStyle = 'border-color: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.4); color: var(--text-secondary);';
                if (t.exit_reason.includes('PROFIT_TARGET') || t.exit_reason === 'TARGET_1' || t.exit_reason === 'TARGET_2') {
                    exitBadgeStyle = 'border-color: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.4); color: var(--accent-green); background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.08);';
                } else if (t.exit_reason === 'BREAKEVEN_STOP') {
                    exitBadgeStyle = 'border-color: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.5); color: var(--accent-blue); background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.12); font-weight: 700;';
                } else if (t.exit_reason === 'SAME_DAY_STOP') {
                    exitBadgeStyle = 'border-color: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.5); color: #f43f5e; background: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.1); font-weight: 700;';
                } else if (t.exit_reason === 'STOP_LOSS') {
                    exitBadgeStyle = 'border-color: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.4); color: var(--accent-red); background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.08);';
                } else if (t.exit_reason === 'TRAILING_STOP') {
                    exitBadgeStyle = 'border-color: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.4); color: var(--accent-cyan); background: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.08);';
                } else if (t.exit_reason.includes('EXPIRY') || t.exit_reason.includes('TIME')) {
                    exitBadgeStyle = 'border-color: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.4); color: var(--accent-amber); background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.08);';
                }

                const trimTag = t.is_partially_trimmed
                    ? `<span class="exchange-tag" style="background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15); color: var(--accent-green); border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.35); font-size: 9px; padding: 1px 4px; margin-left: 4px;" title="Banked +1.8R partial profit on 50% shares at Target 1">Trimmed T1</span>`
                    : '';

                const tr = document.createElement('tr');
                tr.style.borderBottom = '1px solid var(--border-color)';
                tr.style.cursor = 'pointer';
                tr.title = `Click to inspect quantitative dossier for ${t.symbol}`;
                tr.onclick = () => openSymbol(t.symbol);
                tr.innerHTML = `
                    <td style="padding: 10px 8px; font-family: monospace; font-size: 11px;">
                        <div>${t.entry_date}</div>
                        <div style="color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 10px;">→ ${t.exit_date || 'Active'}</div>
                    </td>
                    <td style="padding: 10px 8px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-primary);">
                        <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;">
                            <span>${t.symbol}</span>
                            <span class="exchange-tag" style="font-size: 10px;">${t.country}</span>
                        </div>
                    </td>
                    <td style="padding: 10px 8px;">
                        <span class="exchange-tag" style="background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15); color: var(--accent-green); font-size: 10px;">LONG</span>
                    </td>
                    <td style="padding: 10px 8px; font-family: monospace;">$${(t.entry_price || 0).toFixed(2)}</td>
                    <td style="padding: 10px 8px; font-family: monospace;">$${(t.exit_price || 0).toFixed(2)}</td>
                    <td style="padding: 10px 8px; color: var(--text-muted);">${t.holding_days}d</td>
                    <td style="padding: 10px 8px;">
                        <span class="exchange-tag" style="${exitBadgeStyle} font-size: 10px;">
                            ${t.exit_reason}
                        </span>
                        ${trimTag}
                    </td>
                    <td style="padding: 10px 8px; font-weight: 700; font-family: monospace; color: ${isWin ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-red)'};">
                        ${isWin ? '+' : ''}${(t.return_pct || 0).toFixed(2)}%
                    </td>
                    <td style="padding: 10px 8px; font-weight: 700; font-family: monospace; color: ${isWin ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-red)'};">
                        ${netPnl >= 0 ? '+$' : '-$'}${Math.abs(netPnl).toFixed(2)}
                    </td>
                    <td style="padding: 10px 8px; font-weight: 700; font-family: monospace; color: ${isWin ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-red)'};">
                        ${(t.r_multiple || 0) >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${(t.r_multiple || 0).toFixed(2)}R
                    </td>
                    <td style="padding: 10px 8px; color: ${pColor}; font-weight: 600; font-size: 11px;">${t.partition}</td>
                `;
                tBody.appendChild(tr);
            });

            renderBtPagination(totalFiltered, startIdx, endIdx);
        }

        function renderBtPagination(totalFiltered, startIdx, endIdx) {
            const ctrl = document.getElementById('btPaginationControls');
            if (!ctrl) return;
            if (totalFiltered === 0) {
                ctrl.innerHTML = '';
                return;
            }

            if (btPageSize === 'ALL') {
                ctrl.innerHTML = `<span style="font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted);">Showing all <strong>${totalFiltered}</strong> trades</span>`;
                return;
            }

            const size = parseInt(btPageSize, 10);
            const totalPages = Math.ceil(totalFiltered / size);
            
            let html = `
                <span style="font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted);">
                    Showing <strong>${startIdx + 1}–${endIdx}</strong> of <strong>${totalFiltered}</strong> trades
                </span>
                <div style="display: flex; gap: 6px; align-items: center;">
                    <button class="filter-btn" ${btCurrentPage <= 1 ? 'disabled style="opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed;"' : ''} onclick="goToBtPage(1)">« First</button>
                    <button class="filter-btn" ${btCurrentPage <= 1 ? 'disabled style="opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed;"' : ''} onclick="goToBtPage(${btCurrentPage - 1})">‹ Prev</button>
                    <span style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; padding: 0 8px; color: var(--text-primary);">Page ${btCurrentPage} of ${totalPages}</span>
                    <button class="filter-btn" ${btCurrentPage >= totalPages ? 'disabled style="opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed;"' : ''} onclick="goToBtPage(${btCurrentPage + 1})">Next ›</button>
                    <button class="filter-btn" ${btCurrentPage >= totalPages ? 'disabled style="opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed;"' : ''} onclick="goToBtPage(${totalPages})">Last »</button>
                </div>
            `;
            ctrl.innerHTML = html;
        }

        function goToBtPage(page) {
            btCurrentPage = page;
            renderTradeTablePage();
            const tCard = document.getElementById('backtestTradeBody');
            if (tCard) tCard.parentElement.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
        }

        function changeBtPageSize() {
            const sel = document.getElementById('btPageSize');
            if (sel) btPageSize = sel.value;
            btCurrentPage = 1;
            renderTradeTablePage();
        }

        function renderBacktestView() {
            if (!backtestBundle || !backtestBundle.strategies) {
                loadBacktestsAndRender();
                return;
            }

            // Strategy selector buttons
            const bar = document.getElementById('strategySelectorBar');
            bar.innerHTML = '';

            const strats = [
                { id: 'ENSEMBLE_8F', label: '8-Factor Trend & Value Ensemble', status: 'ACTIVE' },
                { id: 'PO3_LIQUIDITY_SWEEP', label: 'TAC-15: PO3 Liquidity Sweep Reversal', status: 'ACTIVE' },
                { id: 'PO3_META_GATED', label: 'TAC-15-ML: PO3 Meta-Label Gated', status: 'ACTIVE' },
                { id: 'ADAPTIVE_DUAL_REGIME', label: 'Dual-Regime Adaptive Ensemble', status: 'ACTIVE' },
                { id: 'TAC01_PULLBACK', label: 'TAC-01: Pullback Support Swing', status: 'ACTIVE' },
                { id: 'TAC02_SQUEEZE', label: 'TAC-02: Volatility Squeeze', status: 'ACTIVE' },
                { id: 'TAC04_MOMENTUM', label: 'TAC-04: Momentum 52W Breakout', status: 'ACTIVE' },
                { id: 'TAC03_BREAKOUT_CHASE', label: 'TAC-03: Breakout Chase (RETIRED)', status: 'RETIRED' }
            ];

            strats.forEach(s => {
                const btn = document.createElement('button');
                const isRet = s.status === 'RETIRED';
                btn.className = `filter-btn ${s.id === selectedStrategyId ? 'active' : ''}`;
                btn.innerHTML = `
                    <span>${s.label}</span>
                    ${isRet ? '<span style="font-size: 9px; padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 3px; background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.25); color: #ef4444; margin-left: 4px; font-weight: 800;">RETIRED</span>' : ''}
                    <span title="Open full quantitative dossier" style="margin-left: 6px; padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 3px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); font-size: 10px; opacity: 0.85;" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); selectedStrategyId = '${s.id}'; renderBacktestView(); openStrategyModal('${s.id}');">🔬 SPEC</span>
                `;
                btn.onclick = () => {
                    if (selectedStrategyId === s.id) {
                        openStrategyModal(s.id);
                    } else {
                        selectedStrategyId = s.id;
                        renderBacktestView();
                    }
                };
                bar.appendChild(btn);
            });

            const currentStrat = backtestBundle.strategies[selectedStrategyId];
            if (!currentStrat) return;

            const m = currentStrat.metrics;
            document.getElementById('equityTitle').innerHTML = `
                <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; width: 100%;">
                    <span>${currentStrat.strategy_name} — Net Equity vs ${selectedBenchmarkKey === 'SPY' ? 'SPY (S&P 500)' : 'XIU (TSX 60)'}</span>
                    <button class="filter-btn" style="padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 11px; border-color: var(--accent-cyan); color: var(--accent-cyan); cursor: pointer;" onclick="openStrategyModal('${selectedStrategyId}')">
                        🔬 Inspect Strategy Rules &amp; Rationale
                    </button>
                </div>
            `;

            // Retired Strategy Autopsy Banner
            const retBanner = document.getElementById('retiredStrategyBanner');
            if (retBanner) {
                if (currentStrat.status === 'RETIRED') {
                    retBanner.style.display = 'block';
                    retBanner.innerHTML = `
                        <div style="background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.35); border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px 18px;">
                            <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px;">
                                <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;">
                                    <span class="score-pill" style="background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.25); color: #ef4444; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; border: 1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.4);">
                                        STRATEGY RETIRED ON EVIDENCE
                                    </span>
                                    <strong style="color: #ef4444; font-size: 13px;">Phase 7 Quantitative DoD De-Registration</strong>
                                </div>
                                <span style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted);">De-registered: ${currentStrat.retirement_date || '2026-08-15'}</span>
                            </div>
                            <div style="font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: 1.5;">
                                ${currentStrat.retirement_reason || 'Disqualified from live signal generation on negative out-of-sample expectancy, excessive fee drag, and failing deflated Sharpe ratio threshold.'}
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    `;
                } else {
                    retBanner.style.display = 'none';
                }
            }

            // Phase 23 Meta-Label Gating A/B Performance Banner
            const metaBanner = document.getElementById('metaLabelComparisonBanner');
            if (metaBanner) {
                if (selectedStrategyId === 'PO3_META_GATED' || selectedStrategyId === 'PO3_LIQUIDITY_SWEEP') {
                    metaBanner.style.display = 'block';
                    metaBanner.innerHTML = `
                        <div style="background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.8) 0%, rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.95) 100%); border: 1px solid rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.35); border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px 18px; margin-bottom: 20px;">

        function renderBacktestScorecards(currentStrat) {
            if (!currentStrat || !currentStrat.metrics) return;
            const m = currentStrat.metrics;
            const grid = document.getElementById('backtestMetricsGrid');
            const rigorGrid = document.getElementById('backtestRigorGrid');
            if (!grid) return;

            const isProfitable = m.total_net_return_pct >= 0;

            const isXiu = selectedBenchmarkKey === 'XIU';
            const bmLabel = isXiu ? 'Benchmark (XIU TSX 60)' : 'Benchmark (SPY S&P 500)';
            const bmReturn = isXiu
                ? (m.benchmark_xiu_return_pct != null ? m.benchmark_xiu_return_pct : (m.benchmark_return_pct || 0))
                : (m.benchmark_spy_return_pct != null ? m.benchmark_spy_return_pct : (m.benchmark_return_pct || 0));

            const alphaVal = isXiu
                ? (m.alpha_vs_blended_pct != null ? m.alpha_vs_blended_pct : (m.total_net_return_pct - bmReturn))
                : (m.alpha_vs_spy_pct != null ? m.alpha_vs_spy_pct : (m.alpha_pct != null ? m.alpha_pct : (m.total_net_return_pct - bmReturn)));

            const isAlphaPositive = alphaVal >= 0;

            const isBmPositive = typeof bmReturn === 'number' && !isNaN(bmReturn) && bmReturn >= 0;
            const formattedBm = (typeof bmReturn === 'number' && !isNaN(bmReturn))
                ? `${isBmPositive ? '+' : ''}${bmReturn.toFixed(2)}%`
                : '0.00%';

            const formattedAlpha = (typeof alphaVal === 'number' && !isNaN(alphaVal))

            grid.innerHTML = `
                <div class="scorecard-card" style="background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px;">

                    <div style="font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; color: ${m.sharpe_ratio >= 1.0 ? 'var(--accent-green)' : (m.sharpe_ratio >= 0 ? 'var(--accent-amber)' : 'var(--accent-red)')}; margin: 4px 0;">

                            $${capM}M USD
                        </div>
                        <div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted);">Threshold: ≤2% ADV dollar volume</div>
                    </div>

                    <div class="scorecard-card" style="background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px;">

                            ${m.turnover_annualized || '3.8'}x / yr

                        <div style="font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; color: ${(m.longest_losing_streak || 6) <= 8 ? 'var(--accent-amber)' : 'var(--accent-red)'}; margin: 4px 0;">

            // Render scorecards

            // Draw Equity Curve Canvas safely

            // Walk-forward partitions table
            try {

                    const pnlVal = pData.net_pnl_usd != null ? pData.net_pnl_usd : (pData.net_pnl != null ? pData.net_pnl : 0);
                    const isPos = pnlVal >= 0;
                    pRows += `

                            <td style="padding: 10px 8px;">${(rData.win_rate_pct || 0).toFixed(1)}%</td>
                            <td style="padding: 10px 8px; font-weight: 700; color: ${isPosR ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-red)'};">
                                ${isPosR ? '+' : ''}${avgR.toFixed(2)}R
                            </td>
                        </tr>
                    `;
                }
                rTable.innerHTML = `
                    <table style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 12px; text-align: left;">

                            <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color); color: var(--text-muted);">
                                <th style="padding: 8px;">Regime</th>
                                <th style="padding: 8px;">Trades</th>
                                <th style="padding: 8px;">Win Rate</th>

                        <tbody>${rRows}</tbody>

                console.warn("Regime table non-fatal error:", err);

            // Cost sensitivity table
            try {

                        <table style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 12px; text-align: left;">
                            <thead>
                                <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color); color: var(--text-muted);">

                            <tbody>
                                <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);">
                                    <td style="padding: 8px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--accent-green);">1x Baseline</td>

                                        ${cs.cost_1x.net_return_pct >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${cs.cost_1x.net_return_pct}%
                                    </td>

                                    <td style="padding: 8px; font-family: monospace;">$${cs.cost_2x.fees_usd.toLocaleString()}</td>
                                    <td style="padding: 8px; font-weight: 700; color: ${cs.cost_2x.net_return_pct >= 0 ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-red)'}; font-family: monospace;">
                                        ${cs.cost_2x.net_return_pct >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${cs.cost_2x.net_return_pct}%
                                    </td>

                                    <td style="padding: 8px;">30.0 bps / side (60 bps)</td>
                                    <td style="padding: 8px; font-family: monospace;">$${cs.cost_3x.fees_usd.toLocaleString()}</td>

            const allTrades = getActiveStrategyTrades();
