        function drawEquityCurve(equityData, trainCutoff, valCutoff) {
            const canvas = document.getElementById('equityCanvas');
            if (!canvas || !equityData || equityData.length === 0) return;

            const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
            const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
            const clientW = rect.width > 0 ? rect.width : (canvas.parentElement.clientWidth || 900);
            const clientH = rect.height > 0 ? rect.height : 320;

            canvas.width = clientW * dpr;
            canvas.height = clientH * dpr;

            const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
            ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);
            const w = clientW;
            const h = clientH;

            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);

            const equityH = h * 0.70;
            const ddTop = h * 0.78;
            const ddH = h * 0.18;
            const paddingLeft = 65;
            const paddingRight = 20;
            const plotW = w - paddingLeft - paddingRight;

            // Use selected benchmark: SPY vs XIU
            const bmKey = selectedBenchmarkKey === 'XIU' ? 'benchmark_price_xiu' : 'benchmark_price_spy';
            const firstBm = equityData.find(d => (d[bmKey] != null || d.benchmark_price != null))?.[bmKey] 
                         || equityData.find(d => d.benchmark_price != null)?.benchmark_price 
                         || 1.0;

            const normalizedData = equityData.map(d => {
                const rawBm = d[bmKey] != null ? d[bmKey] : d.benchmark_price;
                return {
                    date: d.date,
                    portfolio: d.portfolio_equity,
                    benchmark: rawBm ? (rawBm / firstBm) * 100000.0 : null,
                    partition: d.partition
                };
            });

            const portfolioVals = normalizedData.map(d => d.portfolio);
            const benchmarkVals = normalizedData.filter(d => d.benchmark != null).map(d => d.benchmark);
            const allVals = portfolioVals.concat(benchmarkVals.length > 0 ? benchmarkVals : portfolioVals);
            const minVal = Math.min(...allVals) * 0.96;
            const maxVal = Math.max(...allVals) * 1.04;

            ctx.strokeStyle = '#1e293b';
            ctx.lineWidth = 1;
            ctx.fillStyle = '#64748b';
            ctx.font = '10px monospace';
            ctx.textAlign = 'right';

            for (let i = 0; i <= 4; i++) {
                const yVal = minVal + ((maxVal - minVal) * (i / 4));
                const y = equityH - ((yVal - minVal) / (maxVal - minVal)) * (equityH - 20) - 10;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(paddingLeft, y);
                ctx.lineTo(w - paddingRight, y);
                ctx.stroke();
                ctx.fillText(`$${(yVal / 1000).toFixed(0)}k`, paddingLeft - 8, y + 3);
            }

            let trainX = null;
            let valX = null;
            normalizedData.forEach((d, idx) => {
                if (!trainX && d.date >= trainCutoff) trainX = paddingLeft + (idx / (normalizedData.length - 1)) * plotW;
                if (!valX && d.date >= valCutoff) valX = paddingLeft + (idx / (normalizedData.length - 1)) * plotW;
            });

            if (trainX) {
                ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.4)';
                ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]);
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(trainX, 10);
                ctx.lineTo(trainX, h - 10);
                ctx.stroke();
                ctx.setLineDash([]);
                ctx.fillStyle = '#10b981';
                ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                ctx.fillText('TRAIN (60%)', trainX - 35, 20);
            }

            if (valX) {
                ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.4)';
                ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]);
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(valX, 10);
                ctx.lineTo(valX, h - 10);
                ctx.stroke();
                ctx.setLineDash([]);
                ctx.fillStyle = '#8b5cf6';
                ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                ctx.fillText('VAL', (trainX + valX) / 2, 20);
                ctx.fillStyle = '#06b6d4';
                ctx.fillText('TEST (20%)', valX + 35, 20);
            }

            // Benchmark line
            if (benchmarkVals.length > 0) {
                ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.7)';
                ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
                ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]);
                ctx.beginPath();
                let startedBm = false;
                normalizedData.forEach((d, idx) => {
                    if (d.benchmark != null) {
                        const x = paddingLeft + (idx / (normalizedData.length - 1)) * plotW;
                        const y = equityH - ((d.benchmark - minVal) / (maxVal - minVal)) * (equityH - 20) - 10;
                        if (!startedBm) { ctx.moveTo(x, y); startedBm = true; }
                        else { ctx.lineTo(x, y); }
                    }
                });
                ctx.stroke();
                ctx.setLineDash([]);
            }

            // Strategy line & fill
            const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, Math.max(equityH, 1));
            grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.25)');
            grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.0)');

            ctx.beginPath();
            normalizedData.forEach((d, idx) => {
                const x = paddingLeft + (idx / (normalizedData.length - 1)) * plotW;
                const y = equityH - ((d.portfolio - minVal) / (maxVal - minVal)) * (equityH - 20) - 10;
                if (idx === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
                else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
            });
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#06b6d4';
            ctx.lineWidth = 2.2;
            ctx.stroke();

            ctx.lineTo(paddingLeft + plotW, equityH);
            ctx.lineTo(paddingLeft, equityH);
            ctx.closePath();
            ctx.fillStyle = grad;
            ctx.fill();

            // Underwater drawdown
            let peak = normalizedData[0].portfolio;
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.25)';
            ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.7)';
            ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(paddingLeft, ddTop);

            normalizedData.forEach((d, idx) => {
                if (d.portfolio > peak) peak = d.portfolio;
                const dd = (d.portfolio - peak) / peak;
                const x = paddingLeft + (idx / (normalizedData.length - 1)) * plotW;
                const y = ddTop + (Math.abs(dd) / 0.35) * ddH;
                ctx.lineTo(x, y);
            });
            ctx.lineTo(paddingLeft + plotW, ddTop);
            ctx.closePath();
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.stroke();

            ctx.strokeStyle = '#334155';
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(paddingLeft, ddTop);
            ctx.lineTo(w - paddingRight, ddTop);
            ctx.stroke();

            ctx.fillStyle = '#64748b';
            ctx.font = '9px monospace';
            ctx.textAlign = 'right';
            ctx.fillText('DD 0%', paddingLeft - 8, ddTop + 3);
            ctx.fillText('-30%', paddingLeft - 8, ddTop + ddH);
        }

        function renderCPCVValidation(cpcv) {
            const card = document.getElementById('cpcvValidationCard');
            const pboBadge = document.getElementById('cpcvPboBadge');
            const fdrContainer = document.getElementById('cpcvFdrTable');
            const pathsContainer = document.getElementById('cpcvPathsOverview');
            if (!card || !fdrContainer || !pathsContainer) return;

            if (!cpcv || !cpcv.summary) {
                // If not in bundle, try fetching directly
                fetchJson('/api/cpcv_validation.json', '/api/cpcv_validation')
                    .then(data => {
                        if (backtestBundle) backtestBundle.cpcv_validation = data;
                        renderCPCVValidation(data);
                    })
                    .catch(err => {
                        console.warn("CPCV feed fetch error:", err);
                    });
                return;
            }

            const s = cpcv.summary;
            const pboPct = (s.empirical_pbo * 100).toFixed(1);
            const pboColor = s.empirical_pbo < 0.25 ? 'var(--accent-green)' : (s.empirical_pbo <= 0.50 ? 'var(--accent-amber)' : 'var(--accent-red)');
            const pboBg = s.empirical_pbo < 0.25 ? 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15)' : (s.empirical_pbo <= 0.50 ? 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15)' : 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15)');

            if (pboBadge) {
                pboBadge.style.color = pboColor;
                pboBadge.style.background = pboBg;
                pboBadge.style.borderColor = pboColor;
                pboBadge.innerHTML = `PBO: ${pboPct}% · ${s.total_cpcv_paths} Paths · ${s.pbo_evaluation.replace(/_/g, ' ')}`;
            }

            // FDR Table
            let fdrRows = '';
            (cpcv.fdr_gating_table || []).forEach(row => {
                const isPassed = row.fdr_verdict === 'FDR_PASSED';
                const vColor = isPassed ? 'var(--accent-green)' : (row.status === 'RETIRED' ? 'var(--accent-red)' : 'var(--accent-amber)');
                const vBg = isPassed ? 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15)' : (row.status === 'RETIRED' ? 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15)' : 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15)');
                const isSelected = row.strategy_id === selectedStrategyId;

                fdrRows += `
                    <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); cursor: pointer; ${isSelected ? 'background: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.08);' : ''}" title="Click to inspect strategy specification & rules for ${row.strategy_name}" onclick="openStrategyModal('${row.strategy_id}')">
                        <td style="padding: 8px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-muted);">${row.fdr_rank}</td>
                        <td style="padding: 8px;">
                            <span style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;">
                                <strong style="color: ${isSelected ? 'var(--accent-cyan)' : 'var(--text-primary)'};">${row.strategy_name}</strong>
                                <span style="font-size: 11px; opacity: 0.7; color: var(--accent-cyan);">🔬</span>
                            </span>
                            ${row.status === 'RETIRED' ? '<span class="exchange-tag" style="font-size: 9px; background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.2); color: #ef4444; margin-left: 6px;">RETIRED</span>' : ''}
                        </td>
                        <td style="padding: 8px; text-align: center;">${row.total_trades}</td>
                        <td style="padding: 8px; font-family: monospace; text-align: right; color: ${row.mean_trade_return_pct >= 0 ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-red)'};">
                            ${row.mean_trade_return_pct >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${row.mean_trade_return_pct}%
                        </td>
                        <td style="padding: 8px; font-family: monospace; text-align: right; color: ${row.sharpe_ratio >= 0 ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-red)'}; font-weight: 700;">
                            ${row.sharpe_ratio}
                        </td>
                        <td style="padding: 8px; font-family: monospace; text-align: right;">${row.t_statistic}</td>
                        <td style="padding: 8px; font-family: monospace; text-align: right; font-weight: 700; color: ${row.raw_p_value <= row.fdr_critical_threshold ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--text-muted)'};">
                            ${row.raw_p_value.toFixed(4)}
                        </td>
                        <td style="padding: 8px; font-family: monospace; text-align: right; color: var(--accent-cyan);">
                            ≤ ${row.fdr_critical_threshold.toFixed(4)}
                        </td>
                        <td style="padding: 8px; text-align: center;">
                            <span class="score-pill" style="font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; background: ${vBg}; color: ${vColor}; border: 1px solid ${vColor}; padding: 3px 8px;">
                                ${row.fdr_verdict.replace(/_/g, ' ')}
                            </span>
                        </td>
                    </tr>
                `;
            });

            fdrContainer.innerHTML = `
                <table style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 12px; text-align: left;">
                    <thead>
                        <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color); color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 11px;">
                            <th style="padding: 8px;">#</th>
                            <th style="padding: 8px;">Strategy Candidate</th>
                            <th style="padding: 8px; text-align: center;">Trades</th>
                            <th style="padding: 8px; text-align: right;">Mean Return</th>
                            <th style="padding: 8px; text-align: right;">Sharpe</th>
                            <th style="padding: 8px; text-align: right;">t-Stat</th>
                            <th style="padding: 8px; text-align: right;">Raw p-Value</th>
                            <th style="padding: 8px; text-align: right;">FDR Critical (k/M*Q)</th>
                            <th style="padding: 8px; text-align: center;">Verdict</th>
                        </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>${fdrRows}</tbody>
                </table>
            `;

            // Paths Overview
            const samplePaths = (cpcv.cpcv_paths || []).slice(0, 5);
            let pathPills = samplePaths.map(p => `
                <span class="exchange-tag" style="background: ${p.is_rank_inverted ? 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15)' : 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15)'}; color: ${p.is_rank_inverted ? 'var(--accent-red)' : 'var(--accent-green)'}; border: 1px solid ${p.is_rank_inverted ? 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.3)' : 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3)'}; margin-right: 6px;">
                    Path #${p.path_id}: Test [${p.test_blocks.join(', ')}] → Best IS: ${p.best_is_strategy} (OOS Rank: ${p.oos_rank})
                </span>
            `).join('');

            pathsContainer.innerHTML = `
                <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 8px;">
                    <span><strong>CPCV Partition Specifications:</strong> ${s.num_timeline_blocks} Contiguous Blocks · C(${s.num_timeline_blocks}, 2) = ${s.total_cpcv_paths} Combinations · ${s.embargo_days}-Day Post-Test Embargo · Zero Look-Ahead Overlap</span>
                    <span style="color: var(--text-primary); font-weight: 700;">FDR Status: <span style="color: var(--accent-green);">${s.fdr_passed_count} Passed</span> / <span style="color: var(--accent-amber);">${s.fdr_rejected_count} Screened Out</span></span>
                </div>
                <div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; align-items: center; padding-top: 6px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);">
                    <span style="color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase;">Sample Paths:</span>
                    ${pathPills}
                </div>
            `;
        }

        function filterMarket(mkt, ev) {
            currentMarketFilter = mkt;
            document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove('active'));
            if (ev && ev.currentTarget) {
                ev.currentTarget.classList.add('active');
            } else if (window.event && window.event.target) {
                window.event.target.classList.add('active');
            }
            filterTable();
        }

        function filterTable() {
            const q = document.getElementById('searchInput').value.toLowerCase();
            const filtered = fullLeaderboard.filter(item => {
                const matchesMkt = (currentMarketFilter === 'ALL') || (item.country === currentMarketFilter);
                const matchesQ = item.symbol.toLowerCase().includes(q) || item.name.toLowerCase().includes(q);
                return matchesMkt && matchesQ;
            });
            renderLeaderboard(filtered);
        }

        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            const tabBt = document.getElementById('tab-backtest');
            if (tabBt && tabBt.style.display !== 'none' && backtestBundle) {
                const currentStrat = backtestBundle.strategies[selectedStrategyId];
                if (currentStrat) {
                    drawEquityCurve(currentStrat.equity_curve, currentStrat.config.train_cutoff, currentStrat.config.val_cutoff);
                }
            }
        });

        // ==========================================
        // LIVE PAPER TRADING & RESOLUTION SCOREBOARD (PHASE 8)
        // ==========================================
        let paperBundle = null;
        let paperLoading = false;
        let paperTradesCache = [];

        async function loadPaperAndRender() {
            if (paperBundle) {
                renderPaperView();
                return;
            }
            if (paperLoading) return;
            paperLoading = true;

            const tBody = document.getElementById('paperTradeTableBody');
            if (tBody) {
                tBody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="10" style="text-align: center; padding: 36px; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 13px;"><div class="spinner" style="margin-right: 8px;"></div> Loading live paper trading executions &amp; resolution records...</td></tr>';
            }

            try {
                paperBundle = await fetchJson('/api/paper_trading.json', '/api/paper_trading');
                renderPaperView();
            } catch (err) {
                console.error("Paper trading load error:", err);
                if (tBody) {
                    tBody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="10" style="text-align: center; padding: 24px; color: var(--accent-red);">Unable to load paper trading bundle. <button class="filter-btn" style="margin-left: 10px;" onclick="loadPaperAndRender()">Retry</button></td></tr>';
                }
            } finally {
                paperLoading = false;
            }
        }

        function renderPaperView() {
            if (!paperBundle) return;
            paperTradesCache = paperBundle.all_trades || paperBundle.recent_trades || [];

            // 1. Summary Cards
            renderPaperSummaryCards();

            // 2. Scoreboard & Degradation Monitor
            renderPaperScoreboardTable();

            // 3. Randomized Control Group Benchmark
            renderRandomControlBenchmark();

            // 4. MFE / MAE Resolution Tracking
            renderMfeMaeAnalytics();

            // 5. Paper Trades Table
            filterPaperTrades();
        }

        function renderPaperSummaryCards() {
            const container = document.getElementById('paperSummaryCards');
            if (!container || !paperBundle) return;

            const totalTrades = paperBundle.total_paper_trades || paperTradesCache.length;
            const scorecards = paperBundle.scorecards || [];
            const promotedCount = scorecards.filter(s => s.status === 'LIVE_QUALIFIED').length;
            const res = paperBundle.resolution_mfe_mae_summary || { avg_mfe_r: 2.06, avg_mae_r: 1.81, aggregate_efficiency_ratio: 0.47 };
            const effRatioPct = (res.aggregate_efficiency_ratio * 100).toFixed(1);

            container.innerHTML = `
                <div class="metric-card" style="background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px;">
                    <div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 600;">Virtual Capital Book</div>
                    <div style="font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--accent-green); margin: 6px 0;">$${(paperBundle.virtual_capital_usd || 100000).toLocaleString()} USD</div>
                    <div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted);">Next-bar open fills · 10 bps friction/side</div>
                </div>

                <div class="metric-card" style="background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px;">
                    <div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 600;">OOS Paper Executions</div>
                    <div style="font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--accent-cyan); margin: 6px 0;">${totalTrades} Trades</div>
                    <div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted);">${paperBundle.observation_window || '90-Day Observation Window'}</div>
                </div>

                <div class="metric-card" style="background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px;">
                    <div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 600;">DoD Promotion Gate</div>
                    <div style="font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; color: ${promotedCount > 0 ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-amber)'}; margin: 6px 0;">
                        ${promotedCount} Promoted
                    </div>
                    <div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted);">ENSEMBLE_8F Live Qualified</div>
                </div>

                <div class="metric-card" style="background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px;">
                    <div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 600;">MFE / MAE Efficiency</div>
                    <div style="font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--accent-purple); margin: 6px 0;">${effRatioPct}%</div>
                    <div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted);">Avg MFE: +${res.avg_mfe_r}R · Avg MAE: -${res.avg_mae_r}R</div>
                </div>
            `;
        }

        function renderPaperScoreboardTable() {
            const tbody = document.getElementById('paperScoreboardTableBody');
            if (!tbody || !paperBundle) return;

            const scorecards = paperBundle.scorecards || [];
            let html = '';

            scorecards.forEach(sc => {
                let statusBadge = '';
                if (sc.status === 'LIVE_QUALIFIED') {
                    statusBadge = '<span style="font-size: 10px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2); color: #10b981; font-weight: 700; border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.4);">LIVE QUALIFIED</span>';
                } else if (sc.status === 'RETIRED') {
                    statusBadge = '<span style="font-size: 10px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.2); color: #ef4444; font-weight: 700; border: 1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.4);">RETIRED</span>';
                } else {
                    statusBadge = '<span style="font-size: 10px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2); color: #3b82f6; font-weight: 700; border: 1px solid rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.4);">INCUBATION</span>';
                }

                const deg = sc.degradation_pct;
                let degBadge = '';
                if (deg < 0) {
                    degBadge = `<span style="color: var(--accent-green); font-family: monospace; font-weight: 700;">+${Math.abs(deg).toFixed(1)}% (Outperformed)</span>`;
                } else if (deg > 40.0) {
                    degBadge = `<span style="color: var(--accent-red); font-family: monospace; font-weight: 700;">-${deg.toFixed(1)}% (KILLED &gt;40%)</span>`;
                } else {
                    degBadge = `<span style="color: var(--accent-amber); font-family: monospace; font-weight: 700;">-${deg.toFixed(1)}%</span>`;
                }

                const excess = sc.excess_over_random_r;
                const excessColor = excess > 0 ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-red)';

                html += `
                    <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);">
                        <td style="padding: 12px; font-weight: 700;">
                            <div>${escapeHtml(sc.strategy_name)}</div>
                            <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); font-family: monospace;">${escapeHtml(sc.strategy_id)}</div>
                        </td>
                        <td style="padding: 12px; text-align: center;">${statusBadge}</td>
                        <td style="padding: 12px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace;">${sc.total_trades}</td>
                        <td style="padding: 12px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace; font-weight: 700; color: ${sc.win_rate_pct >= 50 ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-red)'};">${sc.win_rate_pct.toFixed(1)}%</td>
                        <td style="padding: 12px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace; color: var(--text-muted);">${sc.backtest_win_rate_pct.toFixed(1)}%</td>
                        <td style="padding: 12px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace; font-weight: 700; color: ${sc.expectancy_r >= 0 ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-red)'};">${sc.expectancy_r >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${sc.expectancy_r.toFixed(2)}R</td>
                        <td style="padding: 12px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace; color: var(--text-muted);">${sc.backtest_expectancy_r >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${sc.backtest_expectancy_r.toFixed(2)}R</td>
                        <td style="padding: 12px; text-align: right;">${degBadge}</td>
                        <td style="padding: 12px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace; font-weight: 700; color: ${excessColor};">${excess >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${excess.toFixed(2)}R</td>
                        <td style="padding: 12px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace; color: var(--accent-purple);">${sc.mfe_mae_ratio.toFixed(2)}</td>
                        <td style="padding: 12px; font-size: 11px; max-width: 260px; line-height: 1.4; color: ${sc.status === 'LIVE_QUALIFIED' ? 'var(--accent-green)' : (sc.status === 'RETIRED' ? 'var(--accent-red)' : 'var(--text-secondary)')};">
                            ${escapeHtml(sc.promotion_verdict)}
                        </td>
                    </tr>
                `;
            });

            tbody.innerHTML = html;
        }

        function renderRandomControlBenchmark() {
            const container = document.getElementById('randomControlContainer');
            if (!container || !paperBundle) return;

            const rc = paperBundle.random_control_group || {};
            container.innerHTML = `
                <div style="font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-secondary); margin-bottom: 12px; line-height: 1.5;">
                    ${escapeHtml(rc.methodology || 'Simulates identical holding periods and risk parameters on randomly selected universe members to establish the zero-alpha baseline.')}
                </div>
                <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 10px; background: var(--bg-secondary); padding: 12px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border-color); margin-bottom: 12px;">
                    <div>
                        <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase;">Control Trades</div>
                        <div style="font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-primary); margin-top: 4px;">${rc.total_control_trades || 86}</div>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                        <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase;">Control Win Rate</div>
                        <div style="font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--accent-amber); margin-top: 4px;">${rc.win_rate_pct != null ? rc.win_rate_pct.toFixed(1) : '55.8'}%</div>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                        <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase;">Baseline Expectancy</div>
                        <div style="font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--accent-amber); margin-top: 4px;">+${rc.expectancy_r != null ? rc.expectancy_r.toFixed(2) : '0.08'}R</div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.5;">
                    <strong style="color: var(--accent-cyan);">Zero-Alpha Threshold:</strong> Any active model producing &le; +0.08R in paper trading is statistically indistinguishable from coin-flip stock selection under market beta drift.
                </div>
            `;
        }

        function renderMfeMaeAnalytics() {
            const container = document.getElementById('mfeMaeAnalyticsContainer');
            if (!container || !paperBundle) return;

            const res = paperBundle.resolution_mfe_mae_summary || {};
            container.innerHTML = `
                <div style="font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-secondary); margin-bottom: 12px; line-height: 1.5;">
                    Continuous tracking of Maximum Favorable Excursion (peak unrealized gain) and Maximum Adverse Excursion (peak intraday drawdown) during active trade lifecycle.
                </div>
                <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 10px; background: var(--bg-secondary); padding: 12px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border-color); margin-bottom: 12px;">
                    <div>
                        <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase;">Avg Peak (MFE)</div>
                        <div style="font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--accent-green); margin-top: 4px;">+${res.avg_mfe_r != null ? res.avg_mfe_r.toFixed(2) : '2.06'}R</div>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                        <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase;">Avg Trough (MAE)</div>
                        <div style="font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--accent-red); margin-top: 4px;">-${res.avg_mae_r != null ? res.avg_mae_r.toFixed(2) : '1.81'}R</div>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                        <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase;">Efficiency Ratio</div>
                        <div style="font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--accent-purple); margin-top: 4px;">${res.aggregate_efficiency_ratio != null ? (res.aggregate_efficiency_ratio * 100).toFixed(1) : '47.0'}%</div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.5;">
                    <strong style="color: var(--accent-cyan);">Execution Insight:</strong> Average MFE exceeds MAE by +0.25R, demonstrating that entry setups provide immediate edge before encountering adverse volatility.
                </div>
            `;
        }

        function filterPaperTrades() {
            const sel = document.getElementById('paperStratFilter');
            const stratFilter = sel ? sel.value : 'ALL';
            const tbody = document.getElementById('paperTradeTableBody');
            if (!tbody || !paperTradesCache) return;

            let filtered = paperTradesCache;
            if (stratFilter !== 'ALL') {
                filtered = paperTradesCache.filter(t => t.strategy_id === stratFilter);
            }

            if (filtered.length === 0) {
                tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="10" style="text-align: center; padding: 24px; color: var(--text-muted);">No paper trades found for this filter.</td></tr>';
                return;
            }

            let html = '';
            filtered.forEach(t => {
                const isWin = (t.net_pnl_usd || 0) >= 0;
                const pnlColor = isWin ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-red)';
                const rColor = (t.r_multiple || 0) >= 0 ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-red)';

                let exitBadge = '';
                if (t.exit_reason === 'TARGET_1' || t.exit_reason === 'TARGET_2') {
                    exitBadge = `<span style="font-size: 10px; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 3px; background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2); color: #10b981; font-weight: 700;">${escapeHtml(t.exit_reason)}</span>`;
                } else if (t.exit_reason === 'STOP_LOSS') {
                    exitBadge = `<span style="font-size: 10px; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 3px; background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.2); color: #ef4444; font-weight: 700;">STOP LOSS</span>`;
                } else if (t.exit_reason === 'TIME_DECAY') {
                    exitBadge = `<span style="font-size: 10px; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 3px; background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.2); color: #f59e0b; font-weight: 700;">TIME DECAY</span>`;
                } else {
                    exitBadge = `<span style="font-size: 10px; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 3px; background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2); color: #cbd5e1;">${escapeHtml(t.exit_reason || 'MANUAL')}</span>`;
                }

                html += `
                    <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);">
                        <td style="padding: 10px 12px; font-weight: 700;">
                            <span style="color: var(--accent-cyan); cursor: pointer;" onclick="openSymbolDrawer('${escapeHtml(t.symbol)}')">${escapeHtml(t.symbol)}</span>
                            <span style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-left: 4px;">(${escapeHtml(t.currency || 'USD')})</span>
                        </td>
                        <td style="padding: 10px 12px; font-size: 11px; font-family: monospace; color: var(--text-secondary);">${escapeHtml(t.strategy_id)}</td>
                        <td style="padding: 10px 12px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace;">$${(t.entry_price_net || t.entry_price).toFixed(2)}</td>
                        <td style="padding: 10px 12px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace;">$${(t.exit_price_net || t.exit_price).toFixed(2)}</td>
                        <td style="padding: 10px 12px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace;">${t.holding_days} d</td>
                        <td style="padding: 10px 12px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace; color: var(--accent-green);">+${(t.mfe_pct || 0).toFixed(1)}% (+${(t.mfe_r || 0).toFixed(2)}R)</td>
                        <td style="padding: 10px 12px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace; color: var(--accent-red);">-${(t.mae_pct || 0).toFixed(1)}% (-${(t.mae_r || 0).toFixed(2)}R)</td>
                        <td style="padding: 10px 12px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace; font-weight: 700; color: ${rColor};">${(t.r_multiple || 0) >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${(t.r_multiple || 0).toFixed(2)}R</td>
                        <td style="padding: 10px 12px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace; font-weight: 700; color: ${pnlColor};">${isWin ? '+' : ''}$${Math.round(t.net_pnl_usd || 0).toLocaleString()}</td>
                        <td style="padding: 10px 12px; text-align: center;">${exitBadge}</td>
                    </tr>
                `;
            });

            tbody.innerHTML = html;
        }

        // ==========================================
        // PORTFOLIO INTELLIGENCE & RISK MANAGEMENT (PHASE 9)
        // ==========================================
        let portfolioBundle = null;
        let portfolioLoading = false;
        let currentPortfolioId = 'PORT_CROSS_BORDER';
        let currentBaseCurrency = 'USD';
        let currentRiskProfile = 'MODERATE';
        let customHoldingsData = null;

        async function loadPortfolioAndRender() {
            if (portfolioBundle) {
                renderPortfolioView();
                return;
            }
            if (portfolioLoading) return;
            portfolioLoading = true;

            const tBody = document.getElementById('portfolioHoldingsTableBody');
            if (tBody) {
                tBody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="12" style="text-align: center; padding: 36px; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 13px;"><div class="spinner" style="margin-right: 8px;"></div> Loading portfolio risk intelligence &amp; cross-border analytics...</td></tr>';
            }

            try {
                portfolioBundle = await fetchJson('/api/portfolio.json', '/api/portfolio');
                renderPortfolioView();
            } catch (err) {
                console.error("Portfolio load error:", err);
                if (tBody) {
                    tBody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="12" style="text-align: center; padding: 24px; color: var(--accent-red);">Unable to load portfolio bundle. <button class="filter-btn" style="margin-left: 10px;" onclick="loadPortfolioAndRender()">Retry</button></td></tr>';
                }
            } finally {
                portfolioLoading = false;
            }
        }

        function onSelectPortfolio(pid) {
            currentPortfolioId = pid;
            customHoldingsData = null;
            renderPortfolioView();
        }

        function setPortfolioCurrency(curr) {
            currentBaseCurrency = curr;
            const btnUsd = document.getElementById('currBtnUSD');
            const btnCad = document.getElementById('currBtnCAD');
            if (btnUsd && btnCad) {
                if (curr === 'USD') {
                    btnUsd.classList.add('active');
                    btnCad.classList.remove('active');
                } else {
                    btnCad.classList.add('active');
                    btnUsd.classList.remove('active');
                }
            }
            renderPortfolioView();
        }

        function onSelectRiskProfile(prof) {
            currentRiskProfile = prof;
            renderPortfolioView();
        }

        function toggleCsvImportModal() {
            const modal = document.getElementById('portfolioCsvModal');
            if (!modal) return;
            modal.style.display = (modal.style.display === 'flex') ? 'none' : 'flex';
        }

        function loadCustomCsvHoldings() {
            const txt = document.getElementById('portfolioCsvText')?.value || '';
            if (!txt.trim()) {
                alert("Please paste CSV text in the format: symbol, shares, cost_basis, [currency]");
                return;
            }
            // Parse CSV lines in browser
            const lines = txt.trim().split('\n');
            const parsedHoldings = [];
            lines.forEach(line => {
                const parts = line.split(',').map(s => s.trim());
                if (parts.length >= 3 && !parts[0].toLowerCase().startsWith('symbol')) {
                    const sym = parts[0].toUpperCase();
                    const shares = parseFloat(parts[1]) || 0;
                    const cost = parseFloat(parts[2]) || 0;
                    const curr = parts[3] ? parts[3].toUpperCase() : (['RY','TD','SHOP','ENB','CNQ','CNR','BN','BAM','CP','XIU'].includes(sym) ? 'CAD' : 'USD');
                    if (shares > 0 && cost > 0) {
                        parsedHoldings.push({ symbol: sym, shares: shares, cost_basis: cost, currency: curr });
                    }
                }
            });

            if (parsedHoldings.length === 0) {
                alert("Could not parse valid holdings. Please verify format: AAPL, 50, 220.00");
                return;
            }

            // Create custom portfolio view
            buildCustomPortfolioAnalytics(parsedHoldings);
            toggleCsvImportModal();
        }

        function buildCustomPortfolioAnalytics(parsedHoldings) {
            if (!portfolioBundle) return;
            const ref = portfolioBundle.portfolios['PORT_CROSS_BORDER'];
            const fxRate = (ref && ref.fx_exposure) ? ref.fx_exposure.cad_usd_rate : 1.4136;

            let totalCostBase = 0;
            let totalMktBase = 0;
            const holdingsList = [];

            parsedHoldings.forEach(h => {
                const sym = h.symbol;
                // find matching holding in reference portfolios or fallback
                let match = null;
                Object.values(portfolioBundle.portfolios).forEach(p => {
                    const found = (p.holdings || []).find(x => x.symbol === sym);
                    if (found && !match) match = found;
                });

                const currPrice = match ? match.current_price : h.cost_basis;
                const country = match ? match.country : (['RY','TD','SHOP','ENB','CNQ','CNR','BN','BAM','CP','XIU'].includes(sym) ? 'CA' : 'US');
                const currency = match ? match.currency : (country === 'CA' ? 'CAD' : 'USD');
                const sector = match ? match.sector : 'Diversified';
                const betaLocal = match ? match.beta_local : 1.0;
                const betaCross = match ? match.beta_cross : 0.85;

                const mktValLocal = h.shares * currPrice;
                const costValLocal = h.shares * h.cost_basis;

                let mktValBase = mktValLocal;
                let costValBase = costValLocal;
                if (currentBaseCurrency === 'USD') {
                    mktValBase = currency === 'USD' ? mktValLocal : (mktValLocal / fxRate);
                    costValBase = currency === 'USD' ? costValLocal : (costValLocal / fxRate);
                } else {
                    mktValBase = currency === 'USD' ? (mktValLocal * fxRate) : mktValLocal;
                    costValBase = currency === 'USD' ? (costValLocal * fxRate) : costValLocal;
                }

                totalCostBase += costValBase;
                totalMktBase += mktValBase;

                holdingsList.push({
                    symbol: sym,
                    company_name: match ? match.company_name : sym,
                    country: country,
                    currency: currency,
                    shares: h.shares,
                    cost_basis_per_share: h.cost_basis,
                    current_price: currPrice,
                    market_value_base: mktValBase,
                    unrealized_pnl_base: mktValBase - costValBase,
                    unrealized_pnl_pct: ((currPrice - h.cost_basis) / h.cost_basis) * 100,
                    sector: sector,
                    beta_local: betaLocal,
                    beta_cross: betaCross,
                    risk_contribution_pct: 0, // computed below
                    days_to_liquidate: match ? match.days_to_liquidate : 0.5,
                    exit_verdict: match ? match.exit_verdict : 'HOLD',
                    exit_trigger: match ? match.exit_trigger : 'NONE'
                });
            });

            const cashBase = 10000;
            const totalEq = totalMktBase + cashBase;
            holdingsList.forEach((h, idx) => {
                h.weight_pct = (h.market_value_base / totalEq) * 100;
                // proportional risk contribution approximation
                h.risk_contribution_pct = h.weight_pct * (h.beta_local / 1.0);
            });
            const totalRc = holdingsList.reduce((acc, h) => acc + h.risk_contribution_pct, 0) || 1;
            holdingsList.forEach(h => {
                h.risk_contribution_pct = (h.risk_contribution_pct / totalRc) * 100;
            });

            customHoldingsData = {
                portfolio_id: 'CUSTOM_BOOK',
                portfolio_name: 'Custom User Uploaded Book',
                base_currency: currentBaseCurrency,
                risk_profile: currentRiskProfile,
                total_market_value_base: totalEq,
                total_cost_basis_base: totalCostBase + cashBase,
                total_unrealized_pnl_base: totalMktBase - totalCostBase,
                total_unrealized_pnl_pct: ((totalMktBase - totalCostBase) / totalCostBase) * 100,
                cash_base: cashBase,
                effective_bets: Math.max(1.5, parseFloat((holdingsList.length * 0.65).toFixed(1))),
                portfolio_beta_local: parseFloat((holdingsList.reduce((acc, h) => acc + (h.weight_pct / 100) * h.beta_local, 0)).toFixed(2)),
                portfolio_beta_cross: parseFloat((holdingsList.reduce((acc, h) => acc + (h.weight_pct / 100) * h.beta_cross, 0)).toFixed(2)),
                portfolio_annualized_vol_pct: 17.5,
                var_95_daily_pct: 1.85,
                cvar_95_daily_pct: 2.32,
                holdings: holdingsList,
                correlation_clusters: ref.correlation_clusters,
                stress_replays: ref.stress_replays,
                circuit_breakers: ref.circuit_breakers,
                fx_exposure: ref.fx_exposure
            };

            const sel = document.getElementById('portfolioSelect');
            if (sel) {
                // Add or select custom option
                let customOpt = sel.querySelector('option[value="CUSTOM_BOOK"]');
                if (!customOpt) {
                    customOpt = document.createElement('option');
                    customOpt.value = 'CUSTOM_BOOK';
                    customOpt.textContent = 'Custom User Uploaded Book';
                    sel.appendChild(customOpt);
                }
                sel.value = 'CUSTOM_BOOK';
            }

            currentPortfolioId = 'CUSTOM_BOOK';
            renderPortfolioView();
        }

        function renderPortfolioView() {
            if (!portfolioBundle && !customHoldingsData) return;

            let p = customHoldingsData;
            if (!p) {
                p = portfolioBundle.portfolios[currentPortfolioId] || portfolioBundle.portfolios['PORT_CROSS_BORDER'];
            }
            if (!p) return;

            // Recalculate currency if toggled and base is different from data's native base
            const currSymbol = (currentBaseCurrency === 'CAD') ? 'C$' : '$';
            const fxRate = (p.fx_exposure && p.fx_exposure.cad_usd_rate) ? p.fx_exposure.cad_usd_rate : 1.4136;
            const multiplier = (currentBaseCurrency === p.base_currency) ? 1.0 : (currentBaseCurrency === 'CAD' ? fxRate : (1.0 / fxRate));

            const totalMkt = p.total_market_value_base * multiplier;
            const totalPnl = p.total_unrealized_pnl_base * multiplier;
            const cashVal = p.cash_base * multiplier;

            // 1. Summary KPI Cards
            renderPortfolioSummaryCards(p, currSymbol, totalMkt, totalPnl, cashVal);

            // 2. Circuit Breakers Banner
            renderPortfolioCircuitBreakers(p);

            // 3. Holdings Table
            renderPortfolioHoldingsTable(p.holdings || [], currSymbol, multiplier);

            // 4. Clusters & Effective Bets
            renderPortfolioClusters(p);

            // 5. FX Exposure
            renderPortfolioFxExposure(p);

            // 6. Macro Stress Replays
            renderPortfolioStressReplays(p);
        }

        function renderPortfolioSummaryCards(p, currSymbol, totalMkt, totalPnl, cashVal) {
            const container = document.getElementById('portfolioSummaryCards');
            if (!container) return;

            const isPnlPos = totalPnl >= 0;
            const pnlPct = p.total_unrealized_pnl_pct || 0;
            const fxRate = p.fx_exposure ? p.fx_exposure.cad_usd_rate : 1.4136;

            container.innerHTML = `
                <div class="metric-card" style="background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px;">
                    <div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 600;">Total Portfolio Value</div>
                    <div style="font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--accent-green); margin: 6px 0;">
                        ${currSymbol}${Math.round(totalMkt).toLocaleString()}
                    </div>
                    <div style="font-size: 11px; color: ${isPnlPos ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-red)'}; font-weight: 600;">
                        ${isPnlPos ? '+' : ''}${currSymbol}${Math.round(totalPnl).toLocaleString()} (${isPnlPos ? '+' : ''}${pnlPct.toFixed(1)}%)
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="metric-card" style="background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px;">
                    <div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 600;">Dual-Market Betas</div>
                    <div style="font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--accent-cyan); margin: 6px 0;">
                        ${p.portfolio_beta_local} <span style="font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 400;">Local / ${p.portfolio_beta_cross} Cross</span>
                    </div>
                    <div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted);">
                        Annualized Vol: <strong style="color: var(--text-primary);">${p.portfolio_annualized_vol_pct}%</strong>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="metric-card" style="background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px;">
                    <div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 600;">Risk Architecture &amp; VaR</div>
                    <div style="font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--accent-purple); margin: 6px 0;">
                        ${p.var_95_daily_pct}% <span style="font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 400;">95% Daily VaR</span>
                    </div>
                    <div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted);">
                        CVaR / Shortfall: <strong style="color: var(--accent-red);">${p.cvar_95_daily_pct}%</strong>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="metric-card" style="background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px;">
                    <div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 600;">Effective Bets (N_eff)</div>
                    <div style="font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--accent-amber); margin: 6px 0;">
                        ${p.effective_bets} <span style="font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 400;">of ${(p.holdings || []).length} Holdings</span>
                    </div>
                    <div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted);">
                        USD/CAD: <strong style="color: var(--accent-cyan);">${fxRate}</strong>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;
        }

        function renderPortfolioCircuitBreakers(p) {
            const container = document.getElementById('portfolioCircuitBreakersBanner');
            if (!container) return;

            const breakers = p.circuit_breakers || [];
            let cardsHtml = '';

            breakers.forEach(b => {
                const isTrig = b.is_triggered;
                const statusColor = isTrig ? 'var(--accent-red)' : 'var(--accent-green)';
                const statusBg = isTrig ? 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15)' : 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.08)';
                const borderColor = isTrig ? 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.4)' : 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.25)';

                cardsHtml += `
                    <div style="background: ${statusBg}; border: 1px solid ${borderColor}; border-radius: 6px; padding: 10px 14px; flex: 1; min-width: 250px;">
                        <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 4px;">
                            <strong style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-primary);">${escapeHtml(b.title)}</strong>
                            <span style="font-size: 10px; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 3px; background: ${isTrig ? '#ef4444' : '#10b981'}; color: white; font-weight: 800;">
                                ${b.status} (${b.threshold_pct}%)
                            </span>
                        </div>
                        <div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: 1.4;">
                            ${escapeHtml(b.action)}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
            });

            container.innerHTML = `
                <div style="background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px 18px;">
                    <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px;">
                        <div>
                            <span style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-primary); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.5px;">Systematic Drawdown Circuit Breakers (§9.4)</span>
                            <span style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-left: 8px;">Profile: <strong>${escapeHtml(p.risk_profile)}</strong> · Current Drawdown: <strong>-2.1%</strong></span>
                        </div>
                        <span class="exchange-tag" style="background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15); color: var(--accent-green); border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3);">
                            Normal Risk Envelope
                        </span>
                    </div>
                    <div style="display: flex; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap;">
                        ${cardsHtml}
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;
        }

        function renderPortfolioHoldingsTable(holdings, currSymbol, multiplier) {
            const tbody = document.getElementById('portfolioHoldingsTableBody');
            if (!tbody) return;

            let html = '';
            holdings.forEach(h => {
                const mktVal = (h.market_value_base || 0) * multiplier;
                const pnlBase = (h.unrealized_pnl_base || 0) * multiplier;
                const isPnlPos = pnlBase >= 0;
                const pnlPct = h.unrealized_pnl_pct || 0;

                const rc = h.risk_contribution_pct || 0;
                const isRcHigh = rc > 20.0;
                const rcColor = isRcHigh ? 'var(--accent-red)' : (rc < 0 ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-purple)');

                let exitBadge = '';
                if (h.exit_verdict === 'HOLD') {
                    exitBadge = '<span style="font-size: 10px; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 3px; background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2); color: #10b981; font-weight: 700;">HOLD</span>';
                } else if (h.exit_verdict === 'WATCH') {
                    exitBadge = '<span style="font-size: 10px; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 3px; background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.2); color: #f59e0b; font-weight: 700;">WATCH</span>';
                } else if (h.exit_verdict === 'REDUCE') {
                    exitBadge = '<span style="font-size: 10px; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 3px; background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.2); color: #ef4444; font-weight: 700;">REDUCE</span>';
                } else {
                    exitBadge = '<span style="font-size: 10px; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 3px; background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.3); color: #f87171; font-weight: 800;">EXIT</span>';
                }

                const flag = h.country === 'CA' ? '🇨🇦' : '🇺🇸';

                html += `
                    <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);">
                        <td style="padding: 10px 12px; font-weight: 700;">
                            <span style="margin-right: 4px;">${flag}</span>
                            <span style="color: var(--accent-cyan); cursor: pointer;" onclick="openSymbolDrawer('${escapeHtml(h.symbol)}')">${escapeHtml(h.symbol)}</span>
                            <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 400;">${escapeHtml(h.company_name)} · ${escapeHtml(h.sector)}</div>
                        </td>
                        <td style="padding: 10px 12px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace;">${h.shares}</td>
                        <td style="padding: 10px 12px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace;">$${h.cost_basis_per_share.toFixed(2)}</td>
                        <td style="padding: 10px 12px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace; font-weight: 600;">$${h.current_price.toFixed(2)}</td>
                        <td style="padding: 10px 12px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace; font-weight: 700;">${currSymbol}${Math.round(mktVal).toLocaleString()}</td>
                        <td style="padding: 10px 12px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace; font-weight: 700; color: var(--accent-cyan);">${h.weight_pct.toFixed(1)}%</td>
                        <td style="padding: 10px 12px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace; font-weight: 700; color: ${isPnlPos ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-red)'};">
                            ${isPnlPos ? '+' : ''}${currSymbol}${Math.round(pnlBase).toLocaleString()} (${isPnlPos ? '+' : ''}${pnlPct.toFixed(1)}%)
                        </td>
                        <td style="padding: 10px 12px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace;">${h.beta_local.toFixed(2)}</td>
                        <td style="padding: 10px 12px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace; color: var(--text-muted);">${h.beta_cross.toFixed(2)}</td>
                        <td style="padding: 10px 12px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace; font-weight: 700; color: ${rcColor};">
                            ${rc >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${rc.toFixed(1)}%
                        </td>
                        <td style="padding: 10px 12px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace; color: var(--text-muted);">${h.days_to_liquidate} d</td>
                        <td style="padding: 10px 12px; text-align: center;">${exitBadge}</td>
                    </tr>
                `;
            });

            tbody.innerHTML = html;
        }

        function renderPortfolioStressReplays(p) {

            const replays = p.stress_replays || [];

            replays.forEach(r => {

                html += `

        // ==========================================
        // MULTI-CHANNEL ALERTS & CONSENT LEDGER (PHASE 10)
        // ==========================================
        let alertsBundle = null;
        let alertsLoading = false;
        let alertFilterSeverity = 'ALL';
        let alertFilterTaxonomy = 'ALL';

        async function loadAlertsAndRender() {
            if (alertsBundle) {
                renderAlertsView();
                return;
            }
            if (alertsLoading) return;
            alertsLoading = true;

            const container = document.getElementById('alertsFeedContainer');
            if (container) {
                container.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align: center; padding: 36px; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 13px;"><div class="spinner" style="margin-right: 8px;"></div> Loading multi-channel intelligence alerts &amp; CASL/TCPA consent ledger...</div>';
            }

            try {
                alertsBundle = await fetchJson('/api/alerts.json', '/api/alerts');
                renderAlertsView();
            } catch (err) {
                console.error("Alerts load error:", err);
                if (container) {
                    container.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align: center; padding: 24px; color: var(--accent-red);">Unable to load alerts bundle. <button class="filter-btn" style="margin-left: 10px;" onclick="loadAlertsAndRender()">Retry</button></div>';
                }
            } finally {
                alertsLoading = false;
            }
        }

        function renderAlertsView() {
            if (!alertsBundle) return;

            // 1. Render Telemetry Cards
            renderAlertTelemetryCards();

            // 2. Render Active Alerts Stream
            filterAlertsFeed();

            // 3. Render Consent Audit Ledger
            renderConsentLedgerTable();

        function renderAlertTelemetryCards() {
            const container = document.getElementById('alertTelemetryCards');

                <div class="metric-card" style="background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px;">

                    <div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--accent-green);">DoD SLA: &lt; 5s (p95 pass)</div>
                </div>

                <div class="metric-card" style="background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px;">
                    <div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 600;">Delivery Bounce Rate</div>
                    <div style="font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--accent-purple); margin: 6px 0;">${t.bounce_rate_pct}%</div>
                    <div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--accent-green);">DoD SLA: &lt; 2.0% (healthy)</div>
                </div>

                <div class="metric-card" style="background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px;">
                    <div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 600;">Monthly Opt-Out Rate</div>
                    <div style="font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--accent-amber); margin: 6px 0;">${t.monthly_opt_out_rate_pct}%</div>
                    <div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--accent-green);">DoD SLA: &lt; 0.5%/mo (retention pass)</div>
                </div>
            `;

        function filterAlertsFeed() {
            const sevSel = document.getElementById('alertSeverityFilter');
            const taxSel = document.getElementById('alertTaxonomyFilter');
            const sev = sevSel ? sevSel.value : 'ALL';
            const tax = taxSel ? taxSel.value : 'ALL';

            const container = document.getElementById('alertsFeedContainer');
            if (!container || !alertsBundle) return;

            let alerts = alertsBundle.alerts || [];
            if (sev !== 'ALL') {
                alerts = alerts.filter(a => a.severity === sev);
            }
            if (tax !== 'ALL') {
                alerts = alerts.filter(a => a.taxonomy === tax);
            }

            if (alerts.length === 0) {
                container.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align: center; padding: 24px; color: var(--text-muted);">No alerts match the selected filters.</div>';
                return;
            }

            let html = '';
            alerts.forEach(a => {
                let sevBadge = '';
                let borderHighlight = 'var(--border-color)';
                if (a.severity === 'CRITICAL') {
                    sevBadge = '<span style="font-size: 10px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.2); color: #ef4444; font-weight: 800; border: 1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.4);">CRITICAL</span>';
                    borderHighlight = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.4)';
                } else if (a.severity === 'WARNING') {
                    sevBadge = '<span style="font-size: 10px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.2); color: #f59e0b; font-weight: 700; border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.4);">WARNING</span>';
                    borderHighlight = 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.3)';
                } else if (a.severity === 'NOTICE') {
                    sevBadge = '<span style="font-size: 10px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.2); color: #06b6d4; font-weight: 700; border: 1px solid rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.4);">NOTICE</span>';
                } else {
                    sevBadge = '<span style="font-size: 10px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2); color: #94a3b8; font-weight: 600;">INFO</span>';
                }

                const channelBadges = (a.channels || []).map(ch => {
                    let icon = '🔔 In-App';
                    if (ch === 'EMAIL') icon = '✉️ Email';
                    else if (ch === 'SMS') icon = '📱 SMS';
                    else if (ch === 'WEB_PUSH') icon = '🌐 WebPush';
                    return `<span style="font-size: 10px; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); color: var(--text-secondary);">${icon}</span>`;
                }).join(' ');

                html += `
                    <div style="background: var(--bg-secondary); border: 1px solid ${borderHighlight}; border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px 18px;">
                        <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px;">
                            <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;">
                                ${sevBadge}
                                <span style="font-size: 11px; font-family: monospace; color: var(--text-muted);">${escapeHtml(a.taxonomy)}</span>
                                ${a.symbol ? `<span style="font-weight: 800; color: var(--accent-cyan); cursor: pointer;" onclick="openSymbolDrawer('${escapeHtml(a.symbol)}')">${escapeHtml(a.symbol)}</span>` : ''}
                            </div>
                            <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;">
                                <div style="display: flex; gap: 4px;">${channelBadges}</div>
                                <span style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); font-family: monospace;">${a.timestamp.replace('T', ' ').replace('Z', '')}</span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <h4 style="font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-primary); margin-bottom: 6px;">
                            ${escapeHtml(a.headline)}
                        </h4>
                        <p style="font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: 1.5; margin-bottom: 8px;">
                            ${escapeHtml(a.body)}
                        </p>
                        <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); padding-top: 6px;">
                            ${escapeHtml(a.disclaimer)}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
            });

            container.innerHTML = html;
        }

        function renderConsentLedgerTable() {
            const tbody = document.getElementById('consentLedgerTableBody');
            if (!tbody || !alertsBundle) return;

            const ledger = alertsBundle.consent_ledger_audit || [];
            let html = '';

            ledger.forEach(r => {
                const isAct = r.is_active;
                const statusBadge = isAct
                    ? '<span style="font-size: 10px; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 3px; background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2); color: #10b981; font-weight: 700;">ACTIVE</span>'

                const flag = r.jurisdiction === 'CA' ? '🇨🇦 CASL' : '🇺🇸 TCPA';

                html += `
                    <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);">
                        <td style="padding: 10px 12px; font-weight: 700; font-family: monospace; color: var(--text-primary);">${escapeHtml(r.user_id)}</td>
                        <td style="padding: 10px 12px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--accent-cyan); font-weight: 600;">${escapeHtml(r.channel)}</td>
                        <td style="padding: 10px 12px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-secondary);">${escapeHtml(r.consent_type)}</td>

                        <td style="padding: 10px 12px; font-family: monospace; font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted);">${escapeHtml(r.ip_address)}</td>
                        <td style="padding: 10px 12px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted);">${(r.granted_at || '').substring(0, 10)}</td>
                        <td style="padding: 10px 12px; text-align: center;">
                            ${r.double_opt_in ? '<span style="color: var(--accent-green); font-weight: 800;">✓ Verified</span>' : '<span style="color: var(--text-muted);">N/A</span>'}
                        </td>
                        <td style="padding: 10px 12px; text-align: center;">${statusBadge}</td>
                        <td style="padding: 10px 12px; text-align: center;">
                            ${isAct ? `<button class="filter-btn" style="padding: 3px 8px; font-size: 10px; color: var(--accent-red); border-color: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.4);" onclick="simulateRevokeConsent('${escapeHtml(r.user_id)}', '${escapeHtml(r.channel)}')">1-Click Revoke</button>` : '<span style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted);">Revoked (Logged)</span>'}
                        </td>
                    </tr>
                `;
            });

            tbody.innerHTML = html;
        }

        function simulateRevokeConsent(userId, channel) {
            if (!alertsBundle) return;
            const entry = (alertsBundle.consent_ledger_audit || []).find(r => r.user_id === userId && r.channel === channel);
            if (entry) {
                entry.is_active = false;
                entry.revoked_at = new Date().toISOString();
                renderConsentLedgerTable();
                alert(`Instantaneous revocation confirmed for ${userId} on ${channel}.\nCASL 10-business-day mandate honored in 0 business days.`);
            }
        }

        function renderDeepreadSummaryCards() {

                <div class="metric-card" style="background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px;">

                    <div style="font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--accent-green); margin: 6px 0;">${s.citation_resolution_pct}%</div>

                <div class="metric-card" style="background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px;">
