```html
        function setCatalystMarketFilter(mkt) {
            catMarketFilter = mkt;
            const btnAll = document.getElementById('catMarketAll');
            const btnUS = document.getElementById('catMarketUS');
            const btnCA = document.getElementById('catMarketCA');
            const btnMacro = document.getElementById('catMarketMacro');

            if (btnAll) btnAll.classList.toggle('active', mkt === 'ALL');
            if (btnUS) btnUS.classList.toggle('active', mkt === 'US');
            if (btnCA) btnCA.classList.toggle('active', mkt === 'CA');
            if (btnMacro) btnMacro.classList.toggle('active', mkt === 'MACRO');

            filterCatalysts();
        }

        function filterCatalysts() {
            if (!catalystsBundle || !catalystsBundle.catalysts) return;

            const matFilter = document.getElementById('catMaterialityFilter')?.value || 'ALL';
            const catFilter = document.getElementById('catCategoryFilter')?.value || 'ALL';
            const sentFilter = document.getElementById('catSentimentFilter')?.value || 'ALL';
            const q = (document.getElementById('catalystSearchInput')?.value || '').trim().toLowerCase();

            filteredCatalysts = catalystsBundle.catalysts.filter(c => {
                // Market
                if (catMarketFilter !== 'ALL' && c.market !== catMarketFilter) return false;

                // Materiality
                if (matFilter === 'HIGH' && c.materiality_level !== 'HIGH') return false;
                if (matFilter === 'MEDIUM' && c.materiality_score < 3) return false;
                if (matFilter === 'LOW' && c.materiality_level !== 'LOW') return false;

                // Category
                if (catFilter !== 'ALL' && c.event_category !== catFilter) return false;

                // Sentiment
                if (sentFilter === 'BULLISH' && c.sentiment_score <= 0.05) return false;
                if (sentFilter === 'BEARISH' && c.sentiment_score >= -0.05) return false;
                if (sentFilter === 'NEUTRAL' && (c.sentiment_score > 0.05 || c.sentiment_score < -0.05)) return false;

                // Query search
                if (q) {
                    const matchSym = (c.symbol || '').toLowerCase().includes(q);
                    const matchName = (c.company_name || '').toLowerCase().includes(q);
                    const matchHead = (c.headline || '').toLowerCase().includes(q);
                    const matchSummary = (c.summary || '').toLowerCase().includes(q);
                    if (!matchSym && !matchName && !matchHead && !matchSummary) return false;
                }

                return true;
            });

            catCurrentPage = 1;
            renderCatalystsFeed();
        }

        function renderCatalystsFeed() {
            const container = document.getElementById('catalystsFeedContainer');
            if (!container) return;

            if (filteredCatalysts.length === 0) {
                container.innerHTML = `
                    <div style="background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 40px; text-align: center; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 13px;">
                        No catalysts match the selected market, materiality, or search filters.
                    </div>
                `;
                renderCatalystPagination();
                return;
            }

            const startIdx = (catCurrentPage - 1) * catPageSize;
            const endIdx = startIdx + catPageSize;
            const pageItems = filteredCatalysts.slice(startIdx, endIdx);

            let html = '';
            pageItems.forEach(c => {
                const matCls = c.materiality_level === 'HIGH' ? 'mat-high' : (c.materiality_level === 'MEDIUM' ? 'mat-medium' : 'mat-low');
                const sentCls = `sent-${(c.sentiment_label || 'neutral').toLowerCase()}`;
                const has1d = c.reaction_1d_pct != null;
                const r1dColor = has1d ? (c.reaction_1d_pct >= 0 ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-red)') : 'var(--text-muted)';
                const r1dText = has1d ? `${c.reaction_1d_pct >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${c.reaction_1d_pct.toFixed(2)}%` : 'Pending (T+1)';

                const isMacro = c.market === 'MACRO';
                const symButton = isMacro
                    ? `<span class="exchange-tag" style="background: rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.2); color: var(--accent-purple); font-weight: 800; font-size: 12px; padding: 4px 8px;">🏛️ ${c.symbol}</span>`
                    : `<button class="filter-btn" onclick="openSymbol('${c.symbol}')" style="font-weight: 800; font-size: 12px; padding: 4px 10px; cursor: pointer; background: var(--bg-secondary);">
                        ${c.market === 'US' ? '🇺🇸' : '🇨🇦'} ${c.symbol}
                       </button>`;

                let claimsHtml = '';
                if (c.factual_claims && c.factual_claims.length > 0) {
                    claimsHtml = `
                        <div style="margin-top: 10px; background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.5); border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);">
                            <div style="font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 4px;">Verified Factual Claims:</div>
                            <ul style="margin: 0; padding-left: 16px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: 1.5;">
                                ${c.factual_claims.map(claim => `<li>${claim}</li>`).join('')}
                            </ul>
                        </div>
                    `;
                }

                let risksHtml = '';
                if (c.hard_gate_triggered) {
                    risksHtml = `
                        <div style="margin-top: 8px; background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15); border: 1px solid var(--accent-red); border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 12px; color: #fca5a5; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700;">
                            ⚠️ CRITICAL GOVERNANCE / ACCOUNTING HARD GATE TRIGGERED: Non-reliance on financial statements or insolvency proceedings active.
                        </div>
                    `;
                } else if (c.invalidation_risks && c.invalidation_risks.length > 0) {
                    risksHtml = `
                        <div style="margin-top: 6px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 6px;">
                            <span style="color: var(--accent-amber); font-weight: 700;">Risk Consideration:</span>
                            <span>${c.invalidation_risks[0]}</span>
                        </div>
                    `;
                }

                html += `
                    <div class="catalyst-card">
                        <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 8px;">
                            <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap;">
                                ${symButton}
                                <span style="font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-primary);">${c.company_name}</span>
                                <span class="exchange-tag" style="color: var(--accent-cyan); font-weight: 600;">${c.event_category}</span>
                            </div>
                            <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap;">
                                <span class="exchange-tag ${matCls}">${c.materiality_level} (Score ${c.materiality_score}/5)</span>
                                <span class="exchange-tag ${sentCls}">${c.sentiment_label} (${c.sentiment_score >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${c.sentiment_score.toFixed(2)})</span>
                                <span class="exchange-tag" style="color: var(--text-muted);">${c.horizon}</span>
                                <span class="exchange-tag status-${c.priced_in_status.toLowerCase()}">${c.priced_in_status}</span>
                                <span style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); font-family: monospace;">${c.filing_date}</span>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <div style="margin-bottom: 6px;">
                            <a href="${c.source_url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" style="font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-primary); text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--accent-blue); line-height: 1.4;">
                                ${c.headline} <span style="color: var(--accent-blue); font-size: 11px;">↗</span>
                            </a>
                        </div>

                        <div style="color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5;">
                            ${c.summary}
                        </div>

                        ${claimsHtml}
                        ${risksHtml}

                        <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-top: 10px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color); padding-top: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted);">
                            <div style="display: flex; gap: 14px; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap;">
                                <span>1D Post-Reaction: <strong style="color: ${r1dColor};">${r1dText}</strong></span>
                                ${c.reaction_3d_pct != null ? `<span>3D Drift: <strong style="color: ${c.reaction_3d_pct >= 0 ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-red)'};">${c.reaction_3d_pct >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${c.reaction_3d_pct.toFixed(2)}%</strong></span>` : ''}
                                ${c.rvol_at_event != null ? `<span>Event RVOL: <strong style="color: var(--text-primary);">${c.rvol_at_event.toFixed(1)}x</strong></span>` : ''}
                                <span>Score Impact: <strong style="color: ${c.score_impact_pts >= 0 ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-red)'};">${c.score_impact_pts >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${c.score_impact_pts} pts</strong></span>
                            </div>
                            <div>
                                <a href="${c.source_url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" style="color: var(--accent-blue); text-decoration: none; font-weight: 600;">
                                    View Official SEC / Regulatory Record ↗
                                </a>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
            });

            container.innerHTML = html;
            renderCatalystPagination();
        }

        function renderCatalystPagination() {
            const controls = document.getElementById('catPaginationControls');
            if (!controls) return;

            const total = filteredCatalysts.length;
            const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / catPageSize));

            controls.innerHTML = `
                <div style="font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted);">
                    Showing ${(total === 0) ? 0 : (catCurrentPage - 1) * catPageSize + 1}–${Math.min(total, catCurrentPage * catPageSize)} of ${total} continuous intelligence events
                </div>
                <div style="display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center;">
                    <button class="filter-btn" ${catCurrentPage <= 1 ? 'disabled style="opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed;"' : ''} onclick="changeCatPage(${catCurrentPage - 1})">
                        &larr; Previous
                    </button>
                    <span style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-primary); padding: 0 4px;">
                        Page ${catCurrentPage} of ${totalPages}
                    </span>
                    <button class="filter-btn" ${catCurrentPage >= totalPages ? 'disabled style="opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed;"' : ''} onclick="changeCatPage(${catCurrentPage + 1})">
                        Next &rarr;
                    </button>
                </div>
            `;
        }

        function changeCatPage(newPage) {
            const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(filteredCatalysts.length / catPageSize));
            if (newPage < 1 || newPage > totalPages) return;
            catCurrentPage = newPage;
            renderCatalystsFeed();
            window.scrollTo({ top: document.getElementById('tab-catalysts').offsetTop - 60, behavior: 'smooth' });
        }

        // Subtab Navigation
        let activeCatalystSubTab = 'feed';
        let calendarTypeFilter = 'ALL';

        function switchCatalystSubTab(subTabId) {
            activeCatalystSubTab = subTabId;
            document.getElementById('subtabBtnFeed')?.classList.toggle('active', subTabId === 'feed');
            document.getElementById('subtabBtnExpectancy')?.classList.toggle('active', subTabId === 'expectancy');
            document.getElementById('subtabBtnCalendar')?.classList.toggle('active', subTabId === 'calendar');

            const viewFeed = document.getElementById('subview-catalysts-feed');
            const viewExp = document.getElementById('subview-catalysts-expectancy');
            const viewCal = document.getElementById('subview-catalysts-calendar');

            if (viewFeed) viewFeed.style.display = subTabId === 'feed' ? 'block' : 'none';
            if (viewExp) viewExp.style.display = subTabId === 'expectancy' ? 'block' : 'none';
            if (viewCal) viewCal.style.display = subTabId === 'calendar' ? 'block' : 'none';

            if (subTabId === 'expectancy') renderExpectancyMatrix();
            if (subTabId === 'calendar') filterCalendar();
        }

        function renderExpectancyMatrix() {
            const tbody = document.getElementById('expectancyTableBody');
            if (!tbody || !catalystsBundle || !catalystsBundle.category_expectancy) return;

            const items = catalystsBundle.category_expectancy;
            let html = '';

            items.forEach(item => {
                const badgeCls = item.verdict_badge === 'ALPHA EDGE'
                    ? 'verdict-badge-edge'
                    : (item.verdict_badge === 'CONDITIONAL' ? 'verdict-badge-conditional' : 'verdict-badge-noise');

                const r1dColor = item.avg_reaction_1d_pct >= 0 ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-red)';
                const r3dColor = item.avg_reaction_3d_pct >= 0 ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-red)';
                const winColor = item.directional_win_rate_pct >= 55 ? 'var(--accent-green)' : (item.directional_win_rate_pct <= 45 ? 'var(--accent-red)' : 'var(--text-primary)');

                html += `
                    <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color); transition: background 0.15s ease;">
                        <td style="padding: 12px 14px;">
                            <div style="font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-primary); font-size: 13px;">${item.category.replace(/_/g, ' ')}</div>
                            <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); font-family: monospace;">CODE: ${item.category}</div>
                        </td>
                        <td style="padding: 12px 14px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-secondary);">
                            ${item.sample_size}
                        </td>
                        <td style="padding: 12px 14px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace; font-weight: 800; color: ${r1dColor};">
                            ${item.avg_reaction_1d_pct >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${item.avg_reaction_1d_pct.toFixed(2)}%
                        </td>
                        <td style="padding: 12px 14px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace; font-weight: 800; color: ${r3dColor};">
                            ${item.avg_reaction_3d_pct >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${item.avg_reaction_3d_pct.toFixed(2)}%
                        </td>
                        <td style="padding: 12px 14px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace; font-weight: 800; color: ${winColor};">
                            ${item.directional_win_rate_pct.toFixed(1)}%
                        </td>
                        <td style="padding: 12px 14px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace; font-weight: 700; color: var(--accent-cyan);">
                            ${item.avg_rvol.toFixed(1)}x
                        </td>
                        <td style="padding: 12px 14px; text-align: center;">
                            <span class="${badgeCls}">${item.verdict_badge}</span>
                        </td>
                        <td style="padding: 12px 14px; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.4; max-width: 380px;">
                            ${item.notes}
                        </td>
                    </tr>
                `;
            });

            tbody.innerHTML = html;
        }

        function setCalendarTypeFilter(t) {
            calendarTypeFilter = t;
            document.getElementById('calFilterAll')?.classList.toggle('active', t === 'ALL');
            document.getElementById('calFilterRate')?.classList.toggle('active', t === 'POLICY_RATE');
            document.getElementById('calFilterEarnings')?.classList.toggle('active', t === 'EARNINGS');
            document.getElementById('calFilterDividend')?.classList.toggle('active', t === 'DIVIDEND');
            filterCalendar();
        }

        function filterCalendar() {
            const container = document.getElementById('calendarEventsContainer');
            if (!container || !catalystsBundle || !catalystsBundle.event_calendar) return;

            const proxFilter = document.getElementById('calProximityFilter')?.value || 'ALL';
            const allEvents = catalystsBundle.event_calendar;

            const filtered = allEvents.filter(ev => {
                if (calendarTypeFilter !== 'ALL' && ev.event_type !== calendarTypeFilter) return false;
                if (proxFilter !== 'ALL' && ev.proximity_flag !== proxFilter) return false;
                return true;
            });

            if (filtered.length === 0) {
                container.innerHTML = `
                    <div style="background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 40px; text-align: center; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 13px;">
                        No scheduled corporate actions or central bank policy decisions match the selected filters.
                    </div>
                `;
                return;
            }

            let html = '';
            filtered.forEach(ev => {
                const isImmediate = ev.proximity_flag === 'EVENT_RISK_IMMEDIATE';
                const proxBadge = isImmediate
                    ? `<span class="cal-imminent">⚠️ EVENT RISK: &lt; 48H</span>`
                    : `<span class="cal-upcoming">📅 SCHEDULED (${ev.days_until}d)</span>`;

                const typeColor = ev.event_type === 'POLICY_RATE' ? 'var(--accent-purple)' : (ev.event_type === 'EARNINGS' ? 'var(--accent-blue)' : 'var(--accent-green)');
                const isMacro = ev.symbol.startsWith('MACRO');
                const symButton = isMacro
                    ? `<span class="exchange-tag" style="background: rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.2); color: var(--accent-purple); font-weight: 800; font-size: 12px; padding: 4px 8px;">🏛️ ${ev.symbol}</span>`
                    : `<button class="filter-btn" onclick="openSymbol('${ev.symbol}')" style="font-weight: 800; font-size: 12px; padding: 4px 10px; cursor: pointer; background: var(--bg-secondary);">
                        ${ev.market === 'US' ? '🇺🇸' : '🇨🇦'} ${ev.symbol}
                       </button>`;

                html += `
                    <div class="catalyst-card" style="border-left: 4px solid ${isImmediate ? 'var(--accent-red)' : typeColor};">
                        <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 8px;">
                            <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap;">
                                ${symButton}
                                <span style="font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-primary);">${ev.company_name}</span>
                                <span class="exchange-tag" style="color: ${typeColor}; font-weight: 700;">${ev.event_type.replace(/_/g, ' ')}</span>
                            </div>
                            <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap;">
                                ${proxBadge}
                                <span style="font-size: 12px; font-family: monospace; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-primary);">${ev.date}</span>
                                <span class="exchange-tag" style="color: var(--text-muted);">${ev.confirmed ? 'Confirmed' : 'Projected'}</span>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <div style="font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-primary); margin-bottom: 4px;">
                            ${ev.title}
                        </div>

                        <div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: 1.5; margin-bottom: 8px;">
                            ${ev.details}
                        </div>

                        <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color); padding-top: 8px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px;">
                            <div>
                                <span style="font-weight: 700; color: ${isImmediate ? 'var(--accent-red)' : 'var(--accent-amber)'};">Risk Management Protocol:</span>
                                <span>${isImmediate ? 'High volatility event. Binary gap risk — reduce position sizing or tighten trailing stops.' : 'Monitor implied volatility and estimate revisions prior to print.'}</span>
                            </div>
                            <div>
                                <span>Source: <strong style="color: var(--text-secondary);">${ev.source}</strong></span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
            });

            container.innerHTML = html;
        }

        // ==========================================
        // PHASE 1 MVP: RESEARCH JOURNAL & WATCHLISTS
        // ==========================================
        let journalBundle = null;
        let watchlistsBundle = null;
        let feedHealthBundle = null;
        let activeJournalSubTab = 'positions';
        let journalStatusFilter = 'ALL';

        async function loadJournalAndRender() {
            try {
                const [jData, wData, hData] = await Promise.all([
                    fetchJson('/api/journal.json', '/api/journal'),
                    fetchJson('/api/watchlists.json', '/api/watchlists'),
                    fetchJson('/api/feed_health.json', '/api/feed_health')
                ]);
                journalBundle = jData;
                watchlistsBundle = wData;
                feedHealthBundle = hData;

                // Merge local positions from localStorage if present
                const localPos = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('local_journal_positions') || '[]');
                if (localPos && localPos.length > 0) {
                    localPos.forEach(lp => {
                        if (!journalBundle.positions.some(p => p.id === lp.id)) {
                            journalBundle.positions.unshift(lp);
                        }
                    });
                }

                renderJournalView();
                renderWatchlistsView();
            } catch (err) {
                console.error("Failed to load journal/watchlists feed:", err);
            }
        }

        function switchJournalSubTab(subTabId) {
            activeJournalSubTab = subTabId;
            document.getElementById('subtabBtnJournalPositions')?.classList.toggle('active', subTabId === 'positions');
            document.getElementById('subtabBtnWatchlists')?.classList.toggle('active', subTabId === 'watchlists');

            const viewPos = document.getElementById('subview-journal-positions');
            const viewWl = document.getElementById('subview-journal-watchlists');

            if (viewPos) viewPos.style.display = subTabId === 'positions' ? 'block' : 'none';
            if (viewWl) viewWl.style.display = subTabId === 'watchlists' ? 'block' : 'none';

            if (subTabId === 'positions') renderJournalView();
            if (subTabId === 'watchlists') renderWatchlistsView();
        }

        function setJournalStatusFilter(stat) {
            journalStatusFilter = stat;
            document.getElementById('journalFilterAll')?.classList.toggle('active', stat === 'ALL');
            document.getElementById('journalFilterOpen')?.classList.toggle('active', stat === 'OPEN');
            document.getElementById('journalFilterClosed')?.classList.toggle('active', stat === 'CLOSED');
            filterJournal();
        }

        function renderJournalView() {
            if (!journalBundle) return;
            renderJournalMetrics();
            filterJournal();
        }

        function renderJournalMetrics() {
            if (!journalBundle || !journalBundle.summary) return;
            const s = journalBundle.summary;
            const grid = document.getElementById('journalMetricsGrid');
            if (!grid) return;

            let totalOpenVal = 0;
            let totalUnrealPnl = 0;
            let totalOpenCost = 0;
            let openCnt = 0;
            let closedCnt = 0;
            let winClosedCnt = 0;
            let totalRealPnl = 0;

            const fxFactor = s.cad_usd_exchange_rate ? (1 / s.cad_usd_exchange_rate) : 0.74;

            journalBundle.positions.forEach(p => {
                if (p.status === 'OPEN') {
                    openCnt++;
                    const curPrice = p.current_price || p.entry_price;
                    const val = p.shares * curPrice;
                    const cost = p.shares * p.entry_price;
                    const unPnl = val - cost;
                    const valUsd = p.currency === 'USD' ? val : val * fxFactor;
                    const costUsd = p.currency === 'USD' ? cost : cost * fxFactor;
                    const unPnlUsd = p.currency === 'USD' ? unPnl : unPnl * fxFactor;
                    totalOpenVal += valUsd;
                    totalOpenCost += costUsd;
                    totalUnrealPnl += unPnlUsd;
                } else if (p.status === 'CLOSED') {
                    closedCnt++;
                    const exitP = p.exit_price || p.entry_price;
                    const realPnl = (p.shares * exitP) - (p.shares * p.entry_price);
                    const realPnlUsd = p.currency === 'USD' ? realPnl : realPnl * fxFactor;
                    totalRealPnl += realPnlUsd;
                    if (realPnl > 0) winClosedCnt++;
                }
            });

            const unPnlPct = totalOpenCost > 0 ? (totalUnrealPnl / totalOpenCost) * 100 : 0;
            const winRate = closedCnt > 0 ? ((winClosedCnt / closedCnt) * 100).toFixed(1) : 'N/A';

            grid.innerHTML = `
                <div class="scorecard-card" style="background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px;">
                    <div style="font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">Open Portfolio Value</div>
                    <div style="font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--text-primary); margin: 4px 0;">
                        $${totalOpenVal.toLocaleString(undefined, {minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2})} <span style="font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted);">USD</span>
                    </div>
                    <div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--accent-cyan);">
                        ≈ C$${(totalOpenVal * (s.cad_usd_exchange_rate || 1.35)).toLocaleString(undefined, {minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2})} CAD Eq.
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="scorecard-card" style="background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px;">
                    <div style="font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">Tracked Positions</div>
                    <div style="font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--text-primary); margin: 4px 0;">
                        ${openCnt} Active <span style="font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 600;">/ ${closedCnt} Closed</span>
                    </div>
                    <div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted);">
                        ${openCnt + closedCnt} total self-directed research entries
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="scorecard-card" style="background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px;">
                    <div style="font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">Unrealized P&L</div>
                    <div style="font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; color: ${totalUnrealPnl >= 0 ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-red)'}; margin: 4px 0;">
                        ${totalUnrealPnl >= 0 ? '+' : ''}$${totalUnrealPnl.toLocaleString(undefined, {minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2})}
                    </div>
                    <div style="font-size: 11px; color: ${unPnlPct >= 0 ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-red)'}; font-weight: 700;">
                        ${unPnlPct >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${unPnlPct.toFixed(2)}% on open cost basis
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="scorecard-card" style="background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px;">
                    <div style="font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">Closed Performance</div>
                    <div style="font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; color: ${totalRealPnl >= 0 ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-red)'}; margin: 4px 0;">
                        ${totalRealPnl >= 0 ? '+' : ''}$${totalRealPnl.toLocaleString(undefined, {minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2})}
                    </div>
                    <div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted);">
                        Win Rate: <strong style="color: ${parseFloat(winRate) >= 50 ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-amber)'};">${winRate}%</strong> · BoC FX: ${s.cad_usd_exchange_rate}
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;
        }

        function filterJournal() {
            const tbody = document.getElementById('journalTableBody');
            if (!tbody || !journalBundle || !journalBundle.positions) return;

            const mktFilter = document.getElementById('journalMarketFilter')?.value || 'ALL';
            const stratFilter = document.getElementById('journalStrategyFilter')?.value || 'ALL';
            const searchQ = (document.getElementById('journalSearchInput')?.value || '').trim().toLowerCase();

            const filtered = journalBundle.positions.filter(p => {
                if (journalStatusFilter !== 'ALL' && p.status !== journalStatusFilter) return false;
                if (mktFilter !== 'ALL' && p.market !== mktFilter) return false;
                if (stratFilter !== 'ALL' && p.strategy_tag !== stratFilter) return false;
                if (searchQ) {
                    const matchSym = (p.symbol || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchQ);
                    const matchThesis = (p.thesis_notes || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchQ);
                    if (!matchSym && !matchThesis) return false;
                }
                return true;
            });

            if (filtered.length === 0) {
                tbody.innerHTML = `
                    <tr>
                        <td colspan="11" style="text-align: center; padding: 40px; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 13px;">
                            No research positions match the selected filters. Click <strong>+ Log Research Position</strong> to add an entry.
                        </td>
                    </tr>
                `;
                return;
            }

            let html = '';
            filtered.forEach(p => {
                const isOpen = p.status === 'OPEN';
                const curP = p.current_price || p.entry_price;
                const costBasis = p.shares * p.entry_price;
                const mktVal = p.shares * curP;
                const pnl = isOpen ? (mktVal - costBasis) : ((p.exit_price || curP) * p.shares - costBasis);
                const pnlPct = costBasis > 0 ? (pnl / costBasis) * 100 : 0;
                const pnlColor = pnl >= 0 ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-red)';
                const currSign = p.currency === 'CAD' ? 'C$' : '$';

                let rrHtml = '—';
                if (p.stop_loss && p.profit_target && Math.abs(p.entry_price - p.stop_loss) > 0.001) {
                    const rr = Math.abs(p.profit_target - p.entry_price) / Math.abs(p.entry_price - p.stop_loss);
                    rrHtml = `
                        <div style="font-size: 11px;">Stop: <strong style="color: var(--accent-red);">${currSign}${p.stop_loss.toFixed(2)}</strong></div>
                        <div style="font-size: 11px;">Target: <strong style="color: var(--accent-green);">${currSign}${p.profit_target.toFixed(2)}</strong></div>
                        <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--accent-cyan); font-weight: 700;">R:R ${rr.toFixed(2)}x</div>
                    `;
                }

                let exitStateHtml = '<span style="color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 11px;">Closed Position</span>';
                if (isOpen) {
                    const lState = p.lifecycle_state || (p.exit_verdict ? p.exit_verdict.state : 'HOLD');
                    let pillStyle = 'background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15); color: #10b981; border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3);';
                    if (lState === 'WATCH') {
                        pillStyle = 'background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15); color: #f59e0b; border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.3);';
                    } else if (lState === 'REDUCE') {
                        pillStyle = 'background: rgba(249, 115, 22, 0.15); color: #f97316; border: 1px solid rgba(249, 115, 22, 0.4);';
                    } else if (lState === 'EXIT') {
                        pillStyle = 'background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15); color: #ef4444; border: 1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.4);';
                    } else if (lState === 'EMERGENCY_RISK') {
                        pillStyle = 'background: rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.25); color: #ff4d4d; border: 1px solid #ff4d4d; font-weight: 800;';
                    }

                    const alloc = p.target_allocation_pct !== undefined ? p.target_allocation_pct : (p.exit_verdict ? p.exit_verdict.target_allocation_pct : 100);
                    const trail = p.suggested_trailing_stop || (p.exit_verdict ? p.exit_verdict.suggested_trailing_stop : null);
                    const actionTxt = p.action_summary || (p.exit_verdict ? p.exit_verdict.action_summary : 'Maintain constructive position structure');

                    exitStateHtml = `
                        <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 3px;">
                            <span class="score-pill" style="font-size: 10px; padding: 2px 8px; ${pillStyle}">${lState}</span>
                            <span style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">${alloc}% Alloc</span>
                        </div>
                        <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: 1.3; max-width: 220px;">${actionTxt}</div>
                        ${trail ? `<div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--accent-cyan); margin-top: 2px;">Trail: <strong>${currSign}${trail.toFixed(2)}</strong></div>` : ''}
                    `;
                }

                const stars = '★'.repeat(p.conviction || 3) + '☆'.repeat(5 - (p.conviction || 3));

                html += `
                    <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color); transition: background 0.15s ease;">
                        <td style="padding: 12px 14px;">
                            <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;">
                                <button class="filter-btn" onclick="openSymbol('${p.symbol}')" style="font-weight: 800; font-size: 12px; padding: 2px 8px; cursor: pointer;">
                                    ${p.market === 'US' ? '🇺🇸' : '🇨🇦'} ${p.symbol}
                                </button>
                                <span style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted);">${p.company_name || ''}</span>
                            </div>
                        </td>
                        <td style="padding: 12px 14px;">
                            <span class="exchange-tag" style="font-weight: 700; ${p.direction === 'LONG' ? 'color: var(--accent-green); border-color: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.4);' : 'color: var(--accent-red); border-color: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.4);'}">
                                ${p.direction}
                            </span>
                            <span class="exchange-tag" style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted);">${p.currency}</span>
                        </td>
                        <td style="padding: 12px 14px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace; font-weight: 700;">
                            ${p.shares}
                        </td>
                        <td style="padding: 12px 14px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-primary);">
                            ${currSign}${p.entry_price.toFixed(2)}
                            <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted);">${p.entry_date || ''}</div>
                        </td>
                        <td style="padding: 12px 14px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace; font-weight: 700;">
                            ${isOpen ? `${currSign}${curP.toFixed(2)}` : `<span style="color: var(--accent-blue);">${currSign}${(p.exit_price || curP).toFixed(2)}</span>`}
                            ${!isOpen ? `<div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted);">Exit: ${p.exit_date || ''}</div>` : ''}
                        </td>
                        <td style="padding: 12px 14px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-primary);">
                            ${currSign}${mktVal.toLocaleString(undefined, {minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2})}
                        </td>
                        <td style="padding: 12px 14px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace; font-weight: 800; color: ${pnlColor};">
                            ${pnl >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${currSign}${pnl.toLocaleString(undefined, {minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2})}
                            <div style="font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700;">${pnlPct >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${pnlPct.toFixed(2)}%</div>
                        </td>
                        <td style="padding: 12px 14px;">
                            ${rrHtml}
                        </td>
                        <td style="padding: 12px 14px;">
                            ${exitStateHtml}
                        </td>
                        <td style="padding: 12px 14px; text-align: center; color: var(--accent-amber); font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 1px;">
                            ${stars}
                        </td>
                        <td style="padding: 12px 14px; max-width: 260px;">
                            <span class="exchange-tag" style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--accent-cyan);">${p.strategy_tag || 'MANUAL'}</span>
                            <div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: 1.4; margin-top: 4px;">${p.thesis_notes || 'No thesis logged.'}</div>
                        </td>
                        <td style="padding: 12px 14px; text-align: center;">
                            <div style="display: flex; gap: 4px; justify-content: center;">
                                ${isOpen ? `<button class="filter-btn" onclick="closeJournalPosition(${p.id})" style="font-size: 10px; padding: 3px 6px; color: var(--accent-amber); cursor: pointer;" title="Mark as Closed">Close</button>` : ''}
                                <button class="filter-btn" onclick="deleteJournalPosition(${p.id})" style="font-size: 10px; padding: 3px 6px; color: var(--accent-red); cursor: pointer;" title="Delete Position">&times;</button>
                            </div>
                        </td>
                    </tr>
                `;
            });

            tbody.innerHTML = html;
        }

        function renderWatchlistsView() {
            if (!watchlistsBundle || !watchlistsBundle.watchlists) return;
            const select = document.getElementById('activeWatchlistSelect');
            if (!select) return;

            const prevVal = select.value;
            select.innerHTML = watchlistsBundle.watchlists.map(w => `
                <option value="${w.watchlist_id}">${w.name} (${w.items.length} symbols)</option>
            `).join('');

            if (prevVal) select.value = prevVal;
            renderWatchlistItems();
        }

        function changeActiveWatchlist() {
            renderWatchlistItems();
        }

        function renderWatchlistItems() {
            const tbody = document.getElementById('watchlistTableBody');
            const select = document.getElementById('activeWatchlistSelect');
            if (!tbody || !select || !watchlistsBundle) return;

            const selectedId = parseInt(select.value, 10);
            const activeWl = watchlistsBundle.watchlists.find(w => w.watchlist_id === selectedId) || watchlistsBundle.watchlists[0];
            if (!activeWl) return;

            if (!activeWl.items || activeWl.items.length === 0) {
                tbody.innerHTML = `
                    <tr>
                        <td colspan="7" style="text-align: center; padding: 40px; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 13px;">
                            This watchlist is currently empty. Use the input above or click <strong>★ Watchlist</strong> in any symbol dossier to add securities.
                        </td>
                    </tr>
                `;
                return;
            }

            let html = '';
            activeWl.items.forEach(item => {
                const currSign = item.currency === 'CAD' ? 'C$' : '$';
                const scoreCls = (item.composite_score || 50) >= 60 ? 'score-high' : 'score-mid';

                html += `
                    <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color); transition: background 0.15s ease;">
                        <td style="padding: 12px 14px;">
                            <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;">
                                <button class="filter-btn" onclick="openSymbol('${item.symbol}')" style="font-weight: 800; font-size: 12px; padding: 3px 8px; cursor: pointer;">
                                    ${item.market === 'US' ? '🇺🇸' : '🇨🇦'} ${item.symbol}
                                </button>
                                <span style="font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-primary); font-size: 13px;">${item.company_name || ''}</span>
                            </div>
                        </td>
                        <td style="padding: 12px 14px;">
                            <span class="exchange-tag">${item.market}</span>
                            <span class="exchange-tag" style="color: var(--text-muted);">${item.currency}</span>
                        </td>
                        <td style="padding: 12px 14px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-primary);">
                            ${currSign}${(item.last_price || 0).toFixed(2)}
                        </td>
                        <td style="padding: 12px 14px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace; font-weight: 700; color: var(--accent-cyan);">
                            ${(item.rvol || 1.0).toFixed(1)}x
                        </td>
                        <td style="padding: 12px 14px; text-align: center;">
                            <span class="score-pill ${scoreCls}" style="font-size: 12px; padding: 2px 8px;">
                                ${item.composite_score || 50}/100
                            </span>
                        </td>
                        <td style="padding: 12px 14px; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 11px;">
                            ${item.notes || 'Added to watchlist.'}
                        </td>
                        <td style="padding: 12px 14px; text-align: center;">
                            <button class="filter-btn" onclick="removeSymbolFromWatchlist('${item.symbol}')" style="font-size: 11px; padding: 3px 8px; color: var(--accent-red); cursor: pointer;">
                                Remove
                            </button>
                        </td>
                    </tr>
                `;
            });

            tbody.innerHTML = html;
        }

        function addSymbolToCurrentWatchlist() {
            const input = document.getElementById('quickAddWatchlistSymbol');
            if (!input || !input.value.trim()) return;
            const sym = input.value.trim().toUpperCase();
            input.value = '';

            quickAddCurrentSymbolToWatchlist(sym);
        }

        function quickAddCurrentSymbolToWatchlist(sym) {
            if (!watchlistsBundle || !watchlistsBundle.watchlists || watchlistsBundle.watchlists.length === 0) return;
            const select = document.getElementById('activeWatchlistSelect');
            const targetId = select ? parseInt(select.value, 10) : watchlistsBundle.watchlists[0].watchlist_id;
            const wl = watchlistsBundle.watchlists.find(w => w.watchlist_id === targetId) || watchlistsBundle.watchlists[0];

            if (wl.items.some(i => i.symbol === sym)) {
                alert(`${sym} is already in watchlist "${wl.name}".`);
                return;
            }

            wl.items.push({
                item_id: Date.now(),
                symbol: sym,
                company_name: sym,
                market: sym.endsWith('.TO') || ['RY', 'TD', 'CNQ', 'ENB', 'BAM', 'SHOP', 'CNR', 'CP', 'BN'].includes(sym) ? 'CA' : 'US',
                currency: sym.endsWith('.TO') || ['RY', 'TD', 'CNQ', 'ENB', 'BAM', 'SHOP', 'CNR', 'CP', 'BN'].includes(sym) ? 'CAD' : 'USD',
                last_price: 100.0,
                rvol: 1.2,
                composite_score: 65,
                notes: 'User custom watchlist candidate',
                added_at: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]
            });

            renderWatchlistItems();
            alert(`✓ Added ${sym} to watchlist "${wl.name}"`);
        }

        function removeSymbolFromWatchlist(sym) {
            if (!watchlistsBundle) return;
            const select = document.getElementById('activeWatchlistSelect');
            const targetId = select ? parseInt(select.value, 10) : watchlistsBundle.watchlists[0].watchlist_id;
            const wl = watchlistsBundle.watchlists.find(w => w.watchlist_id === targetId);
            if (!wl) return;

            wl.items = wl.items.filter(i => i.symbol !== sym);
            renderWatchlistItems();
        }

        // Modals & User Actions
        function openFeedHealthModal() {
            const modal = document.getElementById('feedHealthModal');
            const overlay = document.getElementById('modalOverlay');
            const content = document.getElementById('feedHealthContent');
            if (!modal || !overlay || !content) return;

            if (!feedHealthBundle) {
                fetchJson('/api/feed_health.json', '/api/feed_health')
                    .then(data => {
                        feedHealthBundle = data;
                        renderFeedHealthContent();
                    });
            } else {
                renderFeedHealthContent();
            }

            overlay.style.display = 'block';
            modal.style.display = 'block';
        }

        function renderFeedHealthContent() {
            const content = document.getElementById('feedHealthContent');
            if (!content || !feedHealthBundle) return;

            const feeds = feedHealthBundle.feeds || [];
            const events = feedHealthBundle.data_quality_events || [];

            content.innerHTML = `
                <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr)); gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 20px;">
                    ${feeds.map(f => `
                        <div style="background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 6px; padding: 12px;">
                            <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; margin-bottom: 4px;">
                                <span style="font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-primary); font-size: 13px;">${f.name}</span>
                                <span class="exchange-tag" style="background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15); color: var(--accent-green); border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.4); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800;">
                                    ${f.status}
                                </span>
                            </div>
                            <div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 6px;">
                                Source: <strong>${f.primary_source}</strong>
                            </div>
                            <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 11px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color); padding-top: 6px; color: var(--text-secondary);">
                                <span>Freshness: <strong style="color: var(--accent-cyan);">${f.freshness_hours}h ago</strong></span>
                                <span>Records: <strong>${f.records_count}</strong></span>
                                <span>Coverage: <strong>${f.coverage_pct}%</strong></span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    `).join('')}
                </div>

                <h4 style="font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-secondary); margin-bottom: 8px;">
                    Recent Data Quality & Reconciliation Audit Log (Bitemporal Knowledge Verification)
                </h4>
                <div style="background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 6px; max-height: 180px; overflow-y: auto; padding: 8px; font-size: 11px;">
                    ${events.map(ev => `
                        <div style="display: flex; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); align-items: baseline;">
                            <span class="exchange-tag" style="font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700;">${ev.dimension}</span>
                            <span style="color: var(--accent-green); font-weight: 700;">[${ev.status}]</span>
                            <span style="color: var(--text-secondary); flex-grow: 1;">${ev.description}</span>
                            <span style="color: var(--text-muted); font-family: monospace; font-size: 10px;">${ev.detected_at || ''}</span>
                        </div>
                    `).join('')}
                </div>

                <div style="margin-top: 16px; text-align: right;">
                    <button class="filter-btn" onclick="closeAllModals()">Close Console</button>
                </div>
            `;
        }

        function openConsentModal() {
            document.getElementById('modalOverlay').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('consentModal').style.display = 'block';
        }

        function openJournalEntryModal() {
            document.getElementById('modalOverlay').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('journalEntryModal').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('jPosEntryDate').value = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
        }

        async function openFundamentalsAuditModal() {
            const modal = document.getElementById('fundamentalsAuditModal');
            const overlay = document.getElementById('modalOverlay');
            const content = document.getElementById('fundamentalsAuditContent');

            overlay.style.display = 'block';
            modal.style.display = 'block';
            content.innerHTML = '<div style="padding: 30px; text-align: center; color: var(--text-muted);">Auditing Point-In-Time Fundamentals coverage...</div>';

            try {
                const data = await fetchJson('/api/fundamentals_coverage.json', '/api/fundamentals_coverage');
                const usStatusColor = data.us_dod_passed ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-red)';
                const caStatusColor = data.ca_dod_passed ? 'var(--accent-green)' : 'var(--accent-red)';

                let rowsHtml = '';
                data.matrix.forEach(row => {
                    const stColor = row.status === 'FULL' ? 'var(--accent-green)' : (row.status === 'PARTIAL' ? 'var(--accent-amber)' : 'var(--accent-blue)');
                    const missingText = (row.missing && row.missing.length > 0) ? `<code>${row.missing.join(', ')}</code>` : '<span style="color: var(--text-muted);">-</span>';
                    rowsHtml += `
                        <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); font-size: 11px;">
                            <td style="padding: 6px 10px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--text-primary); cursor: pointer;" onclick="closeAllModals(); openSymbol('${row.symbol}')">
                                ${row.country === 'US' ? '🇺🇸' : '🇨🇦'} ${row.symbol}
                            </td>
                            <td style="padding: 6px 10px; color: var(--text-secondary);">${row.exchange}</td>
                            <td style="padding: 6px 10px;">
                                <span class="exchange-tag" style="color: ${stColor}; font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px;">${row.status.replace(/_/g, ' ')}</span>
                            </td>
                            <td style="padding: 6px 10px; text-align: right; font-weight: 700; font-family: monospace;">${row.fundamental_score}/100</td>
                            <td style="padding: 6px 10px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace; color: var(--accent-green);">${row.quality_score}</td>
                            <td style="padding: 6px 10px; text-align: right; font-family: monospace; color: var(--accent-cyan);">${row.valuation_score}</td>
                            <td style="padding: 6px 10px; font-size: 10px;">${missingText}</td>
                        </tr>
                    `;
                });

                content.innerHTML = `
                    <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 16px;">
                        <div style="background: var(--bg-card); padding: 12px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border-color);">
                            <div style="font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">US Core Equities Coverage (DoD &ge; 95%)</div>
                            <div style="font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; color: ${usStatusColor}; margin-top: 4px;">
                                ${data.us_coverage_pct}% <span style="font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 600;">(${data.us_covered_count} / ${data.us_core_count} covered)</span>
                            </div>
                            <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-secondary); margin-top: 4px;">SEC EDGAR 10-K/10-Q XBRL point-in-time canonical concepts</div>
                        </div>
                        <div style="background: var(--bg-card); padding: 12px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border-color);">
                            <div style="font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">Canadian Core Equities Coverage (DoD &ge; 80%)</div>
                            <div style="font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; color: ${caStatusColor}; margin-top: 4px;">
                                ${data.ca_coverage_pct}% <span style="font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 600;">(${data.ca_covered_count} / ${data.ca_core_count} covered)</span>
                            </div>
                            <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-secondary); margin-top: 4px;">IFRS-Full + US-GAAP 40-F/6-K filing-date gated with weight renormalization</div>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <div style="max-height: 260px; overflow-y: auto; border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 6px; margin-bottom: 16px;">
                        <table style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; text-align: left;">
                            <thead style="background: var(--bg-secondary); position: sticky; top: 0; font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted);">
                                <tr>
                                    <th style="padding: 6px 10px;">Security</th>
                                    <th style="padding: 6px 10px;">Exch</th>
                                    <th style="padding: 6px 10px;">Status</th>
                                    <th style="padding: 6px 10px; text-align: right;">Fund Score</th>
                                    <th style="padding: 6px 10px; text-align: right;">Quality</th>
                                    <th style="padding: 6px 10px; text-align: right;">Valuation</th>
                                    <th style="padding: 6px 10px;">Missing Concepts (Renormalized)</th>
                                </tr>
                            </thead>
                            <tbody>
                                ${rowsHtml}
                            </tbody>
                        </table>
                    </div>

                    <div style="display: flex; justify-content: flex-end;">
                        <button class="filter-btn" onclick="closeAllModals()">Close Audit Console</button>
                    </div>
                `;
            } catch (err) {
                content.innerHTML = '<div style="color: var(--accent-red); padding: 20px;">Failed to load fundamentals coverage audit.</div>';
            }
        }

        function closeAllModals() {
            document.getElementById('modalOverlay').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('modalOverlay').style.zIndex = '150';
            document.getElementById('feedHealthModal').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('consentModal').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('journalEntryModal').style.display = 'none';
            const cpModal = document.getElementById('commandPaletteModal');
            if (cpModal) cpModal.style.display = 'none';
            const fModal = document.getElementById('fundamentalsAuditModal');
            if (fModal) fModal.style.display = 'none';
            const sModal = document.getElementById('strategyModal');
            if (sModal) sModal.style.display = 'none';
        }

        async function openStrategyModal(strategyId) {
            closeDrawer();
            closeAllModals();
            const overlay = document.getElementById('modalOverlay');
            const modal = document.getElementById('strategyModal');
            const titleEl = document.getElementById('strategyModalTitle');
            const content = document.getElementById('strategyModalContent');
            if (!overlay || !modal || !content) return;

            overlay.style.display = 'block';
            modal.style.display = 'block';

            let mappedId = idUpper;
            if (idUpper.includes('META') || idUpper.includes('PO3_META') || idUpper === 'TAC-15-ML') {
                mappedId = 'PO3_META_GATED';
            } else if (idUpper.includes('PO3') || idUpper.includes('SWEEP') || idUpper === 'TAC-15' || idUpper === 'TAC15') {

                mappedId = 'TAC01_PULLBACK';

                mappedId = 'TAC02_SQUEEZE';

        function toggleAttestation() {
            const checked = document.getElementById('userAttestationCheckbox')?.checked;
            localStorage.setItem('user_attestation_confirmed', checked ? 'true' : 'false');
            localStorage.setItem('user_attestation_date', new Date().toISOString());
        }

        function quickLogCurrentSymbolInJournal(sym, price, currency) {
            closeDrawer();
            openJournalEntryModal();
            document.getElementById('jPosSymbol').value = sym;
            document.getElementById('jPosCurrency').value = currency || 'USD';
            document.getElementById('jPosEntryPrice').value = price || '';
            document.getElementById('jPosShares').value = '50';
            document.getElementById('jPosStopLoss').value = (price * 0.95).toFixed(2);
            document.getElementById('jPosProfitTarget').value = (price * 1.10).toFixed(2);
        }

        function saveJournalEntry(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            if (!journalBundle) return;

            const sym = document.getElementById('jPosSymbol').value.trim().toUpperCase();
            const curr = document.getElementById('jPosCurrency').value;
            const dir = document.getElementById('jPosDirection').value;
            const shares = parseFloat(document.getElementById('jPosShares').value);
            const entryP = parseFloat(document.getElementById('jPosEntryPrice').value);
            const entryD = document.getElementById('jPosEntryDate').value;
            const stopL = parseFloat(document.getElementById('jPosStopLoss').value) || null;
            const targetP = parseFloat(document.getElementById('jPosProfitTarget').value) || null;
            const conv = parseInt(document.getElementById('jPosConviction').value, 10);
            const strat = document.getElementById('jPosStrategy').value;
            const thesis = document.getElementById('jPosThesis').value.trim();

            const isCA = sym.endsWith('.TO') || ['RY', 'TD', 'CNQ', 'ENB', 'BAM', 'SHOP', 'CNR', 'CP', 'BN'].includes(sym);

            const newPos = {
                id: Date.now(),
                symbol: sym,
                company_name: sym,
                market: isCA ? 'CA' : 'US',
                currency: curr,
                direction: dir,
                shares: shares,
                entry_price: entryP,
                entry_date: entryD,
                current_price: entryP,
                stop_loss: stopL,
                profit_target: targetP,
                exit_price: null,
                exit_date: null,
                status: 'OPEN',
                conviction: conv,
                strategy_tag: strat,
                thesis_notes: thesis || 'Self-directed research position logged.'
            };

            journalBundle.positions.unshift(newPos);

            // Persist to localStorage
            const localPos = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('local_journal_positions') || '[]');
            localPos.unshift(newPos);
            localStorage.setItem('local_journal_positions', JSON.stringify(localPos));

            closeAllModals();
            renderJournalView();
            alert(`✓ Research position for ${sym} successfully logged in journal.`);
        }

        function closeJournalPosition(id) {
            if (!journalBundle) return;
            const pos = journalBundle.positions.find(p => p.id === id);
            if (!pos) return;

            const exitPriceStr = prompt(`Closing position for ${pos.symbol}. Enter exit price:`, (pos.current_price || pos.entry_price).toFixed(2));
            if (!exitPriceStr) return;
            const exitP = parseFloat(exitPriceStr);
            if (isNaN(exitP) || exitP <= 0) return;

            pos.status = 'CLOSED';
            pos.exit_price = exitP;
            pos.exit_date = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];

            // Update localStorage
            const localPos = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('local_journal_positions') || '[]');
            const idx = localPos.findIndex(p => p.id === id);
            if (idx >= 0) {
                localPos[idx] = pos;
                localStorage.setItem('local_journal_positions', JSON.stringify(localPos));
            }

            renderJournalView();
        }

        function deleteJournalPosition(id) {
            if (!confirm("Are you sure you want to remove this research position from your journal?")) return;
            if (!journalBundle) return;

            journalBundle.positions = journalBundle.positions.filter(p => p.id !== id);

            // Remove from localStorage
            let localPos = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('local_journal_positions') || '[]');
            localPos = localPos.filter(p => p.id !== id);
            localStorage.setItem('local_journal_positions', JSON.stringify(localPos));

            renderJournalView();
        }

        function exportJournalData(format) {
            if (!journalBundle || !journalBundle.positions) return;

            if (format === 'json') {
                const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(journalBundle, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
                const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                const a = document.createElement('a');
                a.href = url;
                a.download = `research_journal_${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.json`;
                a.click();
            } else if (format === 'csv') {
                const headers = ['ID', 'Symbol', 'Market', 'Currency', 'Direction', 'Shares', 'Entry Price', 'Entry Date', 'Current/Exit Price', 'Status', 'Stop Loss', 'Profit Target', 'Conviction', 'Strategy Tag', 'Thesis'];
                const rows = journalBundle.positions.map(p => [
                    p.id,
                    p.symbol,
                    p.market,
                    p.currency,
                    p.direction,
                    p.shares,
                    p.entry_price,
                    `"${p.entry_date || ''}"`,
                    p.status === 'OPEN' ? (p.current_price || p.entry_price) : (p.exit_price || p.entry_price),
                    p.status,
                    p.stop_loss || '',
                    p.profit_target || '',
                    p.conviction || 3,
                    `"${p.strategy_tag || ''}"`,
                    `"${(p.thesis_notes || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`
                ]);
                const csvContent = [headers.join(','), ...rows.map(r => r.join(','))].join('\n');
                const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: 'text/csv' });
                const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                const a = document.createElement('a');
                a.href = url;
                a.download = `research_journal_${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.csv`;
                a.click();
            }
        }

        function exportWatchlistData(format) {
            if (!watchlistsBundle) return;
            const select = document.getElementById('activeWatchlistSelect');
            const targetId = select ? parseInt(select.value, 10) : watchlistsBundle.watchlists[0].watchlist_id;
            const wl = watchlistsBundle.watchlists.find(w => w.watchlist_id === targetId);
            if (!wl) return;

            const headers = ['Symbol', 'Company Name', 'Market', 'Currency', 'Last Price', '24h RVOL', 'Score', 'Notes', 'Added At'];
            const rows = wl.items.map(i => [
                i.symbol,
                `"${(i.company_name || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
                i.market,
                i.currency,
                i.last_price || 0,
                i.rvol || 1.0,
                i.composite_score || 50,
                `"${(i.notes || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
                `"${i.added_at || ''}"`
            ]);
            const csvContent = [headers.join(','), ...rows.map(r => r.join(','))].join('\n');
            const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: 'text/csv' });
            const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            const a = document.createElement('a');
            a.href = url;
            a.download = `${wl.name.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '_')}_${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.csv`;
            a.click();
        }

        window.onload = init;
    </script>
</body>
```

```python
"""
Dual-Market Intelligence Web Dashboard Server
Serves static edge assets and JSON endpoints for Cloudflare Pages / Preview.
Binds to 0.0.0.0:8000 for preview proxy compatibility.
"""

import sys
import os
import json
from pathlib import Path
from http.server import HTTPServer, SimpleHTTPRequestHandler
import urllib.parse

BASE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
FEEDS_DIR = BASE_DIR / "data" / "feeds"
DIST_DIR = BASE_DIR / "data" / "dist"

def get_data_dir() -> Path:
    if FEEDS_DIR.exists() and (FEEDS_DIR / "daily_summary.json").exists():
        return FEEDS_DIR
    return DIST_DIR
WEB_DIR = BASE_DIR / "web"


class MarketIntelHandler(SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, directory=str(WEB_DIR), **kwargs)

    def end_headers(self):
        # Enable CORS and anti-caching for real-time edge updates
        self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
        self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "GET, OPTIONS")
        self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "Content-Type")
        self.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate")
        super().end_headers()

    def do_OPTIONS(self):
        self.send_response(200)
        self.end_headers()

    def do_HEAD(self):
        parsed = urllib.parse.urlparse(self.path)
        path = parsed.path
        if path.startswith("/api/"):
            self._is_head = True
            try:
                self.do_GET()
            finally:
                self._is_head = False
        else:
            super().do_HEAD()

    def do_GET(self):
        parsed = urllib.parse.urlparse(self.path)
        path = parsed.path
        data_dir = get_data_dir()

        # Route root terminal dashboard requests
        if path == "/" or path == "/index.html":
            index_candidates = [
                Path(__file__).parent / "index.html",
                Path(__file__).parent.parent / "public" / "index.html",
            ]
            for cand in index_candidates:
                if cand.exists():
                    self.send_response(200)
                    self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
                    with open(cand, "rb") as f:
                        content = f.read()
                    self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(content)))
                    self.end_headers()
                    if not getattr(self, "_is_head", False):
                        self.wfile.write(content)
                    return

        # Route API requests to data/feeds or data/dist
        if path.startswith("/api/"):
            # Route Server-Sent Events (SSE) Real-Time Tick Stream (Phase 25)
            if path.startswith("/api/stream/ticks"):
                return self._handle_sse_stream(parsed)

            # Route Algorithmic Execution Simulation & TCA Endpoint (Phase 25.3)
            if path.startswith("/api/execution/simulate") or path.startswith("/api/tca"):
                return self._handle_execution_simulation(parsed)

            clean_sub = path[len("/api/"):].lstrip("/")
            if clean_sub.startswith("symbols/") or clean_sub.startswith("symbol/"):
                clean = clean_sub.replace("symbols/", "").replace("symbol/", "").replace(".json", "")
                sym = clean.strip().upper()
                sym_file = data_dir / "symbols" / f"{sym}.json"
                return self._serve_json_file(sym_file)

            alias_map = {
                "summary": "daily_summary.json",
                "summary.json": "daily_summary.json",
                "daily_summary": "daily_summary.json",
                "daily_summary.json": "daily_summary.json",
                "catalysts": "news_filings.json",
                "catalysts.json": "news_filings.json",
            }
            if clean_sub in alias_map:
                return self._serve_json_file(data_dir / alias_map[clean_sub])

            target_filename = clean_sub if clean_sub.endswith(".json") else f"{clean_sub}.json"
            candidate_file = data_dir / target_filename
            if candidate_file.exists():
                return self._serve_json_file(candidate_file)
            elif (data_dir / clean_sub).exists():
                return self._serve_json_file(data_dir / clean_sub)

        # Default to static file serving
        return super().do_GET()

    def _serve_json_file(self, file_path: Path):
        if not file_path.exists():
            self.send_response(404)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(json.dumps({"error": f"Resource not found: {file_path.name}"}).encode("utf-8"))
            return

        try:
            with open(file_path, "rb") as f:
                content = f.read()
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(content)))
            self.end_headers()
            if not getattr(self, "_is_head", False):
                self.wfile.write(content)
        except Exception as e:
            self.send_response(500)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(json.dumps({"error": str(e)}).encode("utf-8"))

    def _handle_sse_stream(self, parsed):
        from src.engine.microstructure import microstructure_engine
        import time

        params = urllib.parse.parse_qs(parsed.query)
        symbol = params.get("symbol", ["SPY"])[0].strip().upper()

        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/event-stream")
        self.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-cache")
        self.send_header("Connection", "keep-alive")
        self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
        self.end_headers()

        # Send initial snapshot event
        try:
            dossier = microstructure_engine.build_symbol_dossier(symbol)
            init_payload = json.dumps({
                "type": "SNAPSHOT",
                "symbol": symbol,
                "order_book": dossier.order_book.to_dict(),
                "metrics": dossier.metrics.to_dict(),
                "recent_ticks": [t.to_dict() for t in dossier.recent_ticks[:10]],
            })
            self.wfile.write(f"event: snapshot\ndata: {init_payload}\n\n".encode("utf-8"))
            self.wfile.flush()

            # Stream live ticks (up to 40 ticks per connection session)
            for _ in range(40):
                time.sleep(0.5)
                tick = microstructure_engine.generate_live_tick(symbol)
                updated_dossier = microstructure_engine._cache.get(symbol)
                tick_payload = json.dumps({
                    "type": "TICK",
                    "symbol": symbol,
                    "tick": tick.to_dict(),
                    "order_book": updated_dossier.order_book.to_dict() if updated_dossier else None,
                    "metrics": updated_dossier.metrics.to_dict() if updated_dossier else None,
                })
                self.wfile.write(f"event: tick\ndata: {tick_payload}\n\n".encode("utf-8"))
                self.wfile.flush()
        except (BrokenPipeError, ConnectionResetError):
            pass
        except Exception as e:
            try:
                self.wfile.write(f"event: error\ndata: {json.dumps({'error': str(e)})}\n\n".encode("utf-8"))
            except Exception:
                pass

    def _handle_execution_simulation(self, parsed):
        from src.engine.microstructure import microstructure_engine
        from src.engine.execution_algo import execution_algo_engine

        params = urllib.parse.parse_qs(parsed.query)
        symbol = params.get("symbol", ["SPY"])[0].strip().upper()
        side = params.get("side", ["BUY"])[0].strip().upper()
        try:
            shares = int(params.get("shares", [500])[0])
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            shares = 500

        try:
            dossier = microstructure_engine.build_symbol_dossier(symbol)
            res = execution_algo_engine.evaluate_all_strategies(
                symbol=symbol,
                side=side,  # type: ignore
                shares=shares,
                book=dossier.order_book,
                metrics=dossier.metrics,
                country=dossier.country,
            )
            payload = json.dumps(res, indent=2).encode("utf-8")
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
            self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(payload)))
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(payload)
        except Exception as e:
            err = json.dumps({"error": str(e)}).encode("utf-8")
            self.send_response(500)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(err)))
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(err)


def run_server(port: int = 8000):
    server_address = ("0.0.0.0", port)
    httpd = HTTPServer(server_address, MarketIntelHandler)
    print(f"Market Intelligence Web Server listening on http://0.0.0.0:{port}")
    try:
        httpd.serve_forever()
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("\nShutting down server.")
        httpd.server_close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    port = int(os.environ.get("PORT", 8000))
    run_server(port)
```

# Configuration & Deployment



<a id=".github-workflows-firebase_deploy.yml"></a>

### `.github/workflows/firebase_deploy.yml`

*87 lines*

```yaml
name: Deploy to Firebase Hosting

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  schedule:
    # Run every weekday at 16:30 EST (21:30 UTC) after US & Canadian markets close
    - cron: '30 21 * * 1-5'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build_and_deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          cache: 'pip'

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Run Master Market Intelligence Pipeline
        run: |
          python3 scripts/run_daily_pipeline.py

      - name: Build Public Distribution Bundle
        run: |
          python3 scripts/build_firebase_public.py

      - name: Extract Firebase Project ID
        env:
          SERVICE_ACCOUNT: ${{ secrets.FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT }}
          EXPLICIT_PROJECT_ID: ${{ secrets.FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID }}
        run: |
          python3 -c "
          import json, os
          explicit = os.environ.get('EXPLICIT_PROJECT_ID', '').strip()
          sa_raw = os.environ.get('SERVICE_ACCOUNT', '').strip()
          proj_id = explicit
          if not proj_id and sa_raw:
              try:
                  data = json.loads(sa_raw)
                  proj_id = data.get('project_id', '')
              except Exception as e:
                  print('Could not parse SERVICE_ACCOUNT JSON:', e)
          if proj_id:
              print(f'Detected Firebase Project ID: {proj_id}')
              with open('.firebaserc', 'w') as f:
                  json.dump({'projects': {'default': proj_id}}, f, indent=2)
              with open(os.environ['GITHUB_ENV'], 'a') as f:
                  f.write(f'DETECTED_PROJECT_ID={proj_id}\n')
          else:
              print('No valid project ID found in secrets or credentials.')
          "

      - name: Deploy via Service Account (if configured)
        if: env.SERVICE_ACCOUNT != '' && env.DETECTED_PROJECT_ID != ''
        uses: FirebaseExtended/action-hosting-deploy@v0
        env:
          SERVICE_ACCOUNT: ${{ secrets.FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT }}
        with:
          repoToken: '${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}'
          firebaseServiceAccount: '${{ secrets.FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT }}'
          channelId: live
          projectId: '${{ env.DETECTED_PROJECT_ID }}'

      - name: Deploy via Firebase Token (if configured)
        if: env.FIREBASE_TOKEN != '' && env.SERVICE_ACCOUNT == ''
        env:
          FIREBASE_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.FIREBASE_TOKEN }}
          SERVICE_ACCOUNT: ${{ secrets.FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT }}
        run: |
          npx firebase-tools deploy --only hosting --token "${{ secrets.FIREBASE_TOKEN }}"

      - name: Build Summary
        run: |
          echo "=========================================================="
          echo " Pipeline Execution Complete!"
          echo " Target Firebase Project: ${DETECTED_PROJECT_ID:-Not configured}"
          echo " Total staged files: $(find public -type f | wc -l)"
          echo "=========================================================="
```
